fields.name: TM-POC State Machine (covers transitions other than HandsOffAssist)
fields.description:
Refer the detail plan in this document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Y0PeGTKmN42EDYG0VQ6DPgJKpBUO8hdTpLJ3jT-ymeQ/edit?tab=t.0
 

Test Environment and Procedures

  • Driving the TM-POC car to the closed course, and then bringing up the driver stack. Make sure the DRB release is after DRB r20250111.1.0. You need add the following parameters in internal_product_driver task, –internal_product_driver.really_drive=1

  • Moving the car to the open EPA track. No specific location required as long as the vehicle can always be localized successfully during the test.

  • Two operators are required to finish all test cases.

  • For safety, at any time during the test, the vehicle speed should be less than 50km/h. (~31 mph). Even if the vehicle is in HandsOff state when reaching the speed, press the brake to exit HandsOff state and lower the speed.

  • The test cases do not need to be executed in order. If any test case failed, mark it as failed and continue the rest of the case.

The operators should end the test if any of the following happens.
1. The vehicle is not in good condition. Such as any warning error light on in the dashboard),can not accelerate, brake, turn properly.
2. If the vehicle can not be localized. you may need run

fields.name: Transition from ControlOff to HandsOff
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.

Transition condition

No StrongSteer AND  trajectory is valid AND

SplState is active

How to test

  1. Make sure the car is already in ControlOffState, if not, put hands on the steering wheel and press the ACC cancel button to quickly transition to ControlOffState. Confirming only LED1 is on.

  2. If there is no emergency, make sure not to press the brake pedal, leave the hands off the steer wheel.  LED3 should become yellow flashing. Press the ACC button. LED2 should be blue and LED3 should become yellow. 

  3. Do not brake if there is no emergency. Observe the car is driving along properly for around 15 seconds.

  4. Mark the test success and split and save the log.

fields.name: Transition from HandsOff to DotNormal
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.

 

Transition condition

(There is no strong steer happening) and (speed is above 5km/h) and (ACC is disabled or Brake Pedal is pressed)

StrongSteer & SpeedHigh & (!SplStateActive | BrakePedalOperation))

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in HandsOff mode by following “Transition from controlOff to HandsOff”, LED2 should be blue and LED3 should be yellow.

  2. Make sure the vehicle speed is greater than 15km/h (~9.3mph)

  3. If the environment is safe, leave your hands off the steering wheel.

  4. Gently press the brake pedal, (make sure after the press, the vehicle speed is still greater than 5km/h or 3.2mph). You should see LED2 turns green and LED3 should be yellow.

  5. Observe the car can NOT drive along itself. (No steering wheel wigging or brake/accelerate action)

  6. Put hands on the steering wheel to transit the state to controlOff. Both LED2 and LED3 shall be off.

  7. Redo steps 1, 2, 3.

  8. Press the cancel button. You should see LED2 turns green and LED3 shall be off.

  9. Redo steps 5, 6.

  10. Mark the test success and split and save the log.

fields.name: Transition from HandsOff to FadeOutToManualDrive
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.
 

Transition condition

(There is strong steer)

StrongSteer

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in HandsOff mode by following “Transition from controlOff to HandsOff”.  LED2 should be blue and LED3 should be yellow.

  2. Do a strong steer to the left (> 3.0nm/meter). You should see the LED2 off and LED3 off

  3. Observe the car can NOT drive along itself. (No steering wheel wigging or brake/accelerate action)

  4. Redo step 1,2,3,4, except this time do a strong steer to the right in step 2.

  5. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: Transition from HandsOff to DotStop
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.

 

Transition condition
(There is no strong steer happening) and (speed is below 5km/h) and (ACC is disabled or Brake Pedal is pressed)

"!StrongSteer & CarStop & (!SplStateActive | !TrajectoryValid | BrakePedalOperation)"

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in HandsOff mode by following “Transition from controlOff to HandsOff”, LED2 should be blue and LED3 should be yellow.

  2. Make sure the vehicle speed is less than 5km/hours.

  3. Gently press the brake pedal. You should see the LED2 is off, LED3 is off. Underneath the state transits from HandsOff to DotStop, then to FadeOutToManualDrive. Need check TLog to confirm later.

  4. Repeat Step 1, 2.

  5. Press the cancel button.

  6. You should see the LED2 is green and LED3 is yellow

  7. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: Transition from DotNormal to FadeOutToManualDrive
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.

Transition condition

"StrongSteer |  LeftGrip | RightGrip"

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in DotNormal mode by following “Transition from HandsOff to DotNormal”, step 1 - 4. 

  2. Grip the left side of the steering wheel, the vehicle shall be in FadeOutToManualDrive mode.  LED2 will be off, LED3 will be off.

  3. Repeat the step 1, and grip the right side of the steering wheel,  the vehicle shall be in FadeOutToManualDrive mode.   LED2 will be off, LED3 will be off.

  4. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: Transition from DotNormal to DotDecelerate
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.

Transition condition

"SpeedLow |  !(LeftGrip | RightGrip) & !StrongSteer"

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in DotNormal mode by following “Transition from HandsOff to DotNormal”, step 1 - 4. 

  2. Lower the speed to less than 15km/hour(~9.3mph)

  3. The vehicle shall be in DotDecelerate state. There is no LED difference between DotNormal and DotDecelerate.

  4. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: Transition from DotNormal to DotStop
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.

Transition condition

"CarStop &  !(LeftGrip | RightGrip) & !StrongSteer"

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in DotNormal mode by following “Transition from HandsOff to DotNormal”, step 1 - 4. 

  2. Hard press the brake pedal so the speed dropped to less than 5km/hour, make sure do not put hands on steering wheel

  3. The vehicle shall be in DotStop state. You need to check the software log to confirm. It is possible that the state transitions to DotDecelerate first, then DotStop if the brake pedal is not pressed hard enough. If we can’t see a direct transition from DotNormal to DotStop, we can give up this testcase.

  4. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: Transition from DotDecelerate to DotStop
fields.description:
Transition condition

"!(LeftGrip | RightGrip) & !StrongSteer & CarStop"

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in HandsOff mode by following “Transition from controlOff to HandsOff”, LED2 should be blue and LED3 should be yellow.

  2. When the vehicle speed is between 5km and 15km, leave your hands off the steering wheel, press the cancel button. The state should be in DotDecelerate now. (Underneath, it transits to DOTNormal first, then transit to DotDecelerate)

  3. Within 4 seconds after pressing the brake pedal above. Press the brake pedal again to lower the speed to 5km/h. The state should be in DOTStop now. However, it will transit to ManualFade immediately.

  4. Redo Step 1, 2, and wait over 4 seconds, and keep waiting until the vehicle speed is lower than 5km/h. The state should be in DOTStop now. (You can put the gear to neutral to lower the speed)

  5. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: Transition from DotDecelerate to FadeOutToManualDrive
fields.description:
Transition condition

"LeftGrip | RightGrip | StrongSteer | (StayInDotDecelerateOver4Seconds & (BrakePedalOperation | Accelerator)"

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in DotDecelerate mode by following “Transition from DotDecelerate to DotStop”, step 1 - 2. 

  2. Put hands on the steering wheel, the state should be in FadeOutToManualDrive state, 

  3. Repeat steps 1, wait over 4 seconds, press the brake pedal  the state should be FadeOutToManualDrive now

  4. Repeat steps 1, wait over 4 seconds, press the accelerate pedal  the state should be FadeOutToManualDrive now

  5. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: Transition from DotStop to FadeOutToManualDrive
fields.description:
Transition condition

"(BrakePedalOperation | Accelerator)"

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in HandsOff mode by following “Transition from controlOff to HandsOff”, the blue LED shall be on when in HandsOff State.

  2. Following “Transition from HandsOff to DotStop” to make sure the vehicle is in DotStop state,  make sure you do not put hands on the steering wheel.

  3. After 4 seconds, press the accelerator pedal, the state shall be in FadeOutToManualDrive

  4. Repeat step 1,2.

  5. Press the brake pedal, the state shall be in FadeOutToManualDrive.

  6. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: FadeOutToManualDrive to ControlOff
fields.description:
Testcases

Once power up the vehicle, the state machine should be in ControlOff State

The operators should see LED1 being red and all other LEDs being off. The ACC indicator icon should appear.
Once seeing the above, split and save the log.

Transition condition

Transit immediately

How to Test

  1. Make sure the car is in HandsOff mode by following “Transition from controlOff to HandsOff”.

  2. Following “Transition from HandsOff to FadeOutToManualDrive” to make sure the vehicle is in FadeOutToManualDrive state.

  3. Mark this test success and split/save the log.

fields.name: TMPOC Verification Tests for Safety Goal 2
fields.description:
Purpose 

To detail the verification plans of the Technical Safety Requirements (TSRs) related to Safety Goal 2: The autonomy kit (AK) shall prevent lateral or longitudinal control outputs to the base vehicle if these outputs are outside the safe performance area.

 

General Test Setup and Precautions

Test site: 

Any reasonably straight stretch of closed course track will do.  The test track should be reasonably free of obstacles on either side of the vehicle, with a recommended minimum lateral buffer of 10 feet  on either side of the vehicle.

 

Test goals: 

  • Verify that the autonomy kit does not allow control requests sent to the base vehicle to exceed the expected guard values.   

 

The following tests make use of the “vehicle characterization controller” to perform maneuvers with a specified trajectory. If you are unfamiliar with operating the vehicle characterization controller, please refer to the above linked Confluence page and/or reach out to a subject matter expert on the Controls team. 

 

The dummy_controller_vehicle_characterization only performs a specified motion. It WILL NOT react to lane lines or objects in the environment.

fields.name: Longitudinal acceleration limit test
fields.description:
Test Setup/Site:

  • Long straight section of road/test track.

  • Ensure that the vehicle used for testing has a working NeoVI FIRE CAN logger installed

 

Test Risks:

  • Acceleration & Braking limits may not be implemented correctly, leading to overbrake or underbrake.  This may lead to loss of traction or trajectory overshoot. Ensure the test area is reasonably free of obstacles.

  • The dummy_controller_vehicle_characterization only performs a specified motion. It WILL NOT react to lane lines or objects in the environment.  

 

Test Risk Mitigations:

  • Tests trajectories shall be straight line, reducing the risk of off-trajectory dynamics

  • Manual takeover of the system is possible by operation of the manual controls and/or Estop button. 

 

Test Overview:

After a 3 second pause, this test will accelerate the vehicle from a stop up to ~50 mph (22 m/s) with the maximum allowed acceleration by the SCALEXIO. Once the vehicle reaches a speed of at least 45 mph, the driver may end the test and regain manual control of the vehicle. The vehicle should only move in a straight line and will make no attempt to stay in lane or avoid objects in its path. 

 

Test Procedure

 

  1. Position vehicle on the test track

  1. On Driving startup menu select:

    1. Test Category: SW_Test

    2. Map Mode: HD 

  1. Select the mission dummy_controller_vehicle_characterization 

    1. From the ANN section in the mission selection dialog box. Note: This mission can be run from anywhere, no need to physically be in ANN.

  1. Select the desired Hardware Configuration

  1. Click On Mount then click on Start.

  1. Stop the controller process.

    1. Not really necessary. You can always reset it before running the test.

  1. Run param edit and set the parameters for your test

    1. Longitudinal_maneuver = step

    2. Lateral_maneuver = step_steer

    3. Velocity_desired = 25 m/s

    4. steer_angle_desired_deg = 0 deg

    5. accel_lower_limit = -8 m/s/s

    6. accel_desired = 5 m/s/s

    7. maneuver_delay = 3 seconds

    8. maneuver_duration = 25 seconds

  1. Once vehicle reaches a speed above 45 mph, driver may take over

  1. Split the log.

  1. Restart the controller process and instruct the driver to engage autonomy as soon as the vehicle enters ready state.

    1. In the process manager,  under controller, you should see:

      1. "Maneuver Start..."

      2. "Maneuver Complete"

    2. These messages denote the maneuver itself, not the setup time.

fields.name: Longitudinal deceleration limit test
fields.description:
Test Setup/Site:

  • Long straight section of road/test track.

  • Ensure that the vehicle used for testing has a working CAN logger installed

 

Test Risks:

  • Acceleration & Braking limits may not be implemented correctly, leading to overbrake or underbrake.  This may lead to loss of traction or trajectory overshoot. Ensure the test area is reasonably free of obstacles.

 

Test Risk Mitigations:

  • Tests trajectories shall be straight line, reducing the risk of off-trajectory dynamics

  • Tests are to be run with incrementally increasing speeds so that marginal behavior can be detected and the test progression halted if necessary.

  • Manual takeover of the system is possible by operation of the manual controls and/or Estop button.

This test will immediately cause the vehicle to accelerate as rapidly as possible to the “Velocity_desired”, maintain this speed for “maneuver_delay” seconds, and then decelerate at the maximum allowed deceleration imposed by the SCALEXIO. The vehicle should only move in a straight line and will make no attempt to stay in lane or avoid objects in its path.

fields.name: TMPOC Verification Tests for Safety Goal 1
fields.description:
Purpose

To detail the verification plans of the Technical Safety Requirements (TSRs) related to Safety Goal 1: The AK shall allow the safety driver to take over control of the lateral and/or longitudinal motion of the base vehicle on safety driver's demand in a timely manner. 

 

General Test Setup and Precautions

Test site: 

Any reasonably straight stretch of closed course track will do.  The test track should be reasonably free of obstacles on either side of the vehicle, with a recommended minimum lateral buffer of 10 feet  on either side of the vehicle.

 

Test goals: 

  • Test the transitions into and out of the “HandsOffAssist” state

  • Verify expected driver takeover mechanisms work as expected

  • Verify requirements regarding necessary “readiness” conditions in order to enter a HandsOffAssist state 

  • Verify HMI functions as expected

 

Test Risks:

  • The tests are checking the behavior of the underlying driver takeover mechanisms.  Failure modes may include but are not limited to the following:

    • Misrepresentation of vehicle control state

    • Simultaneous human and computer control

    • Split controls (e.g.: computer operated steering and human operated brake)

 

Test Risk Mitigations:

  • Conduct the Estop button test first.

  • Conduct lower speed tests first before proceeding on to higher speeds.

 

Estimated test time: 2 hours

fields.name: Interlock Acceptance Test
fields.description:
Process

Vehicle tests on the TM-POC with Internal Product SW must be carried out on a vehicle component build (VCB) that has passed an Interlock Acceptance Test. If the VCB has not passed an Interlock Acceptance Test, then an Interlock Acceptance Test must be performed before further tests are carried out.

 

The completion of the Interlock Acceptance Test will be tracked by AVRD-20641 ticket in JIRA for daily release builds (DRB). Ad-hoc software releases must perform the interlock acceptance test, and then proceed with the planned test.

 

This process applies to all types of vehicle testing:

  • Development data collection

  • Autonomous or manual closed course tests

  • Autonomous or manual public road tests

Interlock Acceptance Test

Follow the steps below to perform an Interlock Acceptance Test on TM-POC.

 

  1. Setup the vehicle on any portion of the closed course with adequate run off space on all sides and away from obstacles.

  2. Start the internal product software using the “driving” startup menu.

  3. Wait for all processes to start up.

  4. Observe the vehicle image on X-view.  If “No vehicle pose” is displayed, wait until a GNSS solution is acquired, and the Applanix publishes a vehicle pose.  If another message such as “Not localized” is displayed, ok to proceed.

  5. Stop the controller process using the process manager if it was automatically started.

  6. Start the tmpoc_interlock_acceptance_controller from the manual section of the process manager.

  7. Move the vehicle gear selector to Drive, and release the brake pedal (vehicle will begin to creep forward).

  8. Verify no lateral (steering) motion or additional longitudinal motion, including braking, beyond expected vehicle creep is observed from the vehicle for 15 seconds.

  9. Kill tmpoc_interlock_acceptance_controller. Start controller process.

fields.name: Basic longitudinal vehicle motion
fields.description:
This scenario is unofficial - it is part of a spike testing improvements in the organisation and traceability of reqs, verifications, scenarios and test cases.

Original contents extracted from /inspired by Chauf-SYS_VER-1.

 

Overview

 

This is a simple linear motion test which evaluates the ego vehicle's ability to comfortably accelerate/decelerate, as well as maintain a constant speed at a chosen speed limit.  At no point throughout the mission shall the AV exceed the speed limit.

 

This scenario can be used to provide data for the following verifications:

 

Verification Name
Chauf-SYS_VER-56 Ego vehicle must not exceed the posted speed limit 
... ...

Scenario Modelling

 

  • Road geometry is straight, flat, with length of approximately 350 m
  • Start/end points are "STOP" lines on the lane
  • Surface friction constraints: μ ∈ [0.65, 0.85] (not a variation, just permitted bounds for testing)
  • Initial AV speed is 0.0 m/s (0.0 mph)

Variations

 

Variation Description
Speed Limit [11.18 m/s (25 mph), 15.64 m/s (35 mph)]

Visuals

                                  Exemplar Speed Profile (15 mph)

Pre-Conditions

 

If any of the pre-conditions fail, the test result should be marked as 'blocked'.

 

  • AV must travel at least 90% of the distance between stop lines
  • AV maximum speed exceeds 90% of the specified speed limit
  • AV stays in lane
  • AV comes to a stop before the stop line at the end of the lane

Software Testing

 

Simulation

 

  • All variations should be tested
  • Tooling
    • Lite Planner + Control only scenario simulation with oracular pose provider is sufficient
    • (debugging) planner only scenario simulation
    • (optional) full system testing

Closed Course Testing

 

  • Testing to be conducted on the TOL Japan side.
  • Perception stack must be functional (safety)

  • In AV mode, please perform two laps of the TOL Japan side scrimmage route using “"ann_ottawalake_mvp1" mission file.  Scribe should the vehicle exceed the speed limit.

  • For additional information on the Test Procedure, please see this link to the FOPs folder procedure.

fields.name: Yield to pedestrians in or about to enter crosswalks while ego vehicle is proceeding straight
fields.description:
This verification is unofficial - it is part of a spike testing improvements in the organisation and traceability of reqs, verifications, scenarios and test cases.

Original contents extracted from /inspired by Chauf-SYS_VER-14.

 

Overview

 

This is a simple linear motion test which evaluates the ego vehicle's ability to comfortably accelerate/decelerate, as well as maintain a constant speed at a chosen speed limit.

 

This scenario can be used to provide data for the following verifications:

 

Verification Name
Chauf-SYS_VER-57 Minimal allowable distance to near side of crosswalk when approaching and crosswalk is occupied by a pedestrian
... ...

Scenario Modelling

 

  • Intersection with crossings or straight segment of road
  • The front bumper of the AV is located a distance Pe [m] from the near edge of the crosswalk.
  • AV approaches the crosswalk at Ve [m/s] and attempts to proceed "straight" through the crosswalk (i.e., does not execute a turning maneuver).
  • Pedestrians are initially located within the crosswalk at a distance, Lw [%], from the driver's side of the AV
  • The pedestrian moves at a constant speed of Vp [km/h]. 
  • Pedestrian's moving direction shall be PD.
  • Total number of pedestrians within the crosswalk at the start of the scenario is, Np. 
  • The rate at which pedestrians enter/exit the crosswalk will be Rp [pedestrians/s].
  • Pedestrian type shall be PT.
  • Pedestrian shall be occluded PO [%].

 

 

Variations

 

Link to Spreadsheet

 

 

Pre-Conditions

 

If any of the pre-conditions fail, the test result should be marked as 'blocked'.

 

  • ...

Software Testing

 

Perception

 

  • TBD

Simulation

 

  • Variations: all variations should be tested
  • Tooling
    • Lite Planner + Control only scenario simulation with oracular pose provider is sufficient
    • (debugging) planner only scenario simulation
    • (optional) full system testing

Closed Course Testing

 

  • Testing to be conducted on the TOL US side.
  • Perception stack must be functional (safety)

  • All test cases to be run 10 times with successful execution expected for all runs.

    • 25 mph: vehicle straight through crosswalk.

    • 40 mph: vehicle straight through crosswalk.

  • Test Procedure:

    • Manually set the target vehicle speed to match the test speed that is being tested.

    • Split the log and assign a name corresponding to test speed and case. For example, “crosswalk_25mph_case1”. 

    • Drive toward the intersection with autonomy engaged.

    • For test cases with an expected outcome of STOP: 

      • The static object or pedestrian must be in place as the vehicle crosses the braking zone cone

      • A moving pedestrian must enter the crosswalk as the vehicle passes the braking zone cone, proceed to the final pedestrian position as shown below, then remain there statically until the vehicle stops. The pedestrian should then exit the crosswalk on the side it entered, and confirm the car resumes travel.

    • For test cases with an expected outcome of DO NOT STOP:

      • The pedestrian should be outside the driveable surface but between the crosswalk boundaries as shown below, as the vehicle passes the braking zone cone.

    • For each test run, note in the rating sheet whether the vehicle stopped or did not stop, or if a handback occured.

    • Scribe any notable behaviors including late detections, localization issues, abrupt vehicle behavior etc.

  • For additional information on the Test Procedure, please see this link to the FOPs folder procedure.

Description

Specification

SWRD-PnP-LCA-NAV_MapLinkLc_110_SP_1

  • Propose a mainline LC to reach the destination at a suitable position before the branch for the destination. (See "LC proposal" in the figure.)
    目的地到達のための本線LC提案を目的地に向けた分岐手前の適切な位置で出すこと。（図の "LC proposal" を参照。）

    It shall be the position where enough time and space is left to perform the all LC assists to reach the destination.
    これは、目的地到達のための全てのLC支援を実行するに足る十分な時間的・空間的猶予が確保された位置である必要がある。

    Assume the time between an LC proposal is displayed and the driver approves it to be 5.0 s (LP_TIME_FOR_DRIVER_APPROVAL_SEC).
    提案してからドライバが承認するまでにかかる時間としては、 5.0 s (LP_TIME_FOR_DRIVER_APPROVAL_SEC) を考慮すること。

    Make an agreement on the logic design with the department issuing the requirement.
    ロジック設計については要求元と合意すること。

The suitable position should be determined from the ability of the system considering required number of LCs, congestion of the LC target lane, accuracy of the map information or localization, etc.
必要なレーンチェンジ回数や、LC先車線の混雑によりLCに時間がかかる可能性、あるいは地図・位置推定精度等も考慮し、能力に合わせて適切な位置を定めること。

In 20TM, system-initiated LC starts at 1500m (JP) or 3200m (US) before the position where a manual LC request starts, and they also increase if the necessary LC count increases.
20TMでは、手動LC要求開始位置から日本は1500m、北米は3200m手前からシステムトリガLCを開始し、必要なLC回数が増えるごとに距離を延ばす様に設計していた。

fields.rationale$592:

fields.description:
Interface

    ターンコンビSW

    ターン信号情報 -> ターンシグナル状態

  • AD State (ADStateManager)
    AD 状態

    LC提案表示要求状態

Specification

SWRD-PnP-LCA-LcpInactive_DC_010_SP_1

  • LC assist shall be initiated as "Driver-Confirmed LC" if all of the following conditions are satisfied (Transition to BeforeSteering):
    以下の条件をすべて満たしたときに"提案承認型LC"としてLC支援を開始すること(BeforeSteeringに遷移すること)。

    • While the "Preconditions(Driver-Confirmed LC)" are satisfied, the following operation is detected:
      The blinker lever is moved to OFF[*2] to left first position[*1] and then returned to OFF[*2] at the timing when the elapsed time condition[*3] is satisfied.
      "提案承認型LC前提条件"を満足する状態で次の操作を検知した。
      ウィンカOFF[*2]から左ウィンカ１段目[*1]に操作され、経過時間の条件[*3]を満たすタイミングでウィンカOFF[*2]になった。

    [*1] Turn Switch Data ->Turn Switch Position (Left) == 1: LeftTurnSwitchON

    [*2] Turn Switch Data ->Turn Switch Position (Left) == 0: OFF

    [*3] 0.05 s (DRIVER_TRIGGER_TAP_MIN_SEC) ≤≤ elapsed time << 0.35 s (DRIVER_TRIGGER_TAP_MAX_SEC)

    • While the "Preconditions(Driver-Confirmed LC)" are satisfied, the following operation is detected:
      The blinker lever is moved to OFF[*5] to right first position[*4] and then returned to OFF[*5] at the timing when the elapsed time condition[*6] is satisfied.
      "提案承認型LC前提条件"を満足する状態で次の操作を検知した。
      ウィンカOFF[*5]から右ウィンカ１段目[*4]に操作され、経過時間の条件[*6]を満たすタイミングでウィンカOFF[*5]になった。

    [*4] Turn Switch Data ->Turn Switch Position (Right) == 1: RightTurnSwitchON

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-LCA-NAV_LcSupp_020
fields.description:
Determine the LC as a suppression target, if another LC to the opposite direction is determined to be necessary.

ある方向のLCが必要だと判断した場合、逆方向のLCを抑制対象とする。
fields.rationale$592:
If another LC in the opposite direction is necessary, it may lead to an immediate return LC being proposed after the first LC. To reduce inconvenience, determine the first LC as a suppression target.
逆方向のLCが必要な場合は、LC後にすぐに元に戻るLCが提案されてしまう可能性があることから、煩わしさ低減のために最初のLCを抑制対象とする。

 

LINK

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-LCA-NAV_LcSupp_020_SP_1
fields.description:
• Determine the corresponding LC as a suppression target in @condition (LC Condition List) for an LC in the opposite direction, if an LC is necessary within a certain distance [*1] ahead of the ego vehicle.
    自車前方の一定距離以内[*1]で LC が必要なとき、@condition(LC Condition List)で該当する場合、LC方向と逆方向のLCを抑制対象と判定する。

    [*1]
    The certain distance is defined as follows. The distance depends on the LCA initiation category of the LC to be judged and whether it is a new proposal or an existing proposal.
    一定距離は以下の通りとする。抑制判定対象の LC の LCA起動方法カテゴリーによって、また、新規提案開始か既存提案維持かで、距離を切り替える。

    In addition, when starting a new proposal, add a margin considering time for the driver to confirm.
    また提案を新たに開始するときは、ドライバの承認に必要な時間を考慮して、さらにマージンを追加する。

    LCA Initiation Category Distance
    Driver Confirmed LC 500.0 m (LP_REQ_DIST_FOR_DC_LC_METER) for keeping an existing proposal and add 5.0 s (LP_TIME_FOR_DRIVER_APPROVAL_SEC) more if starting a new proposal
    Driver Initiated LC 500.0 m (LP_REQ_DIST_FOR_DI_LC_METER)

    Interface

    IN

  • Long Spatial Information (MapService)
    長距離空間情報

    LC先レーンの一定距離以内[*1]で LC が必要なとき、@condition(LC Condition List)で該当する、LC方向と逆方向のLCを抑制対象と判定する。

    LCをすることで目的地に到達できなくなることがわかっている場合、事前にLCを抑制対象とすることで快適な走行を実現する。

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-LCA-LP_DynamicLc_020
fields.description:
- After executing an overtaking LC, if certain conditions are satisfied, a lane change proposal to return to the driving lane is made.

- 追い越しLCを実施後、所定の条件を満足した場合、走行レーンへの追い越し戻りLCを提案する

 

Interface

IN

  • Object (ThreeSixtyDegreePerception)
    物標

  • Customization state for overtaking proposal (Internal)
    Traffic flow LC customization state

  • Ego vehicle speed (based on wheel speed) (IOLayer)
    自車車体速度（車輪速ベース）

  • Target Space Information (Internal)
    狙いスペース情報

  • Long Spatial Information (MapService)
    長距離空間情報

OUT

  • LC Proposal Info (Internal)
    LC提案情報

Specification

SWRD-PnP-LCA-LP_DynamicLc_020_SP_1

  • Output an return proposal when all of the following conditions are met.
    下記条件のすべてを満たす場合に、追い越し戻り提案を出力すること

    Note that the direction left/right of the faster lane is different by country. Use information in Long Spatial Information.
    高速側レーンが左右どちらかは、国ごとに違うので留意すること。長距離空間情報 内に情報が格納されている。

    • The current Customization state for overtaking proposal (Internal) is CustomStateToggle::On.
      現在の 交通流LCカスタマイズ状態 が CustomStateToggle::On である

    • During the overtaking state.
      追越中状態であること。

    • Driving in the fastest lane.
      最高速車線を走行中。

    • The preceding vehicle at the start of overtaking has been successfully overtaken.
      追越開始時の先行車を追い越せていること

    • The blinker in the forward directions is not on.
      順方向のウィンカが点灯中でない

    • It has been 3.0 s (LP_SUPP_AFTER_SYSTEM_START_SEC) or more since the activation of AD.
      AD起動開始してから3.0 s (LP_SUPP_AFTER_SYSTEM_START_SEC)以上経過していること

    • There is space available for a lane change (LC) in the target lane, or it is expected that space will become available.
      LC先レーンにLC可能なスペースが存在する、もしくは見込みがあること。

    OUT Value
    LC Proposal Info (Internal) Information about the return LC proposal
    追い越し戻り提案情報。

SWRD-PnP-LCA-LP_DynamicLc_020_SP_2

  • Withdraw the LC proposal when any of the following conditions are met.
    下記条件のいずれかを満たす場合に、LC 提案を取り下げること。

    • Entered a section where the LC assisted by the system is not possible.
      システムによる LC 支援が不可能な区間に入った

    • A certain amount of time (30.0 s (LP_PROP_TIMEOUT_SEC)) or more has passed without approval.
      承認されずに一定時間(30.0 s (LP_PROP_TIMEOUT_SEC))以上が経過した

    • The driver rejected the proposal.
      ドライバが拒否した

    • The surrounding environment has become unsuitable for returning to the original lane.
      追い越し戻り不可能な周辺環境になった

    • It has been determined that reaching the destination will not be possible.
      目的地に到達できなくなると判断された

    OUT Value
    LC Proposal Info (Internal) Proposal withdrawal information (including withdrawal reasons)
    提案取り下げ情報（取り下げ理由を含む）

    Make sure to have measures to reduce flickering/hunting as shown below.
    ただし、以下に例示するような、瞬灯・瞬滅等の防止のための措置を講じること。

    • Have hysteresis mechanism on judgement thresholds if possible.
      可能な範囲で判断基準にヒステリシス等を設ける。
    • If the withdrawal conditions are only temporary or re-proposal is possible soon, and there is no concern about immediate cancellation after approval, keep the proposal for 2.0 s (LP_PROP_MIN_SEC) at least.
      一時的な取り下げ条件成立で、再度提案条件成立の可能性があり、承認後即キャンセルなどの懸念も無い場合は、最低提案維持時間(2.0 s (LP_PROP_MIN_SEC))を確保する仕組みを設ける。
    • After withdrawal, avoid to make new proposal for 4.0 s (LP_PROP_SUPP_AFTER_WITHDRAW_SEC)
      提案を取り下げた場合、4.0 s (LP_PROP_SUPP_AFTER_WITHDRAW_SEC) の間、再提案を抑制する。

    note

    It is not necessary to keep proposal when it is not expected LC will become possible.
    LC が出来ないと見込まれる様な場合に提案を続ける必要はない。

    UN-R171 allows proposal only when LC is expected to be possible.
    UN-R171 は提案をLC可能と判断した時に限っているため。
fields.rationale$592:
• Because the vehicle should return to the driving lane once the overtaking of the slower preceding vehicle is completed.
    遅い先行車の追い越しが終わったら、走行車線に戻るべきであるため

 

LINK

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-LCA-LP_DynamicLc_030
fields.description:
Interface

IN

  • Object (ThreeSixtyDegreePerception)
    物標

  • Ego vehicle speed (based on wheel speed) (IOLayer)
    自車車体速度（車輪速ベース）

  • Proposal Reject Flag (HumanSystemInterface)
    提案却下フラグ

  • Target Space Information (Internal)
    狙いスペース情報

  • Long Spatial Information (MapService)
    長距離空間情報

OUT

  • LC Proposal Info (Internal)
    LC提案情報

Specification

SWRD-PnP-LCA-LP_DynamicLc_030_SP_1

  • If all of the following conditions are met, output a proposal for exiting the fastest lane.
    下記条件のすべてを満たす場合に、最高速車線離脱LC提案を出力すること。

    Note that the direction left/right of the faster lane is different by country. Use information in Long Spatial Information.
    高速側レーンが左右どちらかは、国ごとに違うので留意すること。長距離空間情報 内に情報が格納されている。

    • The driving in the fastest lane continues more than or equal to 2000.0 m (LP_FASTEST_LANE_LIMIT_STAY_METER) or 120.0 s (LP_FASTEST_LANE_LIMIT_STAY_SEC)
      最高速車線の走行が 2000.0 m (LP_FASTEST_LANE_LIMIT_STAY_METER) または 120.0 s (LP_FASTEST_LANE_LIMIT_STAY_SEC) 以上継続していること。

    • During the overtaking state.
      追越中状態でないこと。

    • Driving in the fastest lane.
      最高速車線を走行中。

    • The blinker in the forward directions is not on.
      順方向のウィンカが点灯中でない

    • It has been 3.0 s (LP_SUPP_AFTER_SYSTEM_START_SEC) or more since the activation of AD.
      AD起動開始してから3.0 s (LP_SUPP_AFTER_SYSTEM_START_SEC)以上経過していること

    • There is space available for a lane change (LC) in the target lane, or it is expected that space will become available.
      LC先レーンにLC可能なスペースが存在する、もしくは見込みがあること。

    OUT Value
    LC Proposal Info (Internal) Proposaling for exiting the fastest lane information.
    最高速車線離脱LC提案情報。

SWRD-PnP-LCA-LP_DynamicLc_030_SP_2

  • Withdraw the LC proposal when the following conditions are met.
    下記条件のいずれかを満たす場合に、LC 提案を取り下げること。

    • Entered a section where the LC assisted by the system is not possible.
      システムによる LC 支援が不可能な区間に入った

    • The driver rejected the proposal.
      ドライバが拒否した

      No timeout for fastest-lane-exit feature. Since this is regulation related, the driver's explicit rejection is necessary.
      最高速車線離脱に関しては、タイムアウトは設けない。法規要件であるため、拒否と判定するにはドライバの明確な意思を必要とする。

    • The surrounding environment has become unsuitable for returning to the original lane.
      追い越し戻り不可能な周辺環境になった

    • It has been determined that reaching the destination will not be possible.
      目的地に到達できなくなると判断された

    OUT Value
    LC Proposal Info (Internal) Proposal withdrawal information (including withdrawal reasons)
    提案取り下げ情報（取り下げ理由を含む）

    Make sure to have measures to reduce flickering/hunting as shown below.
    ただし、以下に例示するような、瞬灯・瞬滅等の防止のための措置を講じること。

    • Have hysteresis mechanism on judgement thresholds if possible.
      可能な範囲で判断基準にヒステリシス等を設ける。
    • If the withdrawal conditions are only temporary or re-proposal is possible soon, and there is no concern about immediate cancellation after approval, keep the proposal for 2.0 s (LP_PROP_MIN_SEC) at least.
      一時的な取り下げ条件成立で、再度提案条件成立の可能性があり、承認後即キャンセルなどの懸念も無い場合は、最低提案維持時間(2.0 s (LP_PROP_MIN_SEC))を確保する仕組みを設ける。
    • After withdrawal, avoid to make new proposal for 4.0 s (LP_PROP_SUPP_AFTER_WITHDRAW_SEC)
      提案を取り下げた場合、4.0 s (LP_PROP_SUPP_AFTER_WITHDRAW_SEC) の間、再提案を抑制する。
fields.rationale$592:
• Because continuously driving in the fastest lane constitutes a traffic violation.
    最高速車線を走行し続けることは交通違反になるため

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-LK-10
fields.description:
Description

The timing for initiating this determination when entering the shoulder lane from the main line, and the timing for ending this determination when exiting from the shoulder lane, is aligned with the definition of SWRD-LaDSC-3 judgement timing.
本線から路肩レーンに侵入しているシーンで本判定を開始するタイミング、および路肩レーンから退出しているシーンで本判定を終了するタイミングはSWRD-LaDSC-3の判定のタイミングの定義と合わせる。

Interface

IN

  • Camera information
    カメラ情報

  • Ego vehicle pose in odometry coordinate system
    オドメトリ座標系における自車のポーズ

  • Map and navigation information
    地図およびナビルート情報

OUT

  • Odd violation state
    ODD逸脱状態

Specification

SWRD-PnP-LK-10_SP_1

  • If the vehicle is driving within or attempting to enter or exit the shoulder lane, "Odd violation state" is set to kOddViolationDrivingOffRoadway.
    自車が路肩レーン内を走行している、または自車が路肩レーンに侵入しようとしている、または自車が路肩レーンから退出しようとしている場合は「ODD逸脱状態」をkOddViolationDrivingOffRoadwayとする。

  • Otherwise, set "Odd violation state" to kOddViolationNotSystemLimitation.
    上記以外の場合は「ODD逸脱状態」をkOddViolationNotSystemLimitationとする。

    • [Description] Because no ODD violation state other than kOddViolationDrivingOffRoadway exists now, this requirement defines the condition for kOddViolationDrivingOffRoadway. If a new ODD violation state is added in the future, the condition for kOddViolationNotSystemLimitation will be defined in a separate requirement.
      【説明】現状の「ODD逸脱状態」はkOddViolationDrivingOffRoadway以外に逸脱状態がないため、本要件でkOddViolationDrivingOffRoadwayの条件を定義する。もし将来、別のODD逸脱状態が追加された場合、kOddViolationNotSystemLimitationとする条件は別要件化する予定である。
fields.rationale$592:
• If the vehicle is driving on the shoulder lane, it is determined to be not in normal driving mode, and a state transition in the AD control system is carried out.
    路肩レーンを走行している場合は通常走行ではないと判断しAD制御状態の状態遷移を行う。

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-LK-12
fields.description:
Description

  • This requirement defines the common specifications for "target trajectory" that are referenced by all trajectory generation requirements (SWRD-PnP-LK-1, SWRD-PnP-LK-2, SWRD-PnP-LK-5, SWRD-PnP-LK-6, SWRD-PnP-LK-13).
    本要件は、全トラジェクトリ生成要件（SWRD-PnP-LK-1, SWRD-PnP-LK-2, SWRD-PnP-LK-5, SWRD-PnP-LK-6, SWRD-PnP-LK-13）から参照される「目標トラジェクトリ」の共通仕様を定義する。

Interface

IN

OUT

Specification

SWRD-PnP-LK-12_SP_1

  • The trajectory path expressed by the coordinate sequence of "target trajectory" and the attributes at each trajectory point (curvature, speed, longitudinal acceleration, etc.) shall be mutually consistent.
    「目標トラジェクトリ」の座標点列で表現される軌跡と、トラジェクトリ各点のattribute（曲率、速度、縦加速度等）は互いに整合すること。

    • [Description] Consistency is verified by the downstream trajectory checker. Specific verification details and thresholds will be detailed separately based on controller requirements.
      【説明】整合性は後段のトラジェクトリチェッカーで検証される。具体的な検証内容や閾値はコントローラー要件を踏まえて別途詳細化する。

SWRD-PnP-LK-12_SP_2

  • "Target trajectory" shall be a sequence of 51 (NUM_POINTS_OF_TRAJECTORY) points sampled at intervals of 0.1 s (TRAJECTORY_TIME_STEP) within the range from time 0 seconds at point 0 to 0.1 s (TRAJECTORY_TIME_STEP) × (51 (NUM_POINTS_OF_TRAJECTORY) - 1) ahead.
    「目標トラジェクトリ」は、0点目（時刻0秒）から 0.1 s (TRAJECTORY_TIME_STEP) × (51 (NUM_POINTS_OF_TRAJECTORY) - 1) 秒先までを 0.1 s (TRAJECTORY_TIME_STEP) 間隔でサンプリングした 51 (NUM_POINTS_OF_TRAJECTORY) 点の点列であること。

SWRD-PnP-LK-12_SP_3

  • The trajectory shall be expressed in the coordinates of the ego vehicle's rear axle center, and the timestamp of the ego vehicle position shall be the timestamp of the trajectory.
    トラジェクトリは自車の後輪軸中心座標で表現されており、その自車位置の時刻情報がトラジェクトリの時刻情報となっていること
fields.rationale$592:
• To comply with the design assumptions of the downstream controller, maintain design consistency across the entire system, and prevent vehicle behavior instability or unexpected operation. Additionally, constraint violations are subject to checks by the trajectory checker, and violations lead to reduced availability.
    後段コントローラーの設計前提を遵守し、システム全体の設計整合性を保ち、車両挙動の不安定化や予期せぬ動作を防ぐため。また、制約逸脱はトラジェクトリチェッカーでのチェック対象となり、逸脱時はアベイラビリティ低下を招くため。

CA Git Requirement v2.2.0

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits
fields.description:
Description

  • The requirement for the SP is to target the interval from t0 to t22 within the sampling range.
    SPに記載されている機能要件の速度プランは 0.0秒 ～ 2.2秒 (*1) までの区間におけるサンプリング値を対象とする。

    • (*1) Refer to headway time setting in ISO 15622, Section 6.2.3.1.
      (*1) ISO15622 6.2.3.1項における車間時間設定を参照

  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the Appendix.
    本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：Definition_of_Common_equations"に定義されたものとする。

Physical quantity Symbol
Sampling time tn
Target trajectory speed value vn
Acceleration an
Jerk jn

  • In this SWRD, the target trajectory contains a time-series dataset of planned ego vehicle speeds at each sampling time as the vehicle travels along the predicted path.
    本SWRDにおける目標トラジェクトリは、車両が予測経路上を移動する際の各サンプリング時刻ごとに計画された自車速度の時系列データを持つ。

  • Sampling starts at time t0​ (index 0) and continues at intervals of Δt, recording the target trajectory speed values vn corresponding to each sampling time tn​ within the range 0.0 to 5.0 seconds.
    サンプリングはサンプリング番号 0 の時刻 t0​ からサンプリング間隔 Δt ごとに実施し、各サンプリング時刻 tn​（0.0秒〜5.0秒）における目標トラジェクトリの速度値 vn​ を格納する。

Interface

IN

  • Ego vehicle speed
    自車速度

  • Ego vehicle acceleration
    自車加速度

  • Set speed
    設定車速

OUT

  • Target trajectory
    目標トラジェクトリ

Specification

SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits_SP_1

  • The minimum acceleration threshold for each speed vn​ is defined as follows, and the measured average acceleration an​ shall not be less than this threshold.
    各速度 vn​ における最小加速度閾値 alimit_min(v) は以下の通り定義し、加速度 an​ がこの閾値を下回らない速度プランであること。

SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits_SP_2

  • The maximum acceleration threshold alimit_max(v) for each speed vn​ is defined as follows, and the measured average acceleration an​ shall not exceed this threshold.
    各速度 vn​ における最大加速度閾値 alimit_max(v) は以下の通り定義し、加速度 an​ がこの閾値を上回らない速度プランであること。

SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits_SP_3

  • The minimum jerk threshold jlimit_min(v) for each speed vn​ is defined as follows, and the measured average jerk jn​ shall not be less than this threshold.
    各速度 vn​ における最小ジャーク閾値 jlimit_min(v) は以下の通り定義し、ジャーク jn がこの閾値を下回らない速度プランであること。
fields.rationale$592:
• To ensure that acceleration and jerk remain within acceptable limits.
    加速度、ジャークが許容範囲を超えないようにするため。
  • Each threshold shall comply with ISO15622.
    各閾値はISO15622に準拠する。

LINK:

CA Git Requirement vf.v2.3.0

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-CSpm_CorneringSpeedManagement_0001
fields.description:
Description

  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the Appendix.
    本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：Definition_of_Common_equations"に定義されたものとする。
Physical quantity Symbol
Sampling time tn
Target trajectory speed value vn
Lateral acceleration alat,n
Path curvature κn

  • In this SWRD, the target trajectory contains a time-series dataset of planned ego vehicle speeds at each sampling time as the vehicle travels along the predicted path.
    本SWRDにおける目標トラジェクトリは、車両が予測経路上を移動する際の各サンプリング時刻ごとに計画された自車速度の時系列データを持つ。

  • The target trajectory speed targeted by this requirement is defined at intervals of Δt from the time t0 corresponding to sampling index 0 up to 5.0 seconds ahead, and stores the velocity value vn​ at each sampling time tn.
    本要件で対象とする目標トラジェクトリの速度は、サンプリング番号 0 に対応する時刻 t0​ を起点とし、サンプリング間隔 ΔtΔt ごとに 5.0 秒先まで定義され、各サンプリング時刻 tn​ における速度値 vn​ を格納するものとする。

  • This requirement satisfies the function in UN R171, Section 5.3.7.
    本要件は UN_R171 5.3.7項 における機能を満たすものである。

Interface

IN

  • Ego vehicle speed
    自車速度

  • Ego vehicle acceleration
    自車加速度

  • Set speed
    設定車速

  • Curvature information
    曲率情報

OUT

  • Target trajectory
    目標トラジェクトリ

Specification

SWRD-PnP-VF-CSpm_CorneringSpeedManagement_0001_SP_1

  • When the path curvature κn​ is greater than or equal to 1/3000 m⁻¹, the target trajectory speed shall be such that the lateral acceleration alat,n​ at each point in the time series does not exceed 3.0 m/s², in accordance with the path curvature κn​.
    経路曲率 κn​ が 1/3000 m⁻¹ 以上の場合、時系列の各点における横加速度 alat,n​ が、経路曲率 κn​ に応じて 3.0 m/s² 以下となる目標トラジェクトリの速度であること。

  • The above maximum value shall be configurable and subject to change.
    上記の最大値は後から変更可能なものとする。
fields.rationale$592:
• To assist the driver in traveling at an appropriate vehicle speed adapted to the path curvature.
    経路の曲率に応じて適切な自車速度で走行できるよう、ドライバーの運転を支援するため。

vn​ [m/s] : Ego vehicle speed at sampling time n

jn​ [m/s³] : Jerk at sampling time n

an​ [m/s²] : Ego vehicle acceleration at sampling time n

各サンプリング時刻における相対速度 vrel,n​ [km/h] は下記で定義する。

Specification

SWRD-PnP-LK-9_SP_1

    下記のフローチャートに従って、「レーントポロジー乖離状態」を出力する

† For example, in the case of a three-lane road where only two lanes are recognized due to occlusion or similar factors, and the lane marking of the occluded lane is a dashed line, the number of lanes in "recognition lane information" shall be regarded as "three or more lanes."
