fields.name: Minimum Speed
fields.description: The Lane Keep feature shall operate at speeds over 10kph.

fields.name: ODD general
fields.description: The system shall maintain lane centering in H‑LK‑1 across expressway/urban‑expressway roads within SBRD ODD, with lane width 2.5–5.0 m and explicit support for Wide Lane (> 5.0 m) including width transitions (H‑LK‑1‑4‑1/‑4‑2)

fields.name: Lane Width
fields.description: The Lane Keep shall operated in lanes with width 2.5–5.0 m, and explicitly include the “wide lane” sub‑scenario (> 5.0 m).

fields.name: Road type
fields.description: The Lane Keep shall operate in roadway curvature from radius ≥ 40 m to straight, with sub‑scenario coverage for Curve (< 300 m for ≥ 5 s) and S‑curve (< 600 m).

fields.name: Speed range
fields.description: The Lane Keep shall operate in speed ranges of 0–140 km/h (Category 1) and 0–200 km/h (Category 2); scenario search requires ego > 5 km/h for Lane Keep intervals

fields.name: Road Slope
fields.description: The Lane Keep shall operate in road slope up to longitudinal ±12% (Cat 1)/±15–18% (Cat 2) and transverse ±5% (Cat 1)/±9% (Cat 2)

fields.name: Comfort
fields.description: The Lane Keep ODD shall include dynamic comfort limits such that lateral acceleration remains within ~3.0 m/s² during operation, aligned to ON/OFF performance checks

fields.name: Lane Keep general
fields.description: The system shall maintain lane centering such that lateral deviation and offsets meet Category‑specific Lane Keep criteria in straight and curved segments (e.g., specified X1/X2 ranges, inner/outer offset bands).

fields.name: Limit Wobble
fields.description: The system shall limit wobble (visual) within the prescribed amplitude‑frequency envelope and limit steer‑busy behavior per banded steering activity criteria.

fields.name: Cut-in
fields.description: The system shall tolerate the presence of a lead agent during Lane Keep (no cut‑in) and maintain centering, including when a lead vehicle decelerates on a curve, with Lane Keep criteria unchanged.

fields.name: Disappearing lane marker
fields.description: The system shall degrade gracefully when lane markers temporarily disappear, following the SBRD “lane markers disappeared” scenario behavior and limits.

fields.name: S-Curve
fields.description: The system shall maintain lane centering performance in Euro NCAP AD S‑Curve style path changes per the SBRD steering‑assist capability scenario and associated traceability checks.

fields.name: H‑LK‑1 Lane Keep (Parent)
fields.description:
The system shall keep ego between lane markers/road edges, with ego > 5 km/h, and no cut‑in during the Lane Keep interval; lead agent presence is allowed.
Verification shall use curated SBRD scenes available in the SBRD tree; pass/fail is determined via the standard Lane Keep KPIs (deviation/offset, wobble, steer‑busy) in Mosaic.

fields.name: H‑LK‑1‑1 Lane Keep, Curve
fields.description: The system shall maintain Lane Keep criteria on curves with consistent radius < 300 m for ≥ 5 s, meeting lateral offset/visual wobble/steer‑busy thresholds.

fields.name: H‑LK‑1‑2 Lane Keep, S‑curve
fields.description: The system shall maintain Lane Keep criteria on S‑curves (≥ 2 consecutive curves, change of curvature sign) with radius < 600 m, meeting the same thresholds.

fields.name: H‑LK‑1‑3 Lane Keep, Lane Markers Disappeared
fields.description: The system shall maintain Lane Keep KPIs when lane markers are temporarily absent (H‑LK‑1‑3), with scenario search/QA prioritizing branch/merge openings as primary cases of marker ambiguity; general faded/unpainted segments are secondary.

fields.name: H‑LK‑1‑4 Lane Keep, Wide Lane
fields.description:
The system shall keep lane in wide lanes (> 5.0 m) and handle width transitions (narrower/wider) per sub‑scenarios H‑LK‑1‑4‑1/‑4‑2 while meeting Lane Keep criteria.
Verification shall use curated SBRD scenes available in the SBRD tree; pass/fail is determined via the standard Lane Keep KPIs (deviation/offset, wobble, steer‑busy) in Mosaic.

fields.name: H‑LK‑1‑5/‑6/‑7/‑8/‑9 Lane Keep variants
fields.description: The system shall meet Lane Keep criteria during lane shift, cross‑traffic lane shift, full closure pass, toll‑gate pass, and return‑to‑lane scenarios

fields.name: Minimum Deviation from Centerline Straight Road
fields.description:
When on a straight road, the woven system shall maintain the centerline of the ego vehicle over the centerline of the lane. A distance of 0.20 meters deviation shall be maintained at least 90% of the time.

 

A straight road is defined as a road with a radius of more than 300 meters.

fields.name: Maximum Deviation from Centerline Straight Road
fields.description:
When on a straight road, the woven system shall maintain the centerline of the ego vehicle over the centerline of the lane. A distance of 0.40 meters deviation shall be maintained 99% of the time.

 

A straight road is defined as a road with a radius of more than 300 meters.

fields.name: Minimum Deviation from Centerline Curved Road
fields.description:
When on a curved road, the woven system shall maintain the centerline of the ego vehicle over the centerline of the lane. A distance of 0.20 meters deviation from the outer most wheels and 0.3 meters from the inner most wheels shall be maintained at least 90% of the time.

 

A curved road is defined as a road with a radius of less than 300 meters.

fields.name: Maximum Deviation from Centerline Curved Road
fields.description:
When on a curved road, the woven system shall maintain the centerline of the ego vehicle over the centerline of the lane. A distance of 0.40 meters deviation from the outer most wheels and 0.5 meters from the inner most wheels shall be maintained at least 99% of the time.

 

A curved road is defined as a road with a radius of less than 300 meters.

fields.name: Wobble
fields.description:
The Woven System shall maintain an amplitude of >= x 85% of the time. 

 

x = coef1*frequency(hz)^coef2

 

  • Vehicle speed ≥ 80kph

    • coef1 = 0.0033 + (0.0041 - 0.0033)/(100 - 80)*(vehicle speed - 80)

    • coef2 = -1.928 + (-2.086 + 1.928)/(100 - 80)*(vehicle speed - 80)

  • Vehicle speed < 80kph

    • coef1 = 0.0031 + (0.0033 - 0.0031)/(80 - 60)*(vehicle speed - 60)

coef2 = -1.852 + (-1.928 + 1.852)/(80 - 60)*(vehicle speed - 60)

fields.name: Variable Lateral Offset Return to Centerline
fields.description: If the woven system is biasing the ego vehicle due to surrounding actors, the ego vehicle shall return the vehicle to the centerline of the lane within 5 seconds after the ego's rear bumper fully passes the entirely of the VLO target.

fields.name: Variable Lateral Offset Thresholds
fields.description:
In the event that a target in an adjacent lane is less than 1.35m from the closet point on the ego vehicle to the closest point of the ado vehicle in the target lane, the woven system shall perform a lateral offset. 

The minimum distance the woven system shall allow between the side of the vehicle and the edge of a lane line is 0.1 meters.

fields.name: OLLR – HHB – Mateo Valley
fields.description:
The OLLR regression test shall be executed on every DRB / Flywheel release candidate.

For each Mateo Valley OLLR input tlog that has explicit HHB allowances in the OLLR grading script, the test output shall verify that the number of HHBs of each type does not exceed the configured per‑tlog limits:

  • ip607/D_20250911_165753/d004-607_ip20250902_3_0_Mateo_Valley_Scrimmage_APR_2

    • corridor_violation ≤ 1

  • ip605/D_20250806_171541/d002-605_ip20250727_1_0_MATEO_VALLEY_SCRIMMAGE_APR

    • drivable_area_violation ≤ 2
    • delayed_message ≤ 2

Any HHB failure type on these Mateo Valley tlogs that is not listed above, or any listed type whose count exceeds its allowance, shall cause the OLLR gate to be marked INVESTIGATE or FAIL for that release candidate.

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-1-DistanceToObjects [DONE]
fields.description:
"always distance_to_closest_agent > 0.0 or collision_window_mask == 0"

 

The system shall satisfy C-1 Distance to Objects: during any evaluation window indicated by collision_window_mask = 1, the ego vehicle shall maintain a strictly positive distance to the closest agent, i.e., distance_to_closest_agent > 0.0 whenever collision_window_mask = 1; distances less than or equal to 0.0 outside this window (collision_window_mask = 0) are not considered a violation.

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-2-MaxAccelerationJerk [DONE]
fields.description:
"let stopped = as_signal(ego_longitudinal_vel < 0.45);

let violated_jerk_when_stopped = as_signal(stopped == 1 and ego_longitudinal_jerk > 4.5);

let violated_jerk_when_not_stopped = as_signal(stopped == 0 and ego_longitudinal_jerk > 1.4);

let violated_jerk = as_signal(violated_jerk_when_stopped==1 or violated_jerk_when_not_stopped==1);

always violated_jerk == 0 or evaluation_window_mask == 0"

 

  • Treat the ego as stopped when longitudinal speed < 0.45.
    • If stopped, jerk must be ≤ 4.5.
    • If moving, jerk must be ≤ 1.4.
  • During the evaluation window, jerk must never exceed those thresholds; otherwise the criterion fails.

The system shall satisfy C-2 Max Acceleration Jerk: During any evaluation window indicated by evaluation_window_mask = 1, ego_longitudinal_jerk shall not exceed 4.5 when the ego vehicle is stopped (ego_longitudinal_vel < 0.45) and shall not exceed 1.4 when the ego vehicle is moving (ego_longitudinal_vel ≥ 0.45); jerk violations outside this window are not considered a violation.

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-2-MaxLateralAcceleration [DONE]
fields.description:
"always ego_lateral_acc abs <= 3.0 or evaluation_window_mask == 0"
 

The system shall satisfy Max Lateral Acceleration: during any evaluation window indicated by evaluation_window_mask = 1, the magnitude of the ego vehicle’s lateral acceleration shall not exceed 3.0 m/s², i.e., abs(ego_lateral_acc) ≤ 3.0 whenever evaluation_window_mask = 1; values of abs(ego_lateral_acc) greater than 3.0 when evaluation_window_mask = 0 are not considered a violation.

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-2-MaxDeceleration [DONE]
fields.description:
"always (sbrd_max_allowable_long_decel - ego_forward_acc) < 0 or evaluation_window_mask == 0"


The system shall satisfy C-2-MaxDeceleration: During any period where evaluation_window_mask = 1, the ego vehicle’s forward acceleration shall not exceed the maximum allowable deceleration, i.e. ego_forward_acc ≥ sbrd_max_allowable_long_decel must hold at all times. If, at any point within the evaluation window, ego_forward_acc becomes more negative than sbrd_max_allowable_long_decel (braking stronger than the allowable limit), the C-2 Max Deceleration criterion shall be considered failed.

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-2-MaxDecelerationJerk [DONE]
fields.description:
"always (sbrd_max_allowable_long_decel_jerk - ego_longitudinal_jerk) < 0 or evaluation_window_mask == 0"

 

The system shall satisfy C-2 Max Deceleration Jerk: during any evaluation window indicated by evaluation_window_mask = 1, the ego vehicle’s longitudinal deceleration jerk shall never exceed the specified comfort threshold, i.e., the quantity (sbrd_max_allowable_long_decel_jerk - ego_longitudinal_jerk) shall remain strictly less than 0 whenever evaluation_window_mask = 1; violations of this condition outside the evaluation window (evaluation_window_mask = 0) are not considered a failure.

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-2-MinTTCToLeadAgent [DONE]
fields.description:
"always ttc_to_lead_agent > 1.43 or collision_window_mask==0"

 

The system shall satisfy Min TTC to Lead Agent Violation: during any evaluation window indicated by collision_window_mask = 1, the time-to-collision to the lead agent shall remain strictly greater than 1.43 s, i.e., ttc_to_lead_agent > 1.43 whenever collision_window_mask = 1; violations outside this window (collision_window_mask = 0) are not considered a failure.

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-4-HandbackFromSystem [DONE]
fields.description:
"always hard_handback == 0 or hard_handback_window_mask == 0"


The system shall satisfy C-4 Handback from system: During any evaluation window indicated by hard_handback_window_mask = 1, hard_handback shall remain 0; hard handbacks outside this window are not considered a violation

fields.name: SR-SBRD-C-5-LaneDepartureMIDAS [DONE]
fields.description:
"let departure_status = as_signal(right_lane_departure_status_midas == 0 and left_lane_departure_status_midas == 0)"

 

The system shall satisfy C-5 Lane Departure MIDAS: during any evaluation window indicated by evaluation_window_mask = 1, the ego vehicle shall not depart its lane as measured by MIDAS, i.e., right_lane_departure_status_midas and left_lane_departure_status_midas shall both remain 0; lane departures outside this window are not considered a violation

fields.name: Minimum Speed Condition for Lane Change at Sensor Detection Boundary
fields.description:
If there is no ado vehicle detected behind the ego vehicle, the ego vehicle shall initiate a lane change maneuver only when the following condition is satisfied:

The ego vehicle is assumed that the approaching vehicle is at the outer edge of the perception boundary, travelling at a speed equal to 10% above the maximum permissible speed for the road segment. The sensor detection boundary is defined as 90 meters from the side. 

  • Vego: Ego vehicle speed in meters per second (m/s).

  • Vado: Speed of approaching vehicle in the target path, assumed to be 10% greater than the speed limit of the road, in accordance with UN-R171; Va = 1.1 × SpeedLimit.

  • R: Furthest rear-facing sensor detection range in metres (m)

  • Amax = reasonable braking deceleration, assumed to be 3m/s2 according to UN regulations.
fields.rationale$136:
Formula derivation: 

UN R-171 accepted formula uses the braking-distance model D = v^2 / 2*a.

The accepted UN formula is to assume that ego is traveling at the speed limit prior to making a lane change. This doesn’t make sense for our urban applications so we’ll bound ourselves further setting V = the delta between our 110% over speed limit and our ego speed. 

Source

fields.name: Minimum Speed Condition for LC with Detected Rear Ado
fields.description:
Given that a rear ADO is detected in the target lane, the Ego vehicle shall initiate the lane change maneuver only when the longitudinal distance between the front bumper of the ADO and the rear bumper of the Ego vehicle is greater than dmin, where:

 

AV: Autonomous Vehicle (Ego vehicle)

SFV: Side Follow Vehicle in target lane (ADO vehicle)

 

The following assumptions apply:

  1. Reaction time of SFV driver from the moment AV begins crossing the lane boundary taken from UN-R79.

tb = 0.4 sec

  1. Remaining time gap between SFV and AV as specified in UN-R79.

tGap = 1 sec

  1. Comfortable deceleration of SFV as specified in UN-R79.

aSFV = -3 m/s2

  1. Dmargin = max (4.5m; ADO THW: 3 seconds)

 

Notes: 

  1. Formula provided on HSR9a: Longitudinal distance to rear ado vehicles in target lane.

  2. Minimum value of 4.5 m for D margin represents the approximate length of one passenger vehicle. RAV4 is used as a reference.
fields.rationale$136:
UN Regulation No. 171 (2022) defines the broad permissible speed boundaries for automated lane change functions. While these regulatory limits establish maximum allowable speeds, Woven’s ODD specifies a lower maximum speed of 112 km/h (70 mph), compared to the 130 km/h (80 mph) permitted under UN R‑171. This difference necessitates the definition of Woven-specific speed boundaries for lane change operation, ensuring alignment with the current ODD. 

The minimum speed threshold for lane changes must also account for scenarios where a fast-approaching ado is initially beyond the ego vehicle’s perception range. This consideration ensures the ego maintains a safe maneuvering margin by applying the assumed ado parameters described above — specifically, treating such vehicles as traveling 10% faster than the maximum road speed, as regulated in UN 171 -2022. 

When there is another ado vehicle in the scenario, we no longer need to rely on assumptions since we know the speed and position of the ado. The calculation for gap between ado in target lane and ego shall be the same as the HSR used when releasing a feature, but more strict to adhere to a more comfortable driving experience. The minimum gap required is the approximate length of one passenger vehicle, in this case the RAV4. The time to headway is 3 seconds, which is the estimated gap suggested by the California drivers education course.

fields.name: Maximum Speed for LC Condition
fields.description: The ego vehicle shall initiate a lane change only when Ve is less than or equal to 130 km/h, in accordance with the lane change speed limit defined in UN Regulation No. 171 (2022), or the maximum speed limit of the current Woven operational ODD, whichever is lower.

fields.name: VULCMN_00100
fields.description:
The ECU shall use the cryptographic algorithm listed in "FIPS", "SP800-140C", or "SP800-140D", and whose Status is Final.(*1) *1)Status is "Withdrawn", "Draft" should not be selected.

In addition, based on "SP800-57", the cryptographic algorithm to be used and the key length should decide that the security strength satisfies 128 bits or more.

 

(Supplement) Below, the key length that is 128 bit security strength for typical common key cryptography, public key cryptography, and MAC is shown. ・Common key cryptography：AES/128bit ・Public key cryptography：RSA/3072bit, ECDSA/256bit, ECDH/256bit ・MAC：AES-CMAC/128bit In addition, a typical hash function 128bit security strength is shown below. ・Hash function：SHA256

 

Reasons: When using an original algorithm, although it has the same key length having the substantially same encryption strength, it can be potentially inferior to others. The use of widely accepted standards is also required for "WP29", it is necessary to use encryption algorithms that have been under scrutiny of security specialists. The encryption algorithm being free of vulnerabilities is the prerequisite of security functions.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is ECU level requirement, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: VULCMN_03600
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The same cryptographic key shall not be used for multiple purposes in cryptographic processes.

 

Reasons

 

Uses of the same cryptographic key for multiple purposes raise concerns about the possibility of the leakage of cryptographic key and the spread of effects when it is leaked.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: Cryptographic keys are defined and managed by the OEM and/or Platform ECU level; WbyT does not define cryptographic keys.

fields.name: VULCMN_50100
fields.description: This requirement should be implemented when applying VULCMN_00100. The ECU designer shall perform a test (*) equivalent to the known answer test (AESAVS if the encryption algorithm is AES) described in the test vector published by CAVP, to demonstrate that the encryption algorithm is implemented correctly. *) When cryptographic module supplied from the vendor is used, either of the followings shall be carried out. - Receive the result of a CAVP-equivalent test performed from the vendor. - Perform a CAVP-equivalent test for the cryptographic module.

fields.name: VULCMN_00200
fields.description:
The random number generator shall be satisfied the requirement of the followings (1) or (2).

 

(1): - If the product is equipped with a hardware true random number generator, this generator shall be used (*1). Note that the true random number generator shall comply with AIS31(PTG.2 or PTG.3) . *1) If the output of the hardware true random number generator can not be directly used, the pseudo random number generator may be used with its output as a random number seed. - When using a pseudo random number generator, the requirement values shall be satisfied according to the VC Level shown below (SEE SPECIFICATION DOCUMENT FOR TABLE) in reference to AIS20.

 

(2): The designer shall use pseudo random number generator complied with SP800-90A which is used entropy source output complied with SP800-90B as random number seed. And the pseudo random number generator shall be satisfied followings. - Security strength (*5): 128bit or more (Supplement) Pseudo random number generation algorithm (*5): The algorithm can be adopted one of the Hash_DRBG, HMAC_DRBG or CTR_DRBG. But, in case of CTR_DRBG, block cipher should be used AES. *5) Refer to SP800-90A about Security strength and Pseudo random number generation algorithm.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is ECU level requirement, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: VULCMN_00300
fields.description:
When the random numbers given below are generated, do not use those numbers.

- ALL0 (All bits in the random number bit string are 0.)

- ALL1 (All bits in the random number bit string are 1.)

- Random numbers that match the previous random numbers (*)

(This requirement assumes attacks to random numbers in the field, not during the development phase.)

*) After ECU reset, when the random number is first used, the following may avoid memorizing the random number before the reset. After resetting, the random number is generated twice in a row, and after confirming that the random number generated the second time is different from the random number generated the first time (the previous random number), the second generation random number is used.

Reasons

Attacks that cause generation of same random numbers generate the random numbers described above and they are no longer random.

fields.name: VULCMN_00400
fields.description:
When installing privileged functions except the function permitted by the department responsible for security of Toyota Motor Coporation, the privileged functions shall be removed prior to the shipping of the product. (*1) The privileged functions permitted by the department responsible for security are shown below. -Standard Reprogramming Function -OTA Reprogramming Function But, about privileged functions that are not available via communication from global bus and that are used via wired I/F (the ones which are using connector pins inside the frames of the dotted lines on Fig. 4-1), remaining privileged functions are acceptable if those satisfy the requirements on "4.4.1Countermeasures for Privileged Functions of In-vehicle Parts by Opening (Test Access Port)".

The due date for the countermeasures: By the product shipment on 1A at the latest, the countermeasures described shall be enabled. If it is impossible to remove the privileged functions necessarily with the case except the above, notify the department in charge of the security of Toyota Motor Corporation of the purpose of the privileged functions, security measures, etc. (*2) and obtain an agreement from them. But, in cases that privileged functions of in-vehicle parts without opening are RR6 or less even if communication is spoofed from global bus and that protection measure requirements for CSPs/PSPs(VULCMN_01600 to VULCMN_01900) are satisfied, remaining privileged functions are acceptable without above notification. As a method of achieving RR6 or less, there is a method of prohibiting the operation of the privileged functions of the ECU by using the operation permission condition. Ex) The operation permission condition of privileged functions are set vehicle speed = 0km/h. But the signal which is using to operation permission condition shall be protected from spoofing by followings measures. - Direct lines, Local communication lines, Message authentication

*1) That the privileged functions shall be removed means removing of logics for the privileged functions. A case that removing of connectors as I/F of privileged functions from an in-vehicle part is performed not to enable to use the privileged functions, without removing of the logics, the connector is restored with opening the in-vehicle part, and the privileged functions have potentiality to be exploited. So the case shall satisfy the requirements on "4.4.1 Countermeasures for Privileged Functions of In-vehicle Parts by Opening (Test Access Port)" as well as unavailable privileged functions with communication from global bus.

*2) Information regarding the privileged functions to be notified to the department in charge of security of Toyota Motor Corporation - Names - Purposes - Applications - Risks due to presence of functions in field (assuming exploitation) - Security measures - Security evaluation specifications - Evaluation results Promptly notify the department in charge of the security of Toyota Motor Corporation if it is impossible to remove the privileged functions. However, before notification, confirm that the prohibition condition on the privileged function is not defined, including specifications other than this document E.g. Prohibition condition of ServiceID 0xBA of Phase5 Diagnosis.

fields.name: VULCMN_00500
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"To prevent the privileged functions that can be used without opening the in- vehicle parts placed with a permission obtained by the department in charge of the security from being exploited (*1), disable them prior to the shipping or use access control. Password authentication or C&R authentication shall be used to control accesses. - The password length shall be 128 bits or more. - The password set by string shall contain at least numbers, uppercase letters and lowercase letters, and shall be at least 8 digits in length. - The encryption key used for C&R authentication shall be 128 bits or more. - The encryption algorithm used for C & R authentication shall meet the requirements of VULCMN_00100, and the random numbers shall meet the requirements of VULCMN_00200 and VULCMN_00300. If countermeasure requirements regarding the access control of the privileged functions that can be used without opening the in-vehicle parts more detailed than this document are given in the documents (*4), follow those descriptions. *1) Posing threats (*2) to information assets including CSPs, safety, corporate assets, privacy, etc. *2) Example threats to information assets are: - CSP: Leakage of CSPs - Safety: Tampering of controls and programs of risk level 7 or higher - Corporate assets: Leakage of programs - Privacy: Leakage of personal and privacy information (*3) *3) For personal and privacy information, see "Standards of Personal and Privacy Information" and "Requirements of Personal and Privacy Information". *4) "Constitution of Diagnostics", "Requirements Specification of Standard Reprogramming Security", etc."

 

Reasons

 

To prevent exploitation of privileged functions.

E.g. IG-OFF to IG-ON operation during the authenticated state cancels the authenticated state."

(Supplement) This requirement demands that data accessible by privileged functions be exactly defined. For example, after passing the authentication for diagnostics purposes but before passing the authentication for reprogramming purposes, the data to be used by the reprogramming function is not made accessible."

 

Reasons

 

"If the function for checking some control parameters is capable of reading encryption keys, parties who are not entitled to know encryption keys have access to the encryption keys. Important parameters such as encryption keys that relate to the fundamentals of the security need to be closely controlled. Therefore, it is necessary to clarify the items that should not be read and perform access control appropriate for the purpose."

Reasons

 

"In relation to VULCMN_00800, items that are to be read need to be clearly defined."

fields.name: VULCMN_01000
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The ECU shall not install functions (concealed function) for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation.(*) *) Does not include disabling functions. If off-the-shelf products already install functions (concealed function) for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation, logics for the functions shall be removed. If it is unavoidable to install functions (concealed function) for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation in the ECU, the functions shall satisfy the security requirements and obtain an agreement from the department in charge of system (each design department) and the department in charge of part (each design department). E.g. Software used during only the development phase, inspection software, and other unnecessary software shall not be installed in production parts.

 

Reasons

 

If a function that has not been approved by Toyota Motor Corporation and that may lead to backdoor remains in the market product, it can be used by attackers to access data that are normally not available to them. Excess functions may be potentially exploited by attackers.

E.g. Abnormal operation is not made even though the actual data length does not match the specified data length during a diagnostics or the like. (Anomaly process is carried out.)"

 

Reasons

 

There are attacks that involve making abnormal inputs and observing the behavior to analyze the processing and that involve causing abnormal operations and making outputs outside the scope of specification.

fields.name: VULCMN_01200
fields.description:
Requirements

 

To reduce vulnerabilities of software, for all software in ECU, the coding rules given below shall be applied. - C language: MISRA-C and CERT-C shall be applied in accordance with TSC7030G (C language coding standard for software embedded in in-vehicle electric/electronic parts). - C++ language: MISRA-C ++, AUTOSAR C ++ 14 and CERT-C ++ shall be applied in accordance with TSC7047G (C++ language coding standard for software embedded in in-vehicle electric/electronic parts). - Languages other than C language, and C++ language: Secure coding rules appropriate for each language shall be complied. E.g. ISO/IEC TR 24772, CERT-JAVA, CERT-Perl And, the legacy software, the automatically generated code of model-based development and the external procurement software shall support secure coding in the following table.

*1) You may check the codes using a static program analysis tool that enables secure coding checks(*2), and then fix only deviations from the coding rule that are not acceptable from security perspectives(*3).

*2) Receiving the verification result from a software vendor and confirming the result are acceptable.

*3) Confirm posing threats (*4) to information assets including CSPs, safety, corporate assets, privacy, etc.

*4) Example threats to information assets are: - CSP: Leakage of CSPs - Safety: Tampering of controls and programs of risk level 7 or higher - Corporate assets: Leakage of programs - Privacy: Leakage of personal and privacy information (*5)

*5) For personal and privacy information, see "Standards of Personal and Privacy Information" and "Requirements of Personal and Privacy Information".

Discuss whether measures are necessary among the department in charge of the system (each design department), the department in charge of the part (each design department), the department in charge of the coding (PQF), the department in charge of the security (issuing dept. of this document), and the supplier.

 

Reasons

 

Reduce vulnerabilities by performing coding in accordance with the rules.

fields.name: VULCMN_01700
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"CSPs shall be stored in secured memory (*). *) Secured memory - Memory with limited access from outside ("Read" and "Write") - Memory which permits access to specific tasks - Memory which can be accessed by only directly processing unit in HSM If the protected data is PSP, store it in memory with limited "Write" ("Read" may not be limited, storing in memory which can be accessed by only directly processing unit in HSM is not required)."

 

Reasons

 

"It is necessary that CSPs are stored in a memory with at least limited access ("Read"and"Write") from outside (privileged functions such as diagnostics function, JTAG and other microcontroller-level privileged functions) (For PSPs, "Write" restri ctions.). When assuming higher-level attacks such as software hijacking, it is also necessary to limit access from the CPU."

fields.name: VULCMN_01701
fields.description:
Requirements

 

When storing CSPs in a memory of the microcontroller, access from outside ("Read"and"Write") shall be limited to prevent direct reading and writing from outside. The design shall permit read and write of specific functions only. When storing PSPs in a memory of the microcontroller, "Write" from outside shall be limited. (Read may not be restricted.) When storing the CSPs in the external memory of the microcontroller necessarily, encrypt them and carry out tampering detection (signature verification) for them. When storing PSPs in the external memory of the microcontroller necessarily, tampering detection for them shall be implemented. (Encryption may not be implemented) - VL1:The encryption keys to be used for encryption and tampering detection may be shared among the same part no. - VL2,VL3:The encryption keys to be used for encryption and tampering detection don't affect other vehicles in case of leakage. Protection of the above encryption keys to be used for encryption or tampering detection shall be satisfied requirement VULCMN_01702. E.g. - Separate encryption key is established for each in-vehicle part (each serial no.). - Alternatively, use a public key.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is ECU level requirement, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: VULCMN_01702
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The ECU shall have HSM, and only the processing unit in HSM shall be able to access CSPs and PSPs directly. However, session keys for the purpose of processing the generation, updating, and using CSP are excluded from this requirement and shall satisfy VULCMN_01701. In that case, the CSP shall be deleted from the memory immediately after the processing is completed. Example of deleting) Overwrite the CSP in the memory with zero. When storing PSPs in a memory of the microcontroller necessarily, "Write" from outside shall be limited by using hardware function. When storing PSPs in the external memory of the microcontroller necessarily, PSPs shall be stored in a tamper-detectable state (MAC or signed state) in memory. In addition, only the processing unit in HSM shall be able to access the key to be used for tampering detection directly.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is ECU level requirement, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

Reasons

 

"Whe n distributing a CSP or PSP, it is necessary to maintain the confidentiality and integrity with use of encryption or MAC to prevent the CSPs from being leaked or tampered(For PSPs, to prevent tampering)."

Sensitive personal information: (For detail, refer to related document[7]) Examples: - Personal identification information: ID cards, driver's licenses, personal account system accounts (including passwords)" "- Personal biometric information: genetic information, fingerprints, voiceprints, palm prints, ear shapes, iris patterns, facial features, etc. - Personal asset information: virtual assets, risk assessment records, asset information, credit records, etc. - Personal communication information: communication records and content, etc. - Contact information: address books, friend lists, group lists, etc. - Personal application operation information: website browsing history, etc. - Personal location information: movement trajectories, precise location data, longitude and latitude, etc. - Other information: personal audio, video, image data, etc."

 

Reasons

 

China GB 7.4.2

fields.name: VULCMN_02500
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"To prevent the privileged function (test access port) which can be used by opening the in-vehicle part from being exploited, the function shall be disabled prior to the shipping of the product or access control shall be implemented. As the access control means, password authentication or C&R authentication shall be used. - The password length shall be 128 bits or more. - The password set by string shall contain at least numbers, uppercase letters and lowercase letters, and shall be at least 8 digits in length. - The encryption key used for C&R authentication shall be 128 bits or more. - The encryption algorithm used for C&R authentication shall meet the requirements of VULCMN_00100, and the random numbers shall meet the requirements of VULCMN_00200 and VULCMN_00300. The due date for the countermeasures: By the product shipment on 1A at the latest, the countermeasures described shall be enabled."

 

Reasons

 

"When using privileged functions, it is necessary to prevent exploitations with use of authentication."

fields.name: SWE-DRIVE-397-SWSM
fields.description:
NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX Cybersecurity Manual

Version: 1.0 DRIVE OS 6.5.2

 

Received from Hidetoshi Kobayashi (Denso)

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1110
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall abide by the principle of least privilege when configuring IPC channels of their user processes without disturbing the existing configuration of IPC channels used by DRIVE OS.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level IPC configuration setup that is similar with VULCMN_02300, to achieve this, DN need to setup the configuration file.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1123
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall ensure that spurious interrupts are not generated by ensuring that the hardware is sufficiently protected against physical tampering.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is only realized by DN as it can be realized with setuping up HW dependencies

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1124
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure the following:
i. The GMSL serializer to deserializer bus shall be encrypted at application layer to protect the media signal that passes through it.
ii. The GMSL bus is protected against physical attacks.
iii. The GPIOs powering the HDMI serializer are configured correctly to prevent any unauthorized access to the serializer.
iv. The HDMI signal between Orin and serializer on the board shall be protected against physical tampering that compromises the confidentiality and integrity of the signal.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.
Same logic with above, only Dn can realize this requirement as per the dependey to external world

fields.name: FSI_RES_051
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall place the PTP timestamp (data segment) either in FSI SRAM (protected by firewall register), TCM (protected by firewall register) or FSI carveout (protected by GSC settings).
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.
Only DN can realize this requirement with the dependency to SRAM,TCM,GSC settings.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_137
fields.description: It is assumed the user of DRIVE OS will protect the I2C bus against physical attack. The I2C bus can be physically tampered with to corrupt the transferred camera data (configuration data, error information) causing malfunction of the system. A tampered or misbehaving program using the same bus can also saturate or hold the shared I2C bus for a longer time causing Denial-of-Service attacks.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup with dependency to other IF, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1117
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that appropriate confidentiality and integrity protections are used at the application layer prior to transmitting sensitive data across the PCIe bus between multiple Orin SoCs.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup with dependency to other IFs, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: BSP_RES_042
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must limit the use of MNAND core library interface (APIs in headers nvmnand.h and nvmnand_ufs.h) only to privileged processes using Access Control provided by the interface and take measures to prevent race conditions between the commands issues by different processes using the interface.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup with dependency to others, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1142
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the recorded camera frames being stored in in eMMC flash are protected against tampering by applying appropriate integrity protection mechanisms on the stored frames.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1143
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall implement a data authentication solution for writeable file systems such as QNX DataFs to protect against tampering with the file systems on the storage media. If data confidentiality is required, the user shall consider using an authenticated encryption scheme.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1144
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that any sensitive data such as PII is encrypted before storing it on the non-volatile storage device.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: SW Application level requirement for PII.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1145
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall set the priority of the storage server to the priority of the QNX VM and rate limit the execution of the storage server to mitigate the risk of operational loss.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1146
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall protect the integrity of sensitive data stored in external non-volatile memory using cryptographic integrity measures.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_129
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will ensure eMMC usage such that the total number of program/erase cycles that are foreseen over the entire life of the system/ECU doesn't exceed its allowed program/erase cycles as stated in eMMC documentation.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1016
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall remove UART Device Drivers from the Virtual Machines in production builds to reduce the risk of code reuse attacks that leverage a UART based shell.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1017
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that all debug interfaces (like JTAG) in Orin and the Safety MCU applications are disabled before releasing the ECU into the production environment to prevent attackers from gaining unauthorized access to control functions and data of the ECU. Where disabling certain interfaces is not possible, a cryptographic based locking mechanism shall be deployed to authenticate external clients prior to granting access. Additionally ECID based mechanisms that pin a debug image to a specific chip can also be considered.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup with dependency to other IF, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1018
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that granted Debug access is terminated within the intended expiration period to prevent Debug access misuse.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup with dependency to other IF, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1140
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the decommissioning sequence includes the secure erasure of all private data and user cryptographic secrets.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup to be realized, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1141
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall control access to DRIVE OS builds containing a debug overlay software during the development, production, and post production phases. Additionally, after the debug is no longer needed, the systems shall be either reprogrammed with a production build or the device must be scrapped.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level setup to be realized, WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1029
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that a service authentication mechanism is in place to authorize any DRIVE OS internal service that requests a reboot or shutdown. Additionally, the user of DRIVE OS shall implement plausibility checks on the system state before performing the state transition to mitigate the safety impact of an unauthorized reboot/shutdown request.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level realized requirement, authentication setup can only be done by DN. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1056
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall configure access to Init Group APIs during NvDVMS Operational Mode only for Applications that are allowed to restart during Operational Mode.
Note: Refer to the 'Least Privilege Execution' section of the DRIVE OS 6.0 QNX PDK Developer Guide [2] for information regarding privilege/ability configuration and the 'API Modules' section of the NVIDIA DRIVE OS QNX PDK API Reference [8] for information about API Groups and Required Privileges for specific APIs.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level realized requirement.
This requirement is relevant to QNX security policy/ability/group setup which can be only done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1066
fields.description:
Where the user of DRIVE OS has a process which can execute in OPERATIONAL mode and retains the ability to spawn other processes, the user of DRIVE OS shall impose the following restrictions in the OPERATIONAL mode security policy of such a launcher process:
prohibit the launcher's own access to any ability that is not needed during OPERATIONAL mode restrict the set of processes that the launcher is able to spawn during OPERATIONAL mode to the subset of processes which are able to start during OPERATIONAL mode by the user, using explicit range settings on the settypeid, spawn_setuid, and spawn_setgid abilities of the launcher prohibit the launcher from adding abilities or privileges to itself prohibit the launcher from adding abilities or privileges to spawned processes beyond the subset of abilities and privileges that meets ALL of the following criteria:
ONLY those privileges and abilities that are statically defined in advance by the user for that process, AND ONLY those abilities that are allowed by the DRIVE OS IOLauncher utility, AND NOT those abilities that would allow a process to change its own set of abilities or privileges (e.g. able_priv, setuid, setgid), or those of another process (e.g. xprocess_able)
Note: For endpoint setup, NvIPC requires the ability to add new abilities to client processes. From the above, it follows that NvSciIPCEndpoint configuration cannot be performed during OPERATIONAL mode by a launcher process or by the spawned processes themselves.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level realized reuqirement. The Drive OS integration responsible which is DN needs to consider the operational mode and its relevant configuration.
WbyT is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1026
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall discard any corrupted data plane camera frames upon detection to prevent maliciously crafted camera messages from being injected, replaced, replayed or reordered.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
This requirement is relevant to sensor management/camera. Camera relevant Drive OS reuqirement are all belong to DN. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1027
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that calibration of SoC shutdown sensors used for thermal and voltage monitoring calibration remains immutable after initial configuration to reduce the likelihood of a maliciously triggered shutdown.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
This requirement is relevant to sensor management/camera. Sensor management relevant Drive OS reuqirement are all belong to DN. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1028
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall enable access permission checks for Application Software that configures the SoC thermal and voltage monitoring sensors to prevent unauthorized setup and reconfiguration of such sensors.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
This requirement is relevant to sensor management/camera. Sensor management relevant Drive OS reuqirement are all belong to DN. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1157
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall verify the source and integrity of all data received from the ultrasonic sensor to prevent potential malicious attacks targeting the sensor data.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
This requirement is relevant to sensor management/camera. Sensor management relevant Drive OS reuqirement are all belong to DN. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application level.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1038
fields.description:
Where applicable, the user of DRIVE OS shall ensure the following:
i. the LIN (Local Interconnect Network) interface between the firmware running on Safety MCU and Wetness Sensor shall be protected against unauthorized access
ii. provide a dedicated VLAN for the MCU to Orin communication for any sensor data/configuration that passes from MCU to Orin and vice versa
iii. protect UDP frames that are exchanged between MCU and Orin against tampering and man-in-the middle attack scenarios by using protocols like DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security)
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
This requirement is realized by touching the setup of external lines/frames. This requirement can be only realized by DN.
WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: CSW_REC_010
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall store custom camera device drivers and custom plugin libraries in an authenticated and integrity-protected read-only file system to protect against malicious modification
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is relevant to camera drivers or plugin libs, this file will be integrated into ORIN bin. The requiremnent can be only realized by DN. WbyT is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_132
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will mitigate threats of Camera identity spoofing and Camera frame tampering in camera sensors that lack cryptographic authentication support.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is talking about camera authentication framework. This requirement can not be realized by WbyT as per CA scope. It should be done by DN

fields.name: CSW_ASU_013
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS rotates camera sensor session keys before start (or after stop) of every driving cycle to minimize the risk of cryptographic key leakage through side channel analysis.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is also relevant to Camera interaction for data tx/rx, can only be realized by DN. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: BSP_RES_170
fields.description: To prevent the execution of unauthenticated code from the DataFS, the user of DRIVE OS must mount the underlying DataFS partition such that it does not allow executables to load, i.e., mount the partition with _MOUNT_NOEXEC flag.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is talking about DataFS distribution which is resp of ECU integration. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: BSP_RES_171
fields.description: If using a DataFS partition, the user of DRIVE OS must package the Golden Metadata file of the DataFS partition in the Secondary IFS.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is talking about DataFS distribution which is resp of ECU integration. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1022
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall encrypt files requiring confidentiality protection prior to storing in either the Secondary IFS or data Filesystem to protect against physical exfiltration attacks on the storage media.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement can be only realized by ECU integration which is DN WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1002
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall enable QNX hardening mechanisms by using the following compiler and linker options:
-fpic/-fpie: Randomization of process memory addresses
-Wl,-z,now: Marking executable regions as Read-Only
-fstack-protector-strong: Adding stack canaries in potentially vulnerable functions -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE: To detect out-of-bounds memory accesses by performing lightweight parameter validation at compile time and runtime
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement can be only realized by ECU integration which is DN WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1150
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that ASLR and HW-enforced DEP are enabled for software executing on CCPLEX cores.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement can be only realized by ECU integration which is DN WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: DOS_RES_132
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must not create or delete files used by DRIVE OS processes in the /dev/shmem (/tmp) directory.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is SW Application level requirement. The intention is Drive OS files/categories selfcreation will destory OS security assumption, so WbyT need to take care of it.

fields.name: NET_RES_004
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure all NvSocket clients using the same NvSocket group ID are mutually trusted by each other.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This requirement is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is asking device tree,NvEthMgr,Security policy which can only be done by DN. The distribution resp belong to DN.
WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for how to use NvSocket, this will be pointed out later

fields.name: NET_RES_005
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that the Ethernet and PCIe files in the /tmp folder are exclusively created by legitimate processes before any user processes start, to ensure proper operation of DRIVE OS.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This requirement is Platform/ECU level requirement. It is asking Eth,PCIe file distribution.It can only be realized by DN

fields.name: NET_RES_006
fields.description: The user of Drive OS must ensure that all NvSockets opened are properly closed by calling close() before the program exits, to facilitate the cleanup of the client transmit shared memory.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is SW Application level requirement. The intention is that memory resource leakage can be happen if we do not use close() beforehand

fields.name: NET_RES_007
fields.description: The user of Drive OS must ensure that authentication mechanisms and freshness checks are applied at the Application layer when transmitting and receiving packets using NvSocket, due to the potential threat of IP spoofing.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is SW Application level requirement. The intention is to prevent IP spoofing prevention

fields.name: DOS_ASU_022
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will mount the filesystem containing libraries and executables, as read only. If applicable, the user DRIVE OS will have separate read-write qnx6 Power-Safe filesystem for applications to store data in writable filesystem.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. It is asking for filesystem mounting which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_REC_043
fields.description: If the DRIVE OS user disables the kernel call preemption by using the '-p' kernel option, the DRIVE OS user should manage the risk of a malicious process causing a Denial of Service attack that delays high priority threads in the system.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. The requirement can be only done by DN as per kernel configuration.

fields.name: DOS_REC_044
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should enable the QNX path trust option to limit executable and library loading to the Primary and Secondary IFS. This is necessary to protect against malicious file execution by compromised processes.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This is filesystem integration relevant requirement that can only be done by DN.

fields.name: NVS_REC_038
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that all memory buffers containing sensitive data are cleared and flushed prior to being deallocated to mitigate the risk of sensitive data being accessible.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is SW Application level requirement. The intention is to prevent sensitive data leakage unintentionally

fields.name: DOS_ASU_114
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will follow secure software development practices aimed at minimizing the risk of bug-prone code and flawed applications.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This is ECU integration relevant requirement of security policies which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_136
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will ensure the input buffer sizes conform to the size expectations set by the API, to prevent corruption of DRIVE OS user space applications.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is SW Application level requirement. The intention is to prevent buffer overflow behavior separately

fields.name: DOS_ASU_134
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will check the calibration and configuration data for implausible values prior to use.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This is ECU integration relevant requirement of security policies which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1001
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall launch their processes with resource limits by passing the rlimit option to IOLauncher with the appropriate values.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This is ECU integration relevant requirement of security policies which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1019
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that HW enforced Data Execution Prevention (DEP) is enabled over writable memory regions within the safety microcontroller to prevent execution of arbitrary and malicious code.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This is ECU integration relevant requirement of security policies which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1020
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall configure code segments that are fetched from RAM with read-execute only protection to prevent malicious entities from overwriting the code.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This is ECU configuration relevant requirement of security policies which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1023
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall program the SECURITY_MODE fuse to lock write access to fuse based secrets and critical security parameters after they have been programmed through the production flow to prevent any unauthorized access or tampering.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This is ECU drive OS mode relevant requirement of security policies which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1119
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall protect the Package Signing Private key against replacement and tampering attacks throughout the update lifecycle via HSM or other secure means.
Note: Please consult [NIST Special Publication 800-57 Part 1 Revision 5] for recommendations on managing the private key.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. This requirement is relevant for security key distribution and treated as a part of ECU configuration which can be only done by DN. WbyT AD/ADAS is only responsible for SW Application.

fields.name: FSI_RES_047
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall ensure that the calibration data in FSI carveout that does not change at run time is not writable.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is relevant to calibration data security policy which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: FSI_RES_048
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall ensure that the code section of firmware in FSI carveout is made read only.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is relevant to code security policy which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: FSI_RES_049
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall ensure that the data section of firmware in FSI carveout is marked non-executable
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. This requirement is relevant to data security policy which can only be done by DN.

fields.name: FSI_RES_050
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall be responsible to integrate code/data/calibration data across the different memories available to FSI as per the integration guide. Failure to do so can result in unavailability of functionality.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement.Because integrating FSI code/data/calibration across multiple memories according to the FSI integration guide is an ECU/FSI platform integration task handled by the AUTOSAR/FSI DN.

fields.name: TCFW_REC_002
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should review OEM firewall configurations and verify via integration testing.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement.Because reviewing and validating OEM firewall configurations is a vehicle/network-level platform responsibility handled by the OEM and ECU/network integrators,

fields.name: DOS_RES_137
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall apply either a message authentication code or a digital signature to the MAC address stored in the unsigned section of the BR-BCT to detect tampering in physical storage.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement.Applying MACs or digital signatures to the MAC address in the BR-BCT is a bootloader/flash image security measure implemented by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1120
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the GPIO pin carrying the signal for ECU_ready is protected against physical tampering.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. Protecting the physical ECU_ready GPIO pin against tampering is a hardware/ECU design and packaging responsibility of DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1122
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall enable OEM fuse encryption prior to provisioning the secret keys in fuse arrays during factory programming unless on-target generation of the OEM_KDK0 key is enabled.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level reuqirement. Enabling OEM fuse encryption and provisioning secret keys in fuse arrays during factory programming is a hardware/ECU manufacturing and security provisioning task handled by

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1125
fields.description: It is assumed that the risk of physical tampering with KIST test results in eMMC is within the user's tolerable risk level. It is recommended that the user institutes physical tamper detection of the system enclosure to minimize the risk of KIST test results tampering in eMMC.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Mitigating the physical tampering is a hardware/vehicle security and operational risk decision for the ECU supplier which is DN, not something WbyT's on-vehicle AD/ADAS application

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1126
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall take appropriate measures to protect the GPIO pins on DRIVE OS against physical attack, such as using tamper-resistant enclosures or other physical security measures.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement.Protecting DRIVE OS GPIO pins against physical attack using tamper-resistant enclosures is a hardware ECU supplier task which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1129
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the Safety MCU pin assignment configuration stays immutable after transitioning from the initialization phase.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement.Keeping the Safety MCU pin assignment configuration immutable after initialization is a low-level MCU/ECU hardware and firmware responsibility handled by the platform integrator

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1047
fields.description: OEM shall be able to also sign already NVIDIA signed binaries and/or critical security parameters
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement.This task is relevant to signing chain responsibility of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1030
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall enable mechanisms to support the detection of physical tampering of the system enclosure through usage of tamper detection stickers or other physical measures.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. Enabling mechanism to detect physical tampering means to touch the tamper detection stickers, this task can only be done by ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application can not do anything on it.

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_053
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall protect the following GPIO/I2C pins from physical attack by using tamper detection mechanisms or other physical protection measures.
1. SOC_PWR_ON 2. VM_EN1_N 3. AURIX_SOC_WAKE 4. AURIX_SOC_SPI_CSR 5. ORIN_PWR_REQ_3V3 6. AURIX_SOC_RST 7. SOC_FORCE_RCVR 8. SAFETY_NIRQ 9. FUNC_NIRQ 10. BOOTCHAIN0 11. BOOTCHAIN1 12. IST_REQ 13. IST_DONE 14. SOC_THERM_ALERT 15. SOC_THERM_SHDN 16. I2C0_SCL 17. I2C_SDA
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Physically protecting specific GPIO and I2C pins with tamper-detection is relevant with ECU integrator task which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1048
fields.description: The OEM firmware signing key shall be protected to avoid BR-BCT compromise
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Protecting OEM firmware signing key is a part of secure key management and relevant to FW signing infrastructure. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1049
fields.description: OEM shall convert all OEM pre-production parts to production parts by burning the FUSE_SECURITY_MODE fuse.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Burning of efuse is a task of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1050
fields.description: Signing of boot images using private keys must be done in a secure environment. Private keys shall also be stored securely.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requriement.Performing boot-image signing in a secure environment and securely storing the private signing keys is part of the ECU integrator which is DN, its secure build and key-management infrastructure needs to be realized.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1060
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall take appropriate measures to protect the I2C connections of peripherals against physical attacks, by using tamper-resistant enclosures or other physical security measures.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement.Protecting I2C connections of cores against physical attacks is ECU integrator's task. Only DN can realize it, WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1067
fields.description: When configuration of the hardware watchdog is enabled for the user's application, the user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that watchdog timeout parameters such as timing and timeout behavior can only be configured once, during the Initialization mode, and that the watchdog mechanism can only be disabled during transitions to modes that do not require the watchdog mechanism, such as sleep.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring HW WD timeout parameters and controlling WD ON/OFF is handled by ECU integrator which is DN, WbyT AD application cant do any control on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1068
fields.description: Where the configuration of the hardware watchdog is managed by the user application, the user of DRIVE OS shall exclude any hardware-triggered system reset from the possible actions performed upon a hardware watchdog timeout.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Deciding reaction when HW WD timeout happens depends on DN's security concept. It is not a part of WbyT AD application task.

fields.name: NET_RES_008
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall implement QoS mechanisms within the Ethernet switch to prevent interrupt storms generated by Ethernet traffic from disrupting the Drive OS real time behavior.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring QoS mechanism inside Ethernet switch to prevent interrupts from affecting Drive OS in real time behavior depends on DN's security concept. It is not a part of WbyT AD application area.

fields.name: FSI_RES_039
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the FSI Clock & Reset block is protected from physical tampering of the hardwired link to the Power Management Controller via physical tamper-proof protection measures.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Protecting the FSI clock and reset block hardwired link to PMC is a ECU integrator task. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: FSI_RES_046
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall configure GPIO interrupts used in ICU MCAL as Category2 interrupts and prioritize the interrupts to prevent starvation of critical tasks.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring GPIO interrupts in MACL as CAT-2 is under responsibility of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_135
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will guard against malicious input from hardware.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Guarding against malicious input from HW is a task of ECU integrator which is DN, this is not something that can be done by WbyT inside AD application.

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_009
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that the MCU boot code includes a check for compatibility of the flashed MCU FW with respect to the microcontroller HW variant used in the board in order to mitigate the risk of running incompatible FW on the board. The Following actions must be taken when an incompatibility is detected:
1. Stop boot up sequence of Orin from Safety MCU.
2. Prevent from transitioning to the Normal Operation State.
Note: For further details on stopping boot up of Orin and preventing from transitioning to normal state, refer to 'Power-On Sequence Execution' section under 'MCU Dynamic SW Architecture for Platform Power Manager' in NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 LINUX/QNX PDK Developer Guide.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring the MCU boot mode and checking the FW compatibility is handled as a task of ECU integrator which is DN.WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_010
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure the MCU firmware compatibility with the NVIDIA reference platform HW and the used PDK versions prior to flashing the firmware on the Safety MCU.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Verifying MCU FW compatibility with Nvidia reference HW and specific PDK versions before flashing is a task of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT cant do anything on it.

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_011
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that the MCU boot code is configured to execute the first instruction of the MCU firmware binary at a valid start address as defined in the microcontroller user manual.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring the MCU boot code to start executing firmware from a valid entry address is a low-level MCU/bootloader and ECU platform integration responsibility of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_017
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that the secure boot immutable Root of Trust are physically located within the safety MCU executing the firmware to mitigate the risk of malicious actors gaining access to the secure boot process.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Placing the immutable secure-boot Root of Trust inside the Safety MCU is a secure hardware/boot architecture decision that can be only done by DN. WbyT cant do anything on it.

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_052
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall enable the RAM initialization in the AUTOSAR basic software configuration to ensure that the RAM contents are initialized to a known value at startup.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
RAM initialization in AUTOSAR BSW is under the responsibility of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: FSI_RES_035
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the FSI clocks are properly programmed before initiating any FSI functionality on the platform to prevent undefined behavior.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Programming the FSI closk before using any FSI functionality is a low level SOC security design, this is under the responsibility of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: FSI_RES_036
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the FSI firmware binary is digitally signed after integration to ensure the integrity of the binary.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Digital signature of integrated FSI FW bin derives from the DN security concept. It is not under the control of WbyT AD application.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1003
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that a hardware Root of Trust (RoT) is used to verify the integrity and authenticity of the first image booted on Safety MCU. Subsequently, the chain of trust shall be established to verify the integrity and authenticity of any firmware, software and calibration data consumed by the Safety MCU.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuration and operation of a HW RoT belong to DN security concept. It cant be handled by WbyT AD application side.

fields.name: TCFW_UREQ_001
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall properly provision the system in accordance with DOS_REC_020, and DOS_REC_022 to minimize the (security) attack surface.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Provisioning the system in accordance with DOS_REC_020 and DOS_REC_022 to minimize the security attack surface is a system-level platform provisioning and hardening responsibility of the ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1116
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that a secure boot flow is implemented to verify the integrity and authenticity of the Safety MCU firmware image prior to execution. The user shall also ensure that the control is passed to the Safety MCU image only after successful verification of the image.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Implementing secure boot and ensuring security control is under the responsibility of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1032
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS in MCU shall ensure that the interfaces listed below are only invoked from an authorized software module (e.g. system state manager):
NvMCU_OrinPwrCtrl_RE_RequestGenericService() NVMCU_ORINPWRCTRL_REQ_TRIG_RESET() NVMCU_ORINPWRCTRL_REQ_SHUTDOWN() NVMCU_ORINPWRCTRL_REQ_FORCED_SHDN()
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restriction invocation of safety MCU power control interfaces to an authorized module is a part of ECU integrator task which is DN. It cant be handled by WbyT AD application side.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1034
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that a secure messaging protocol is used to authenticate CAN and Ethernet messages received by the Safety MCU to prevent spoofing or tampering with messages that can cause the Safety MCU to transition DRIVE OS to an unintended state.
Note: For more information, see DOS_REC_020, and DOS_REC_022.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Implementing secure messaging protocols is under the responsibility of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.
