fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1035
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that access to MCU Flash Memory drivers is restricted to authorized applications only, in order to reduce the risk of
i. tampering with power management calibration data and ii. tampering with Flash contents on MCU like the MCU FW.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restriction access to MCU flash memory drivers replies on ECU solution which should be done by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1036
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall restrict access to the GPIO drivers in the Safety MCU to reduce the risk of unwanted state and power management transitions.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting access to GPIO drivers replies on the ECU security concept which is a part of ECU generic solution. This is realized by DN and WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1113
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall halt booting of the Safety MCU and prevent further system initialization or execution if its Secure Boot check fails.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Halting safety boot and preventing further system initialization under boot chain is under the responsibility of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1114
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall enable rollback protection during each software update that contains fixes to either safety defects or security vulnerabilities.
Note: If ratchet values are not updated with each such update, then the system becomes vulnerable to rollback attacks that can re-introduce the security vulnerability or safety defect. For more details on ratchet value update, please refer to section 'Configuring Ratcheting for OEM Owned Software Components' in NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.0 QNX PDK Developer Guide [2].
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enabling roll back protection relies on ECU security concept from DN, this can only be done by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1115
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall secure the Switch firmware and configuration stored on the SPI flash by providing a secure boot mechanism and physical tamper protection.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Securing the switch FW and configuration on SPI depends on DN security concept. It can not be done by WbyT AD application.

fields.name: TCFW_REC_005
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should change the Initialization Vector (IV) when encrypting a new Guest OS kernel image, and place the new IV value in the Salt2 field in the Boot Component Header.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Choosing and updating IV when encryption guest OS image and writing into boot header is a task of DN and a part of DN security concept. It cant be handled by WbyT AD application.

fields.name: DOS_REC_020
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should program the RESERVED_SW fuse field bits 1-0 to 01b and RESERVED_SW fuse field bit 3 to 1 to select the QSPI boot device.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Programming the RESERVED_SW fuse bit to select the QSPI boot device is a low level security solution that can only be done by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_REC_022
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should enable the OEM encryption of the boot software stack by setting the BOOT_SECURITY_INFO[3] fuse bit and programming fuses PRIVATE_KEY 0 to 3 (each of which is 32 bits) with the encryption key.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enabling OEM encryption of boot software stack by configuring BOOT_SECURITY_INFO

fields.name: DOS_REC_033
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS should use either of the following methods to address the root cause/effect of combining binaries from different DRIVE OS releases:
Test and ensure group compatibility across DRIVE OS releases Place the ECU in a tamper-evident enclosure
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring bin compatibility across different DRIVE OS releases is in scope of ECU integration which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: DOS_REC_150
fields.description: It is recommended that the user of DRIVE OS uses a magic number to identify the start of the EEPROM data and the same is validated in the customer code.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Defining the EEPROM data layout adding a magic number and validating it at read time is a part of low level ECU security design. This cant be down by WbyT AD application

fields.name: DOS_REC_151
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall deploy an AES CMAC based authentication scheme for the camera sensor calibration data stored in EEPROM to prevent tampering by unauthorized software. Please refer to SDK guide "EEPROM data protection mechanisms" for details on implementation.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement
Deploying an AES-CMAC based authentication scheme of camera is DN task which is relevant to DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: TCFW_REC_008
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS should use unique asymmetric secure boot key pairs per platform.
Note: Sharing the same secure boot private signing key across different vehicle platforms is not recommended. For details on how to program the root public key, refer to the fuse description table for (FUSE_PK_H0,1,2) in 'Manufacture Programmable Fuses' section of NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX PDK Developer Guide [2].
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Choosing unique asymmetric secure boot key pairs per Platform and programming the root pub keys are under DN plant control as a part of DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_112
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will enable secure boot for the platform via fuse settings.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enabling secure boot for the Platform via efuse belong to DN plant task as per security industrilization concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: PC_RES_010
fields.description: Following the best practices in the security system, the user of DRIVE OS must ensure that the startup script starts all processes and mounts all storage partitions before entering the Normal Operation state. Creating processes during the Normal Operation state is not considered secure. Disallowing creation of new processes in the Normal Operation state makes it difficult for a malicious user to spoof some processes.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring the startup script lauches processes belong to DN industrilization concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: PC_RES_024
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must not modify the abilities and privileges related configurations in the startup script. If changes are required, consult with NVIDIA.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring and modifying abilities and privileges in the system startup script is an OS/security-policy and ECU platform responsibility which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: PC_RES_027
fields.description:
The DRIVE OS user shall ensure the following constraints should be satisfied when modifying or extending the default configuration of PKCS11 tokens.
The user of DRIVE OS shall configure the PKCS11 token such that only one application will have the necessary custom ability access to the TSEC engine at runtime. If multiple applications must use the TSEC engine at runtime, the user must ensure that all such applications are in the same trust boundary. Any application that has access to the TSEC token can use every key on the token.
Security Engine keyslot usage limit assignment for PKCS11 tokens shall be configured to prevent untrusted applications from consuming all keyslots on a Security Engine.
Refer to the following sections of the NVIDIA DRIVE OS QNX SDK Developer Guide for information regarding PKCS11 token calibration:
PKCS#11 ‚Äì Implementation Details (for Custom Ability configuration) Configuring Token-Keyslot Restrictions (for Token-Keyslot assignment)
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring PKCS11 tokens, TSEC engine access abilities, and Security Engine keyslot usage limits is a platform cryptography and key-management responsibility of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: PC_RES_028
fields.description:
The DRIVE OS user shall ensure the following constraints are satisfied when modifying or extending the default configuration of PKCS11-related IVC queue configuration
IVC queues with the 'is_for_pl' field set to non-zero should not be accessible to any application.
IVC channels used to communicate with SE Server for PKCS11 use cases shall be configured to enforce a maximum size for every operation, and priorities among multiple callers to ensure availability for real-time use cases.
Refer to the following section of the NVIDIA DRIVE OS QNX SDK Developer Guide for information regarding PKCS11 IVC queue configuration:
VSE IVC Queue Configuration (for IVC queue information)
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring PKCS11-related IVC queues belong to DN security concept which is a part of ECU Platform tasks. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: PC_RES_029
fields.description:
The DRIVE OS User must ensure the following when establishing application access controls to zero-copy IVC queues.
PKCS11 related IVC channels must be configured so that only trusted and privileged applications can use zero-copy operations.
Stream ID assignment for zero-copy IVC channels used for PKCS11 clients must be configured so that every distinct application uses a distinct stream ID.
In the scenario where application software in a VM is utilizing zero-copy IVC queues to offload cryptographic operations to TZ-SE, no other application within the same VM must utilize TZ-SE for any purpose.
Refer to the following section of the NVIDIA DRIVE OS QNX SDK Developer Guide for information regarding PKCS11 zero-copy IVC queues:
VSE IVC Queue Configuration (For zero-copy IVC queue information)
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring application access controls, stream IDs, and VM usage policies for PKCS11 zero-copy IVC queues to TZ-SE is a low-level cryptographic IPC security concept which belong to DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: VKSC_RES_013
fields.description:
Applications using Vulkan SC with DRIVE OS shall store and load the pipeline cache data such that its data integrity is ensured.
Note: Rationale: The pipeline cache data contains GPU HW instructions in the application shader programs, as well as constants and pipeline state information. Modification of this data could result in execution of illegal GPU instructions and cause unpredictable behavior. Placing this data in a file on a read-only filesystem is recommended to reduce the attack surface. The user of DRIVE OS prepares the pipeline cache data during their SW development using the provided Pipeline Cache Compiler tool. Refer to "The Pipeline Cache Compiler (PCC) Tool" section in the NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX SDK Developer Guide [3], for more details on the tool usage.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is application level requirement.
This requirement constrains how Vulkan SC applications themselves generate,store, and protect their own pipeline cache files, these acticities are under control of WbyT AD application. The intention is to protect the integrity of the safety critical executable code zone

fields.name: DLA_RES_012
fields.description:
The user of DLA shall estimate the minimum number of DLA runtime contexts required by the application and provide this estimate as parameters to NvDla/NDla0Queues and NvDla/NDla1Queues abilities to mitigate the risk of application exhausting the resources.
The user can provide this estimate as a mandatory access control through the startup command in the device tree node or through the IFS startup script.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Estimating the minimum number of DLA runtime contexts and configuring the NvDla/NDla0Queues and NvDla/NDla1Queues abilities via device-tree or IFS startup script is a task of DN security concept.WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DLA_RES_015
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the loadable is stored in a partition that is protected by an access control mechanism.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is application level requirement.
The loadable DLA file is under our own application artifact which contains NN learning, we decide where it is stored and can ensure it sits in a partition with proper access control.
The main intention is to prevent tampering.

fields.name: NVIPC_RES_014
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the entire outgoing frame is populated with user data or filled with zeros when using NvSciIpcWriteGetNextFrame() NvSciIpc API to prevent the transfer of arbitrary data.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is application level requirement.
If NvSciIpcWriteGetNextFrame() is called directly by WbyT's on-vehicle AD/ADAS applications, we shall ensure the entire outgoing frame is fully populated or zero-filled (e.g. by using correct platform APIs, or implementing this function in our application); otherwise stale or arbitrary memory contents could be leaked over IPC

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1007
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall detect when a calibration data has been replaced with a valid copy from a different user platform during the secure boot check.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Detecting during secure boot whether calibration data has been replaced by a valid copy from a different user platform is part of the secure-boot chain mechanism which can only be decided by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1147
fields.description: User of Drive OS shall specify priorities of virtual devices through PCT and shall set highest priority to EDR (Enhanced Data Recorder) partition.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Specifying virtual-device priorities in the PCT and assigning highest priority to the EDR partition is a storage and platform based configuration setup. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1148
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall not load executables from a Data FS file system.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Preventing executables from bneing loaded from a DataFS filesystem-by mounting DataFS NO_EXEC and enforcing execution restriction is an ECU platform configuration responsibility by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: CUD_RES_164
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the CUDA libraries are loaded only in valid applications that use the GPU and DLA hardware.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting which processes are allowed to load CUDA lib is enforced via OS abilities, loader setup, these are contained as a part of DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: IEP_REC_005
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the encoded output data saved after end of recording session from IEP, that is used for offline monitoring, is stored in cryptographically protected cloud storage after the recording session is completed.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is related with MapService Cloud sericice. Protected storage are handled by BEVS3 MapService Cloud CSMS controls

fields.name: DOS_ASU_021
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will ensure that application software, configuration data and calibration data are authenticated.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
The overall authentication mechnisam is ensured by DN as per security concepts. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it directly.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_133
fields.description: It is assumed the user of DRIVE OS will ensure the calibration and configuration data are stored in an authenticated file system to protect their integrity.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is application level requirement.
WbyT own and manage our own calibration and configuration data on the ECU to protect the file's integrity

fields.name: PVA_ASU_006
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that all DataFlows associated with a CmdProgram are triggered to completion.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
PVA-based vision workload configured at the ECU layer, WbyT AD application in BEVs3 do not own or use PVA CmdPrograms, and we cant trigger the dataflow by our own.

fields.name: PVA_ASU_007
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that only VPU ELF binaries compatible with the version of DRIVE OS specified in the PVA SDK documentation are registered for execution with cuPVA.
Note: For more information on the compatible DRIVE OS version(s), refer to the ("Release Notes:Targets") section in the PVA SDK documentation.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Registering VPU ELF bin with cuPVA and ensuring they match the Drive OS version supported by the PVA SDK is ECU integration responsibility, which is DN. WbyT AD application doesn't build or register such VPU bin files.

fields.name: SECSERV_RES_021
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that a discretionary access control mechanism is used to restrict client application access to Security Services APIs.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing discretionary access control to restrict which client applications will call security services APIs is implemented via configuration owned by ECU integrator. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this.

fields.name: SECSERV_RES_044
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS must ensure all the shared libraries of Security Services and their dependencies must be packaged in cryptographically authenticated filesystems such as the primary IFS or secondary IFS.
The shared libraries and dependencies are listed as follows:
/proc/boot/devc-nvvse-safety
/proc/boot/devc-nvtzvault
/proc/boot/devc-nvautomountauth
/proc/boot/nvpkcs11_kat
/proc/boot/libnvpkcs11.so
/proc/boot/libgp.so
/proc/boot/libnvvse-safety.so
/proc/boot/libc.so.5
/proc/boot/libnvos_s3_safety.so
/proc/boot/libnvrm_mem.so
/proc/boot/libnvsciipc.so
/proc/boot/libnvdvms.so
/proc/boot/libnvdvms_client.so
/proc/boot/libnvdtcommon.so
/proc/boot/libnvrm_host1x.so
/proc/boot/libnvsocsys.so
/proc/boot/libnvivc.so
/proc/boot/libgcc_s.so.1
/proc/boot/libslog2.so.1
/proc/boot/libnvos.so
/proc/boot/libnvscievent.so
/proc/boot/libnvtegrahv.so
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Packaging Security Services shared libraries and their dependencies into cryptographically authenticated filesystems (e.g., primary/secondary IFS) is part of the OS image build and platform provisioning owned by the OEM/ECU integrator which is DN.

fields.name: SECSERV_RES_048
fields.description: When using the PKCS#11 API function, C_DeriveKey, to derive symmetric keys, the user of DRIVE OS must ensure that keys derived from a particular root key for different key usage purposes are derived using a unique (label, context) pair as part of the derivation string.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Correctly using C_DeriveKey with unique (label, context) pairs per key-usage purpose is part of the low-level PKCS#11 key-derivation policy and cryptographic key-management configuration owned by the OS/ECU integrator, WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: SECSERV_RES_049
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that key ownership controls are enforced over each individual cryptographic key stored persistently in the PKCS#11 based DRIVE OS key store, including:
Access and usage of a key in a cryptographic algorithm is restricted to the key owner(s).
Key store operations (erase, copy, swap, import, unwrap) on a key is restricted to the key owner(s) or a privileged administrator.
Note: This may be accomplished by assigning different PKCS11 tokens to different applications. Details can be found in the 'PKCS#11 ‚Äì Implementation Details' section in the DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX PDK and Linux PDK Developer Guides to assign different PKCS11 tokens to specific applications.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing key-ownership controls in the PKCS#11-based DRIVE OS keystore is ECU integrator level requirement which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anyting on it.

fields.name: SECSERV_RES_051
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure the ODM_SECURITY_MODE fuse is burned on all production platforms.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Buring the fuse on production platform is a hardware provisioning and manufacturing responsibility of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: SECSERV_RES_052
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS must not exceed the following limits on PKSC11 object creation using PKCS11 APIs throughout the lifetime of the product in order to comply with NIST cryptoperiod restrictions.
Ephemeral CKO_SECRET_KEY objects: 2^32
Ephemeral CKO_PUBLIC_KEY, CKO_PRIVATE_KEY, CKO_DATA objects: 9.2 x 10^11 combined total across all listed object types
Persistent CKO_SECRET_KEY, CKO_PUBLIC_KEY, CKO_PRIVATE_KEY, CKO_DATA objects: 2^24 combined total across all listed object types
Note: PKCS11 object creation involves any operation that creates a new PKCS11 object. Invocation of the following PKCS11 APIs results in a PKCS11 creation operation: C_CreateObject C_GenerateKey C_GenerateKeyPair C_DeriveKey C_UnwrapKey
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing lifetime limits on PKCS#11 object creation to meet NIST cryptoperiod restrictions is a part of ECU integrator responsibility which is DN. WbyT cant do anything on it.

fields.name: SECSERV_RES_053
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that C_WrapKey with CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP is permitted exclusively for camera authentication when using Omnivision - OX05B camera sensors. Should an alternate sensor be used, access to this API should be restricted through the tos_keystore_api_conf field under tos_keystore_config in PCT.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting use of C_WrapKey with CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP to Omnivision OX05B camera authentication and configuring tos_keystore_api_conf in the PCT is a camera-authentication is under the scope of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1010
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall follow the recommendations of the [NIST SP 800-89] standard when handling Digital Signature and their associated private keys.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Following NIST SP 800-89 for handling digital signatures and private keys governs the design and operation of the platform's PKI and key-management infrastructure which is under the scope of DN.WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1012
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall update their Private Keys when the Cryptoperiod of the keys reaches a preset limit defined by the user.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Rotating private keys when their cryptoperiod expires is part of the platform's PKI and key-management lifecycle operated by the OEM/ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1013
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall set the Cryptoperiod of individual Private Keys in the Safety MCU to resist the following Side-Channels Attacks:
1. Differential Electromagnetic Analysis (DEMA) 2. Differential Power Analysis (DPA) 3. Simple Power Analysis (SPA)
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Setting cryptoperiods for individual private keys on the Safety MCU to mitigate side-channel attacks (DEMA/DPA/SPA) is part of the Safety MCU's cryptographic key-management and hardware security strategy owned by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1014
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall obtain assurance of Public Key validity as per [NIST SP 800-89] prior to using the Public Key for Digital Signature verification.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring public-key validity per NIST SP 800-89 before using it for digital-signature verification is part of the platform PKI/credential-validation infrastructure owned by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1015
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall obtain assurance of Public Key validity as per [NIST SP 800-89] prior to using the matching Private Key in the generation of Digital Signatures. This applies to both user embedded software and tools that performs digital signature generation.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Assuring public-key validity per NIST SP 800-89 before using the matching private key to generate digital signatures (in embedded software or tools) is part of the platform PKI and signing-toolchain governance owned by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1031
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall enforce Cryptographic Integrity over a Safety MCU firmware update using one the following Digital Signature Algorithms:
RSA Probabilistic Signature Scheme (RSASSA-PSS) [FIPS 186-4][PKCS1-v2.2] using MGF1 [PKCS1-v2.2] and SHA-256 [FIPS 180-4] over a 3072 bit modulus;
Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA) [RFC 8032] using SHA-512 [FIPS 180-4] over the elliptic curve Curve25519 [RFC 7748];
Elliptic Curve Digital Signature (ECDSA) [FIPS 186-4][ANS X9.62] using SHA-512 [FIPS 180-4] over the elliptic curve secp256r1 [SEC2-v2] or the elliptic curve secp521r1 [SEC2-V2];
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing cryptographic integrity on Safety MCU firmware updates using specific digital signature algorithms is part of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1033
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the GPIO pin(DIO) of Safety MCU that is used to trigger reset of the Orin SoC is only accessed through the DRIVE OS provided module MCU_OrinPwrCtrl.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Controlling of GPIO pin is owned by ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1040
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall mitigate invasive and side channel attacks against data as well as cryptographic keys in the fuse array, unless Fuse encryption is used during factory programming.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Mitigating invasive and side-channel attacks against data and cryptographic keys in the fuse array is a hardware security and manufacturing responsibility of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1121
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall implement monitoring software in the application on CCPLEX and the Functional Safety Island to detect and react to voltage, clock, and temperature related anomalies. Upon detecting such anomalies, it is recommended to either terminate ongoing cryptographic operations, or discard the results.
Note: For information describing thermal monitoring, see "Temperature Monitor Interfaces" and "NVIDIA Orin Temperature Monitoring" in NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX PDK Developer Guide [2]. For voltage monitoring, see "NVIDIA Orin Voltage Monitoring Using VRS12 (VMON)" in NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX PDK Developer Guide [2].
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Implementation of monitoring specific software on CCPLEX and FSM on the Island is a part of Platform level task which is owned by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1151
fields.description: When provisioning the OEM root Key Derivation Key (OEM_KDK0) in efuse, the user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that OEM_KDK0 is mutually independent from other cryptographic keys provisioned across all other Orin SoCs.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring that the OEM_KDK0 efuse key is mutually independent from other cryptographic keys across all Orin SoCs is a hardware provisioning and key-management responsibility of DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1152
fields.description: When submitting cryptographic job requests through the PKCS11 interface and the AUTOSAR interface within the Functional Safety Island, the user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that large cryptographic job requests by a single client do not block other clients resulting in a denial of service of the shared cryptographic engine hardware.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Preventing a single client's large PKCS11/AUTOSAR cryptographic jobs on the Functional Safety Island from blocking others is a shared-crypto-engine scheduling and platform resource-management responsibility of the ECU/FSI integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1153
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall store the root of trust public key for camera sensor authentication in the PKCS11 secure storage with the associated name corresponding to the issuer common name field to enable verification of the authenticity of the sensor.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Using a secure authentication mechanism to validate Camera Capture notifications is part of the camera-control plane and platform security design implemented by the OEM/ECU/camera integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1154
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that a secure authentication mechanism is used to validate Camera Capture notifications before taking any action on them to prevent tampering of Camera Capture notifications by malicious applications.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Using a secure authentication mechanism to validate Camera Capture notifications is part of the camera control-plane and platform security design implemented by the OEM/ECU/camera integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1155
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the private key used to sign the Root of Trust for camera sensors is protected in the build environment using a secure means such as a hardware security module.
Note: Please consult [NIST Special Publication 800-57 Part 1 Revision 5] for recommendations on managing the private key in the build environment.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Protecting the private key used to sign the camera sensor Root of Trust in the build environment (e.g., via an HSM) is part of the DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1156
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that they sign the camera vendor certificate using the Root of Trust key pair and provide it to the camera vendor for provisioning the vendor certificate on the camera sensor. Please work with your camera vendor if the associated work flow is different.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Signing of the camera vendor certificate with root of trust key pair is a part of DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this.

fields.name: TCFW_RES_027
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must not configure XMSS and ECDSA signing algorithms in the secure boot chain.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Choosing which singing algorithms depends on DN decision. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: SAS_RES_038
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall enforce access control mechanisms to ensure that only the specified IPs have access to the Safety Services OS application-:
1. FSI SPI on FSI
2. Aurix SPI (connected to FSI_SPI, SPI_HS) on MCU 3. HSM (SCE HSM and FSI HSM) 4. FSI-ATF carveout 5. TOP2 HSP mailbox on FSI
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing access control so that only specific HW Ips can reach the safety services OS application is a low level of DN security policy. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: FSI_RES_005
fields.description:
The key providers of DRIVE OS must re-provision the keys into the Secure NOR before the respective invocation limit is reached. Invocation boundaries for the various algorithms are listed below:
AES GCM/GMAC with 128 bit key/256 bit key with random nonce: Earlier of authentication tag generation invocations, or 2^52 (See section 8.3 in NIST SP 800-38D)
AES GCM/GMAC with 128 bit key/256 bit key with deterministic nonce construction: 2^52 ciphertext bytes or plaintext bytes for the same key (See NIST SP 800-38D)
AES CMAC with 128 bit key/256 bit key: 2^48 invocations for generation of MAC (See appendix B in NIST SP 800-38B)
AES CBC with 128 bit/256 bit key with random nonce: 2^52 ciphertext bytes generated with the same key
RSA based signature generation: Infinite
ECC based signature generation: Infinite
Note: The user of DRIVE OS must keep track of the number of invocations and/or number or bytes generated for a particular type of key to determine if the key needs to be retired from use. Refer to SDK/PDK, NIST/RSA/ECC standards. For details on how to provision keys into the Secure NOR, refer to section "Persistent Key Object Support" in the PDK Developer Guide.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement
Re-provisioning cryptographic keys into Secure NOR before their invocation limits are reached is part of the platform key-lifecycle management operated by ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: FSI_RES_034
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure the maximum number of keys provisioned throughout the lifetime of the DRIVE OS based system must not exceed the below mentioned limits to ensure that the cryptographic operations are performed within expected operational limits.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing lifetime limites on the total number of keys provisioned in the system is a part of DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: FSI_RES_037
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall cancel ongoing cryptographic operations within the Functional Safety Island and CCPLEX if one of the following conditions is detected
SoC temperature is outside the operating range SoC voltage is outside the operating range SoC clock is outside the operating range
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Canceling cryptographic operations on the Functional Safety Island is a task of ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: FSI_RES_040
fields.description: The User of DRIVE OS must not use a cryptographic signature generated using FSI SW for verification by FSI SW.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restriction on how Functional Safety Island software may (not) use its own cryptographic signatures is a FSI-side cryptographic usage policy owned by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: FSI_RES_041
fields.description: The User of DRIVE OS must verify the consistency of the keying material established or transported by a key agreement scheme.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Verifying the consistency of keying material established or transported by a key-agreement scheme is part of the platform's cryptographic protocol belong to DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this

fields.name: FSI_RES_042
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that FSI applications are not able to access the cryptographic data of other applications unless intended by design.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Isolating FSI applications so they cannot access each other's cryptographic data (unless explicitly intended) is enforced via FSI/platform security configuration which can be only done by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: FSI_RES_044
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must use a new 128-bit random bit string as the Initialization Vector input for each CBC [SP 800-38A] encryption query over a fixed AES [FIPS 197] Symmetric Key.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Choosing and enforcing a fresh 128-bit random IV for each AES-CBC encryption operation belong to DN security concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: FSI_RES_054
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall avoid supplying plaintext keys using the AUTOSAR KeyElementSet() interface wherever possible and use provisioned keys instead.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Choosing whether to supply plaintext keys via the AUTOSAR IF replies on DN choices, this is not something that can be done by AD application.

fields.name: TCFW_REC_004
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS should mitigate physical security attacks when programming the secure SPI NOR provisioning key.
Note: During SPI NOR provisioning, the SPI NOR chip is not yet in a secure state which creates a window of opportunity for mounting physical attacks to recover the SPI NOR provisioning key.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Mitigating physical security attacks during secure SPI NOR provisioning is a hardware provisioning that can only be done by DN.

fields.name: SECSERV_REC_014
fields.description: The users of Security Services should provision keys on the platform with security strength that matches the security strength of DRIVE OS (128 bits or greater).
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Choosing and provisioning Security Services keys with sufficient security strength (≥128 bits) is part of the platform cryptography which relies on DN decision.This taks cant be done by WbyT AD application

fields.name: SECSERV_REC_015
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS should not assign the same PKCS11 device node to multiple PKCS11 clients.
Note: These device nodes refer to the /dev/nvvse-* nodes that facilitate communication with the Security Engines. Details can be found in the 'PKCS#11 ‚Äì Implementation Details' section in the DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX SDK and Linux SDK Developer Guides, and the API reference for the C_NVIDIA_InitializeChannel and C_NVIDIA_OpenSession functions.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Assigning PKCS11 device nodes to clients depends on DN security policy. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: SECSERV_REC_016
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS should refrain from creating PKCS11 key objects in a manner where the PKCS11 client specifies the key material in plaintext. During secure provisioning of keys the DRIVE OS user may accomplish this is several ways, including
Generate a PKCS11 key objects via C_GenerateKey
Derive a PKCS11 key object off an existing key via C_DeriveKey Import a wrapped PKCS11 key object via C_UnwrapKey()
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Deciding not to create PKCS11 key objects from client-supplied plaintext key material etc belong to DN security policy. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: NVDISPLAY_REC_001
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should configure the size of the stage-2 display ISO context bank such that it is not significantly more than the required size for the intended use case.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Sizing the stage-2 display ISO context bank for the display pipeline is a low-level display/SoC resource configuration task handled by the OS/ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: FSI_REC_001
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall employ runtime rate-limiting techniques to prevent the Safety Island from violating safety KPIs by limiting the amount of runtime resources available to the Safety Island. These rate-limiting techniques may include disabling CAN interrupts, partitioning FSI software, and other such measures to spatially isolate network facing software from algorithmic software.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Employing runtime rate-limiting on the Functional Safety Island belong to ECU security policy which can be realized by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_111
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will provide a secure key management infrastructure for managing automotive lifecycle uses cases such as secure boot, logging services, and failure analysis.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/EC levwel requirement.
Providing a secure key-management infrastructure for lifecycle use cases such as secure boot, loggin belong to DN security policy. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: SECSERV_ASU_052
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will rotate the cryptographic keys stored on the secure NOR using the PKCS11 APIs.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/EC levwel requirement.
Rotating cryptographic keys stored in Secure NOR via PKCS11 APIs is part of the platform key-lifecycle management operated by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: SECSERV_ASU_053
fields.description: It is assumed that users of Security Services will keep the total number of bytes encrypted using a particular AES key to be less than 2^48 (2 to the power of 48) over the lifetime of the key. This is applicable for both AES-CTR and AES-CBC modes.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/EC levwel requirement.
Limiting the total bytes encrypted per AES key over its lifetime for key lifecycle management belong to DN security concept.It is not a task that can be done by WbyT AD application

fields.name: SECSERV_ASU_055
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will securely destroy all copies of wrapped cryptographic keys that are provided as an input to the PKCS#11 API's C_UnwrapKey function.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/EC levwel requirement.
Securely destroying wrapped cryptographic keys passed into key management system is to be operated by ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: TCFW_ASU_018
fields.description: When performing Factory Secure Key Provisioning, it is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will be responsible for making sure the higher-order 16 bytes of the FSKP derivation strings differ.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/EC levwel requirement.
Ensuring that the higher-order 16 bytes of FSKP derivation strings differ during Factory Secure Key Provisioning can be realized as a secure manufacturing concept which belong to DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1000
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that, for each stage of operation, user processes are configured in least privilege mode for access to files, resource manager services, and QNX procmgr abilities, in accordance with the DRIVE OS policy and documentation.
Refer to Chapter 5.1.1 in the Safety Developer Guide to understand and integrate with the DRIVE OS strategy for Principle of Least Privilege.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring user processes in least-privilege mode across all operation stages (files, resource-manager services, QNX procmgr abilities) is done via system security policy and startup/launcher settings owned by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1024
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall assign a unique and static Party Identifier to each Camera Sensor.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Assigning a unique, static Party Identifier to each camera sensor is done through camera hardware provisioning and platform/SIPL configuration by ECU integrator which is DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on this point.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1025
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall protect the Immutability of the association between a Camera Sensor and their Party Identifier.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Keeping the association between each camera sensor and its Party Identifier immutable is enforced through camera hardware provisioning belong to a part of DN security manufacturing concept. WbyT AD application cant do anything on ti.

fields.name: BSP_RES_097
fields.description: Discretionary access control is implemented to ensure only intended clients can access services provided by underlying drivers. GIDs allocation is documented in /etc/group file. The user of DRIVE OS must identify the minimum set of group IDs required for the application to function based on the group IDs and start the application with identified minimal set of group IDs. If set is not minimal then the userspace application has access to more services than it needs to. In case of malicious attack, the effect of the attack will be wider. If an application attempts to access a DRIVE OS service without the proper GID in their supplementary group ID list, then that access will fail.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Identifying the minimal set of group IDs and starting applications with only those GIDs and set up DAC design can be realized as part of OS security policy and it is relevant to startup/launcher configuration which is owned by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1037
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall only share access controlled resources to other user processes that have been previously authenticated and authorized.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Deciding which user processes are authenticated/authorized and enforcing the access shared are all belong to DN security policies. This can only be realized by ECU integrator which is DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1059
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall apply authentication and/or encryption protections as needed for logs sent to slogger.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Applying authentication/encryption protections for LOGS sent to slogger is aprt of centralized logging and transport security configuration owned by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1130
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall restrict access to GPIO drivers to ensure that only valid applications can read or write to the GPIO pins on Orin.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting which applications can access GPIO drivers on Orin is enforced via OS permissions, abilities, and platform security policy configured by DN. WbyT AD application cant do anything on it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1131
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that only trusted applications run on the AutoSAR OS running on FSI, since the SRAM is shared across all the FSI CPU cores.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring that only trusted applications run on the AUTOSAR OS on the FSI-given that SRAM is shared across all FSI cores-is part of security policy which is owned by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1132
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall partition FSI OS Applications into separate cores according to the communication channels that must be accessible to each application.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Partitioning FSI OS applications across cores according to required communication channels can be realized as a part of DN security concept. It is not WbyT AD application task.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1133
fields.description: The user of Drive OS shall ensure that any Inference data that is deemed sensitive is to be access controlled and placed in GSC carveout region while resident in volatile memory. The integrity of such inference data stored in non-volatile memory shall be ensured by use of the DataFS file system. For such data at rest, confidentiality protection shall be ensured by application level encryption schemes.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Carveout regions and GSC policies are managed by ECU integarators which is DN. WbyT AD application do not define or control a decidated sensitive interence data storage path, that is the reason why DRIVE OS requirement is treated as out of scope for our SWCs even though similar data protection goals are covered by other in-scope requirement.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1134
fields.description: User of Drive OS shall ensure that in case there is an overlap of virtual device addresses, that the overlap is intentional and defined explicitly.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Deciding whether virtual device address ranges overlap-and ensuring any overlap is intentional and explicitly defined-is a low-level storage/virtual-device configuration task that can only be realized by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1135
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that AUTOSAR mechanisms are used to restrict access of SPI/DMA hardware to applications/tasks that are intended for SPI communication.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Using autosar mechanisms to restrct SPI/DMA hardware access is part of ATUSOAR BSW/MCAL and ECU Platform configuration which can only be realized by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1136
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall use AUTOSAR mechanisms to restrict access of SPI/DMA (channel specific) configuration data to applications/tasks that are intended for SPI communication to mitigate the risk of unauthorized access to SPI/DMA configuration data.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting access to SPI/DMA channel configuration data via AUTOSAR mechanisms is an AUTOSAR BSW/MCAL and ECU platform security configuration which can be only realized by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1137
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that AUTOSAR mechanisms are used to restrict access of CAN code/data to applications/tasks that are intended for CAN communication to prevent unauthorized access and usage of CAN data.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
rRstricting access to CAN code/data using AUTOSAR mechanisms is an AUTOSAR BSW/MCAL and ECU platform security configuration responsibility of DN

fields.name: FSI_RES_029
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS SW shall ensure that access to AUTOSAR MCAL/CDD drivers code/data and peripheral registers is restricted to the applications/tasks that are intended to use them by correctly configuring the underlying memory protection mechanisms.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting access to AUTOSAR MCAL/CDD driver code/data and peripheral registers via memory protection is an AUTOSAR BSW/MCAL and ECU platform configuration responsibility of DN

fields.name: FSI_RES_030
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the MPU programming is performed from startup code or AUTOSAR OS to prevent unintended access to memory regions.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Programming the MPU from startup code or the AUTOSAR OS to prevent unintended memory access is an AUTOSAR/ECU platform safety and memory-protection responsibility of the OS/ECU integrator which is DN

fields.name: FSI_RES_031
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the API to update drift threshold Swt_UpdateTSCMonitorConfiguration or Swt_UpdateDriftThreshold is invoked only from the Safety Services module to protect against unauthorized invocation of the API.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting SWT_UPdateTSCMOnitorCOnfiguration and SWT_UpdateDriftThreshold so they can only be invoked from the Safety Services module is part of the Safety Services/FSI platform belong to a task of DN.

fields.name: FSI_RES_032
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure during integration that the error codes reserved by NVIDIA Software are not reported from any other User Application.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is application level requirement.
WbyT's AD/ADAS applications define and emit their own error/diagnostic codes, we are directly responsible for designing our error-code ranges and implementation so that none of our SWCs ever use NVIDIA-reserved error codes, ensuring those reserved codes remain unique to NVIDIA software

fields.name: FSI_RES_033
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that GIC Registers are programmed only from AutoSAR OS and user applications running on AutoSAR OS shall be restricted from updating these GIC Registers.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Programming GIC registers exclusively from the AUTOSAR OS and preventing AUTOSAR user applications from updating them is an interrupt-controller which is relevant to ECU Platform configuration, this is under the responsibility of DN

fields.name: TCFW_ASU_017
fields.description: It is assumed that the user of DRIVE OS will be responsible for compliance with privacy regulations on the use of Exclusive Chip Identification (ECID).
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring compliance with privacy regulations when using Exclusive Chip Identification (ECID) belong to that task of DN

fields.name: DOS_RES_087
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that QSPI NOR flash storage device - Instance 0 is used exclusively as the boot medium and to store any read only data. Write access shall be performed only via the DRIVE Update APIs to ensure the integrity of the boot medium and the read only data.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring QSPI NOR flash instance 0 as the exclusive boot/read-only medium and restricting all writes to it via DRIVE Update APIs is a boot/storage platform under the responsibility of DN

fields.name: DRU_RES_015
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall not pass any sensitive/confidential information, such as Critical Security Parameters, Personally Identifiable Information, or file names containing sensitive/confidential information when using APIs to ensure that it is not exposed in the failure logs.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Drive-OS–facing APIs that handle Critical Security Parameters and PII are implemented and used by platform/ECU components rather than by WbyT's on-vehicle AD application

fields.name: DRU_RES_018
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the DRIVE Update Command and Control Interface is restricted to the Application software residing in the Guest OS that it interacts with, and ensure that the IVC security policy is used.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting the DRIVE Update Command and Control Interface to specific Guest-OS application software and enforcing the corresponding IVC security policy is an ECU/platform update which belong to DN

fields.name: DRU_RES_019
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that any files exported by the Client OTA Application/Content Provider are marked as read-only to prevent malicious actors from tampering with the files.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is OTA/backend content-management and Platform security configuration task.
Marking files exported by the Client OTA Application/Content Provider as read-only is part of the OTA/backend content-management and platform security configuration owned by the OEM/ECU or cloud integrator, not something WbyT's on-vehicle AD/ADAS application software can implement or control, so this requirement is out of scope

fields.name: DRU_RES_030
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall construct the update package as per guidelines in "DRIVE Update Package" section in the "DRIVE Update V3" chapter in NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX PDK Development Guide.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Constructing DRIVE Update packages according to the NVIDIA "DRIVE Update Package" guidelines is under ECU integarator task which belong to DN

fields.name: DRU_RES_031
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the MCC Library API is implemented correctly and has a timeout configured to ensure that it does not wait forever for a response from the MCC Daemon.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Correct implementation and timeout configuration of the MCC Library API is part of Platform integratorion task which belong to DN

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_012
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that the firmware-update feature on the MCU provides a mechanism to support the confidentiality of MCU binaries, by encrypting the firmware during firmware updates on the MCU, to prevent unauthorized access to the MCU binaries.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Implementing confidentiality protection for MCU firmware updates belong to ECU level security policies

fields.name: NvMCU_RES_054
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS must ensure that only statically built software applications are allowed to be loaded into the MCU via the MCU software update process.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing that only statically built software applications can be loaded onto the MCU via its firmware update process is ECU Platform level responsibility. This cant be achieved by WbyT AD application

fields.name: DOS_RES_134
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the anti-rollback mechanism for Safety MCU firmware is enabled and utilized to protect against unauthorized access or malicious tampering. The user must also regularly update the firmware version in the ratchet field to ensure that only compatible and latest firmware versions are used on the Safety MCU.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enabling and operating the Safety MCU firmware anti-rollback mechanism belong to DN security concept.

fields.name: DOS_RES_045
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the Safety MCU software application detects a SoC boot failure by monitoring a user implemented signal communication from SoC side. In case the boot failure is detected, the user of DRIVE OS on MCU shall implement a recovery mechanism that involves switching to the next valid bootchain.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Detecting SoC boot failure on the Safety MCU via a SoC-side signal and then switching to the next valid bootchain is part of DN security concept.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1054
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that access to the Drive Update delta plugin is restricted to a single authorized client to prevent unauthorized extraction of binaries in the active/inactive bootchain.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting access to the Drive Update delta plugin to a single authorized client-so that binaries in the active/inactive bootchain cannot be extracted, this is realized by ECU level configuration which belong to DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1061
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that if the connection with the OTA server needs to be reestablished by the OTA client after connection failures, the number of connection request retries is limited to a preconfigured maximum limit and sufficient timeouts are implemented between retries.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Limiting OTA client reconnect retries and configuring retry timeouts is part of the Platform configuration owned by DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1062
fields.description: When installing new storage device firmware, the user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the firmware update is performed in a controlled environment with a reliable power source while the vehicle is stationary.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring that storage-device firmware updates occur only in a controlled environment with reliable power while the vehicle is stationary is an operational solution owned by ECU integrator which is DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1063
fields.description:
For production devices that do not require the use of USB in course of normal operation, once the USB interface is no longer needed for either programming, provisioning or testing, the user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that access to the USB physical interface is not available outside of the ECU enclosure. Additionally, if software images are not locked to individual devices through the use of ECID checks during the secure boot process or through device-specific signing keys, it is recommended that the fuse bits are set to permanently disable the USB Recovery Mode (RCM) boot path.
Note: Once the RCM boot path is disabled via fuse settings, it cannot be re-enabled. The RCM boot path may be used for other operations than programming and testing during the manufacturing process, such as for Failure Analysis and to load diagnostic software for the purposes of troubleshooting and to retrieve logs. Once disabled, software updates may be loaded only over-the-air (OTA) through Drive Update (DU), which is only available if DRIVE OS is first able to boot successfully from a boot chain that is present in flash.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Deciding whether to expose or physically block the USB interface on production ECUs and whether to permanently disable USB Recovery Mode via fuse settings is only realized by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1064
fields.description:
Where the secure-boot signing key is not device-unique, the user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the ECID lock of debug overlays remains enabled.
Note: ECID locking of the prod_debug and prod_debug_extra builds on Secure-fused boards is enabled by default. While using prod_debug and prod_debug_extra packages on Secure fused boards, users are expected to obtain HASH(ECID) and use it as input in the bind_partitions step for creating the images with HASH(ECID). Failure to do so can result in a boot failure. Refer to "Secure Boot in Debug Builds" section in [2] for details on obtaining HASH(ECID) and passing it to bind_partitions command.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring ECID locking for debug overlays and managing HASH(ECID) in the secure-boot image creation flow are part of DN security concept

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1127
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the BR-BCT Verification Public Key Hash (PKC) is burnt into SoC Fuse in factory mode.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Burning the BR-BCT Verification Public Key Hash (PKC) into the SoC fuse is a part of DN security manufacturing concept.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1158
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall validate the BR-BCT key revocation update image before sending it to DRIVE Update for the intended target system. Furthermore, it is crucial to ensure that the BR-BCT update process is not interrupted.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Validating BR-BCT key-revocation update images and ensuring the BR-BCT update process is not interrupted are part of the secure-boot chain mechanism which belong to DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1159
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that any image to be flashed by DRIVE OS is decrypted prior to passing the image to DRIVE Update service.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Decrypting images before handing them to the DRIVE Update service is part of the secure update/OTA from DN. This cant be done by WbyT AD application

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1162
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall protect the integrity, authenticity and confidentiality of the image content as it traverses the network. Once received on Drive OS, the user shall authenticate the package, then decrypt the package prior to passing it to Drive Update.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Protecting the integrity, authenticity, and confidentiality of update image content over the network belong to a task of DN in secure update concept.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1163
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that all firmware images transmitted over the network from the OEM server to DRIVE OS are signed and encrypted using a supported signature scheme and cipher. Additionally, the user shall ensure that the keys used for decryption and signature verification are securely stored in the DRIVE OS key store and are only accessible to Drive Update application.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Ensuring that firmware images from the OEM server are signed and encrypted, and that the corresponding decryption/verification keys are securely stored in the DRIVE OS keystore are a part of DN secure update concept

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1164
fields.description:
The user of Drive OS shall ensure that:
i. Critical Firmware (eg flash - eMMC, UFS) and Switch FW are only updated in factory or an authorized dealer environment having sufficient infrastructure to allow recovery from failures that may take place during programming.
ii. Drive Update(DU) plugins are not used to flash such critical firmware
iii. Where possible, flash that supports cryptographically secure firmware should be used
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Deciding where and how critical eMMC/UFS and switch firmware are updated (factory or dealer environment) belong to DN security policies

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1165
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that access controls are in place to restrict access of the data belonging to a Drive Update plugin to only that specific plugin.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enforcing access controls so that each Drive Update plugin can only access its own data is part of the Drive Update framework and platform security configuration owned by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1166
fields.description: Where Chain C is supported in DRIVE OS but deactivated by the user, the OTA Client implemented by the user of DRIVE OS shall deny requests to read or update Chain C contents.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Denying read/update requests to a deactivated boot Chain C can only be realized by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1167
fields.description: When a variant specific calibration partition is not configured to be included in the PVIT (Partition Version Information Table), the user of DRIVE OS shall perform compatibility checks between the variant specific calibration set and the rest of the software images installed on the target prior to issuing the software update using the DRIVE OS update services.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Performing variant-specific calibration compatibility checks against the full set of installed software images and managing PVIT/partition composition is part of variant management and update flow owned by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1174
fields.description:
When the user intends to install variants of a single Secondary IFS Partition, they may configure the skip_pvit_check option for that partition if the following conditions are met:
The user wants to update the variant partition without simultaneously having to update kernel-DTB and the PVIT for each new variant update The user can detect an incompatible variant at runtime after the file system partition has been mounted
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring Secondary IFS variant partitions and handling variant/PVIT/kernel-DTB compatibility belong to Platform/ECU solution which is owned by DN

fields.name: DRU_REC_014
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should ensure that the application software interacting with Command and Control interface should be in its own process boundary separate from application software interacting with DU-Link interface.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Separating the process that interacts with the DRIVE Update Command and Control interface from the process that interacts with the DU-Link interface is a task of ECU integrator which is DN

fields.name: DRU_REC_016
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should validate all the partitions regardless of whether it is a full update / delta update / clone before unlocking the inactive partition.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Validating all partitions before unlocking the inactive bootchain is part of secure boot concept where the owner is DN

fields.name: DRU_REC_017
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should have ACL (Access Control List) permissions set on all the exported DU-Link nodes of user developed DRIVE Update plug-ins to allow least privilege access.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring ACL permissions on exported DU-Link nodes for user-developed DRIVE update plug-ins is aprt of Platform security setup owned by DN

fields.name: DRU_REC_020
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall validate the baseline installation in the inactive bootchain prior to applying a partial update, such as delta update or partition subset, using the 'validate' Tegra Image Installer command(s). Alternatively, all partitions, including unmodified content, can be validated post installation to ensure the baseline installation is as expected.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Validating the baseline installation in the inactive bootchain with Tegra Image belong to DN security concept.

fields.name: DRU_REC_021
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall verify the software version of the update prior to setting the default bootchain or running Boot Health Check to ensure that only expected version of the software is used.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Verifying the software version of an update before setting the default bootchain or running Boot Health Check is part of the bootchain task where the owner is DN

fields.name: DOS_REC_029
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS should perform necessary health checks by adding tests in Boot Health Check Plug-in to ensure the full system has booted successfully and is fully functional after the very first boot to the newly flashed bootchain.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Defining and implementing Boot Health Check plug-in tests to verify system health after first boot of a newly flashed bootchain is part of ECU integrator task where the owner is DN

fields.name: DRU_ASU_005
fields.description: It is assumed that OEM shall not weaken the security infrastructure by disabling those provided by DRIVE OS (like Secure Boot, Secure Store, Secure Upgrade, Authenticated OTA updates etc).
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Deciding whether to enable or disable platform security infrastructure such as Secure Boot belong to DN security policy

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1008
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall setup Controller Area Network (CAN) Transceiver to allow the pass-through of Message Authentication Codes when supporting Secure Onboard Communication.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring the CAN transceiver to pass through Message Authentication Codes for Secure Onboard Communication is a DN security concept.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1009
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that the Ethernet Switch initializes all the ports in Deny All mode by default.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Initializing all Ethernet switch ports in default "deny all" mode is a Platform configuration task that the onwer is DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1039
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that a static policy at startup is applied on all Ethernet Switch ports to configure and apply security rules on the ingress and egress ports to prevent malicious traffic from entering or leaving the system.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring and applying static security policies on Ethernet switch ports at startup (for ingress/egress filtering) is a Platform configuration task that the owner is DN.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1057
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that any Application that requests a Sleep or Wake-up event for an Ethernet port is authorized to do so. Additionally, the user of DRIVE OS shall implement plausibility checks on the system state before performing the state transition to mitigate the safety impact of an unauthorized Sleep/Wake-up request.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Authorizing which applications may request Ethernet port Sleep/Wake events and performing system-state plausibility checks before those transitions is a part of ECU integrator task which belong to DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1058
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall configure frame filtering in the Ethernet MAC hardware of the Orin SoC to filter out Ethernet frames with unrecognized MAC/IP Source Address, Ethertype, IP protocol, or UDP/TCP port and, to the degree possible, block protocols not explicitly supported.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring the Orin Ethernet MAC hardware's frame filtering is a part of ECU responsble tasks that only DN can realize it.

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1069
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall configure the priority ability range of the NvEthMgr resource manager to the lowest range possible matching to the target performance KPIs.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring the NvEthMgr resource manager's priority ability range to the lowest values that still meet performance KPIs is an OS Platform tuning task owned by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1101
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall maintain immutable configurations of L2 and L3 network settings on the Safety MCU and Orin wherever feasible.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Keeping L2/L3 network settings immutable on the Safety MCU and Orin is a network and ECU platform configuration responsibility of DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1102
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall configure CAN MCAL driver on Orin in poll mode instead of interrupt mode for receiving messages to avoid the system being flooded with interrupts. Both 'Read' and 'Bus-Off' should be configured in the poll mode.
Note: 1. Drive OS FSI stack is offered as a closed box or open box solution. In case of closed box, CAN bus is not supported. FSI binary is not configurable in the closed box solution. In case of open box solution, CAN driver is available and configurable in either of the poll mode or interrupt mode as per AutoSAR standards. 2. In case of Interrupt mode, the user of DRIVE OS shall also ensure that application does not cause a 'Tx' storm and flood the CAN bus.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring the CAN MCAL driver on Orin to use poll mode/interrupt mode is a Platform integration task owned by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1103
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall support AutoSAR's Secure Onboard Communication Protocol to protect the CAN messages that are exchanged with the Functional Safety Island (FSI). This is needed to ensure message integrity, freshness and source authentication.
Note: Please refer to AutoSAR's 'Specification of Secure Onboard Communication Protocol' document for further details.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Implementing AUTOSAR Secure Onboard Communication on the CAN path between Orin and the Functional Safety Island is part of ECU integrator which is DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1104
fields.description:
