The user of DRIVE OS shall implement an intrusion prevention system for protecting the FSI CAN bus from other devices to prevent Denial of Service by CAN bus flooding attacks.
Note: One method of reducing the risk of CAN flood attacks against the FSI CAN is to rely on a CAN gateway that segments the FSI CAN from the rest of the Vehicle CAN channels. The gateway can monitor for unwanted CAN identifiers as well as implausible message transmission rates. When anomalies are detected, the CAN gateway can filter out anomalous messages to prevent disruption of the FSI CAN.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Implementing an intrusion prevention system or CAN gateway to protect the FSI CAN bus from flooding attacks is a part of DN security policy

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1105
fields.description: When relaying network messages from the vehicle side to DRIVE OS, the Safety MCU shall authenticate the network message first before relaying it.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Authenticating vehicle-side network messages on the Safety MCU before relaying them to DRIVE OS is owned by ECU integrator which is DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1106
fields.description:
When supplying a mechanism to support a secure communication channel between CCPLEX and the Safety MCU, the user of DRIVE OS shall fulfill the following expectations:
Prior to establishing a secure session between the DRIVE OS services and the Safety MCU applications, a mutual authentication step shall be performed to ensure that only the authorized entities are allowed to exchange messages.
It is recommended to use a secure communication mechanism like NvIPC to exchange messages with the Drive Update and IST clients within the CCPLEX execution environment.
The secure communication channel shall protect the message authenticity, integrity and freshness over the network communication link.
The cryptographic keys used in authenticating the network messages, shall be stored in the DRIVE OS supplied secure key store.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Designing and implementing the secure communication channel between CCPLEX and the Safety MCU is part of Platform communciation and part of DN security policies

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1128
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that access to the CAN communication stack (Controller & Driver) in the Functional Safety Island (FSI), is restricted to authorized applications running on FSI only, in order to reduce the risk of tampering with the CAN bus.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Restricting access to the CAN communication stack is a part of DN security policy

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1107
fields.description:
The user of DRIVE OS shall configure the calibration data (like number of buffer frames, frame sizes, event service thresholds etc) for NvIPC services associated with each process to ensure appropriate rate limiting to prevent Denial of Service and flooding attacks.
Note: Please refer to 'Chip to Chip Communication' and 'Inter-Process Communication' in SDK guide for the configurations.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring NvIPC calibration parameters (buffer counts, frame sizes, event thresholds, etc.) to provide rate limiting and DoS protection is an inter-process communication security policy which can only be realized by DN

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1108
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall enable MACSec for Ethernet links between Orin and any MACsec supporting peripheral (such as the LiDAR sensor, RADAR etc) to protect data integrity, authenticity and freshness.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Enabling and configuring MACsec on Ethernet links between Orin and peripherals (LiDAR, RADAR, etc.) is a part of DN security policy

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1109
fields.description: The user of DRIVE OS shall ensure that all the peripherals connected on Ethernet interfaces on the vehicle have predefined rate limits and Quality of Service values configured to ensure that the traffic originating from these peripherals does not overwhelm the overall system.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
This is Platform/ECU level requirement.
Configuring per-peripheral rate limits and QoS on vehicle Ethernet interfaces is an ECU Platform based solution which can be only realized by DN

fields.name: SEC-ePF-VUL-ECU-REQ-SPEC-a01-02-a
fields.description:
Requirements Specification of Vulnerability Countermeasure for ECU
This document defines the requirements on Vulnerability analysis / Vulnerability
countermeasures for ECU done by supplier to fulfill the requirements of ISO / SAE21434 and
reduce ECU vulnerability to the appropriate level.

 

Received from Hidetoshi Kobayashi (Denso)

fields.name: VULERQ_01005
fields.description: Requirement Deleted
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: Requirement Deleted

fields.name: VULERQ_01001
fields.description:
Requirements

 

Suppliers shall identify off-the-self components to be adopted and check for information related to security.

Conditions That Apply to Off-the shelf components

・ OSS（Open Source Software） e.g. OS（Linux, AGL etc.）、Library（OpenSSL）etc.

・ External procurement software e.g. BSW、Hypervisor、OS（QNX）etc.

・ External procurement hardware e.g. Microcontroller、SoC、HSM、Memory etc.

・ External procurement development environment / tools The development environment / tools to be applied are those used in software implementations. e.g. Compiler, automatic code generation tool for model- based development

※OSS / External procurement software embedded in firmware of product is also applied to this condition.

Items for Checking Information Related to Security

・ Type of the software and hardware, version

・ Whether there is evidence(※) related to security

※ e.g. ： Certificate of security certification(Common Criteria, EDSA Certification, etc.), Vulnerability analysis / evaluation result by software vendor etc.

 

Supplement

If it is hard to judge whether the component to be adopted is off- the-shelf component, the department in charge of security (the department issuing the present specifications), the department in charge of design, and suppliers shall make discussion separately and clarify the measures.

 

Reasons

 

To check the necessity of countermeasures when vulnerabilities of off-the-shelf components are reported
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is a generic supplier in-scope requirement for third party software adoption requested by DN

fields.name: VULERQ_01002
fields.description:
Requirements

 

①Suppliers shall check whether public vulnerabilities described in the vulnerability DB is present in off-the-shelf components to be used for the production. However, except that there are security related evidences of off-the-shelf components. (*1) ②If vulnerabilities are found, execute countermeasures mitigate the vulnerabilities. (*1) For "Vehicles subject to China GB" and "ECU: DCM, MM", vulnerabilities that are disclosed six months prior to the certification test will be subject to verification. Vulnerability DB to be Checked ・ JVN iPedia（or NVD） ・ CVE ・ US-CERT ・ CAVD(only for "Vehicles subject to China GB" and "ECU: DCM, C-DC(MM)") In the Case of Update in Vulnerability DB It is necessary to check vulnerability DB continuously since the information in vulnerability DB is updated every day. Methods to Check the Nonexistence of Vulnerabilities The following is available to check the nonexistence of vulnerabilities. ・(Annex 1) Off-The-Shelf Vulnerability Analysis Guide

 

Reasons

 

To prevent remaining public vulnerabilities that can be exploited
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is a generic security activity requirement requested by DN

fields.name: VULERQ_02001
fields.description:
Requirements

 

Suppliers shall identify security functions to which VC Level is assigned. Examples for each requirement kind of security functions are shown below. - Security specifications issued by department in charge of cybersecurity e.g. Message Authentication, Reprogramming Security - Security specifications issued by other than the department in charge of cybersecurity e.g. Security for proprietary-reprogramming - Security functions applied as vulnerability countermeasure, etc. e.g. JTAG authentication, encryption of communication between chips

 

Reasons

 

To use as input information for vulnerability analysis.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:

The requested functions cant be realized by WbyT SW

fields.name: VULERQ_02002
fields.description:
Requirements

 

Suppliers shall identify ECU's interfaces, usages and used parameters because ECU's interfaces could become attack entry point. Check Items as Interface Related Information ・ Purposes and usage of interfaces ・ Whether interfaces are usable after shipment form vehicle assembly plants. Note Regard interfaces as "existent", even if that interfaces are only used after recall from market. ・ Parameters of interfaces e.g. protocols used on communications, ranges of data Notes ・ Identify including interfaces that is usable only for production phase and nt usable after product shipment. ・ Identify including interfaces that is usable only for prototypes and not usable for productions. Examples of Interfaces that may be Exploitable ・ Wireless communication interfaces that connect to devices which are outside the vehicles. ➢ 3G／LTE／5G、Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、ITS、ETC／DSRC、RF communicationetc. ・ Wired communication interfaces that connect to devices which are outside the vehicles. ➢ CAN、Ethernet、USB、SD、CD、DVD、Blu-ray、etc. ・ Interfaces that are exploitable for physical analyses with disassembling vehicles / modifications. ➢ J-TAG, such as terminals which can access internal

 

Reasons

 

To use as input information for vulnerability analysis.

fields.name: VULERQ_02004
fields.description:
Requirements

 

① Suppliers shall execute vulnerability analysis for design and implementation both of all security functions and interfaces which specified in VULERQ_02001, VULERQ_02002. Perspective of vulnerability analysis shall be referred to "Perspectives Analysis for Vulnerabilities of Architectural Designs" in below. A person who executes vulnerability analysis shall meet "Requirement for a person who execute vulnerability analysis" in below. ② Suppliers shall execute vulnerability countermeasure if vulnerability has found. If suppliers do not take countermeasure, suppliers shall explain reason that countermeasure is not necessary. - example of countermeasure: Mitigation described in CWE (such as additional deployment of security function) - example of reason that countermeasure is not taken: There is no interface to exploit vulnerability

 

Reasons

 

To remove architectural vulnerabilities incorporated in ECUs.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_UREQ_002
fields.description:
The user of Deep Learning Inference shall verify that the serialized safe
engine validated by the TensorRT consistency checker is uncorrupted
and untampered from the time it was created by the TensorRT builder

to the time it’s used by the Deep Learning Inference element at run-
time.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. The serialized safe engine needs integrity protection by the platform. WbyT AD application can't do anything on this.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_UREQ_014
fields.description:
The user of Deep Learning Inference shall store the serialized safe en-
gine validated by the TensorRT consistency checker encrypted on read-
only QNX IFS and at runtime decrypt and verify the integrity of the en-
gine before calling ITRTGraph::createTRTGraph as documented in

the NVIDIA TensorRT API Reference for DRIVE OS [7].

 

Note

This requirement focuses on the integrity and location of the en-
gine. It differs from DEEPLRN_UREQ_002, which emphasizes that

the exact same engine created by the TensorRT builder, and which
passes the TensorRT consistency checker, must be used at runtime.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. The serialized safe engine needs integrity protection by the platform. WbyT AD application can't do anything on this.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_117
fields.description:
The user of Deep Learning Inference must run any application link-
ing to the Deep Learning Inference library in its least privileged mode.

Specifically, the user must run the application as non-root with the
PROCMGR_AID_MEM_PHYS ability dropped and locked.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is Platform/ECU level requirement. The privilege level of the WbyT AD application is determined by the platform. WbyT AD application can't do anything on this.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_104
fields.description:
Whenever the user of Deep Learning Inference links to user-provided
inputs, such as plugins, custom allocators, error recorders, and so on,
against Deep Learning Inference, they must:
▶ Implement the appropriate security mechanisms compliant with

the ISO 21434:2021 standard, for example, following secure cod-
ing practices, code inspection, static or dynamic analysis, ac-
cess control, and so on, to ensure the absence of malicious code,

rather than relying on Deep Learning Inference to prevent mali-
cious behavior, and

▶ store the compiled code in a read-only file system, such as
rootfs, to prevent time-of-check to time-to-use attacks, and
▶ verify the authenticity and integrity of the linked code using
a cryptographically secure signature verification algorithm to
guard against library spoofing, and
▶ use a secure hashing algorithm to verify that the linked code has

not been replaced by an earlier version for the prevention of roll-
back attacks.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: Only first bullet can be applicable at the SW Application level. However, our software developers are trusted and we do not accept untrusted code, so the first bullet does not require implementation to ensure the absence of malicious code. The remaining bullets are applicable at the Platform/ECU level, so not in scope for AD/ADAS SW.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_106
fields.description:
The user of Deep Learning Inference must verify the correctness of all
memory addresses of user-provided inputs. Specifically, this includes
the input tensor addresses where input data will be written prior to
making an enqueue call such as ITRTGraph::executeAsync, and the

output tensor addresses from where output data will be read for sub-
sequent driving decisions.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: This is application level requirement, but it depends on the platform/ECU level software. This requirement constrains the memory addresses used for user-provided inputs and subsequent outputs, but the platform / ECU level software needs to provide the valid memory address space that is allowed to be used for these operations.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_119
fields.description:
The user of Deep Learning Inference must not set the

LD_LIBRARY_PATH environment variable before starting the in-
ference process, and they must ensure that the authentic system

libraries from the rootfs are linked against. This includes the libc,

libc++, libslog2, libm, libgcc_s, and libnvdvms_client li-
braries.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: Partial scope for AD/ADAS SW Application. The inference process is initiated from the WbyT AD application which then call the RT-SDK's TRT runner module which then calls NVidia APIs. It needs to be determined whether Platform/ECU level will perform a LD_LIBRARY_PATH check, or the system will rely on the SW application to check itself. Process management (starting the process and setting start-time environment variables) and system library authentication is all part of DN security concept (e.g. secure boot). Those parts can't be handled by WbyT AD application.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_120
fields.description:
When compiling CUDA Math for use in a user-owned application or li-
brary, the user of Deep Learning Inference must verify that the CUDA

Math source code has not been tampered with and does not contain
any malicious code.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586:
WbyT AD/ADAS is not involved in the source code supply chain. The source code supply chain flow is:
1. NVIDIA: release the original image on NVOnline containing CUDA Math
2. Denso Platform BSP team: modifies the image (mostly configuration settings, but what is actually modified is opaque to us), and shares it via the DN Azure server
3. OT DevOps team: pushes the image to OneTeam Artifactory server
4. OT DevOps team & OT ECP team: make modifications to the image as specified in the dockerfile. Currently these modifications don't touch the CUDA Math files, but this could change (unlikely though) 
5. OT DevOps team: builds the Docker image and releases it to the PF team
6. Denso PF team: verify the image and released to the bevs3-adas-root repository. It is then used to make production build (Not by WbyT AD/ADAS).

fields.name: CIA(工程一覧)_DENSO-WbyT
fields.description:
CIA is direct agreement of WbyT scope with DENSO

 

Received from Hidetoshi Kobayashi (Denso)
WbyT shall support Denso in creation of cybersecurity interface agreement (CIA), resulting from the requirements of ISO/SAE 21434 7.4.3.
fields.scope_for_ad_adas_rationale$586: Standard ISO21434 document that AD/ADAS LoB needs to support.

fields.name: BEV-26 SYD-T-CSPL-ZZZ-25004
fields.description:
For BEV Step3 A-DC
Security requirements for software supplied by TMC

 

Received from Hidetoshi Kobayashi (Denso)

fields.name: (Autonomy) System Requirements
fields.approvers$31: Name Position Date
fields.change_history$31: Revision Date Author Description

fields.name: SWE-DRIVE-397-SWSM
fields.description: SYRDs derived from SWE-DRIVE-397-SWSM

fields.name: DOS_UREQ_1144
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that any sensitive data such as PII is encrypted before storing it on the non-volatile storage device.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: All AD/ADAS SWCGs utilize the same logging framework that stores logging data to non-volatile storage provided by the platform software (all messages transmitted by nodes are logged). Look into "Mass Data Collection (MDC)" provided by OneTeam (Denso/JQuad). PerceptionCore "TdpCalib" component uses non-volatile storage for calibration data. To be clarified at SWRD layer how each SWCG can meet this req.

fields.name: DOS_RES_132
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall not create or delete files used by DRIVE OS processes in the /dev/shmem (/tmp) directory.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: SWCGs are not accessing the filesystem directly, so /dev/shmem & /tmp are not used. Can be validated by a string search of the source code for these two paths.

fields.name: NET_RES_006
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that all NvSockets opened are properly closed by calling close() before the program exits, to facilitate the cleanup of the client transmit shared memory.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: AD/ADAS SWCGs do not directly use NvSockets. It is possible that RTSDK is using them at the lower layer. To be confirmed with RTSDK (Ryo Takahashi-san) owners whether NvSocket is used.

fields.name: NET_RES_007
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that authentication mechanisms and freshness checks are applied at the Application layer when transmitting and receiving packets using NvSocket, due to the potential threat of IP spoofing.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: AD/ADAS SWCGs do not directly use NvSockets. It is possible that RTSDK is using them at the lower layer. To be confirmed with RTSDK (Ryo Takahashi-san) owners whether NvSocket is used.

fields.name: NVS_REC_038
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that all memory buffers containing sensitive data are cleared and flushed prior to being deallocated to mitigate the risk of sensitive data being accessible.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Behavior software (LongitudinalControllerMain, LateralControllerMain, PerceptionCore) will not use dynamic memory allocation, so it's possible this does not apply to those (due to keyword "deallocated"); This is SW Application level requirement. The intention is to prevent sensitive data leakage unintentionally

fields.name: DOS_ASU_136
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure the input buffer sizes conform to the size expectations set by APIs, to prevent corruption of user space applications.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: This is SW Application level requirement. The intention is to prevent memory corruption.

fields.name: VKSC_RES_013
fields.description:
AD/ADAS SW applications using Vulkan SC with DRIVE OS shall store and load the pipeline cache data such that its data integrity is ensured.
Note: Rationale: The pipeline cache data contains GPU HW instructions in the application shader programs, as well as constants and pipeline state information. Modification of this data could result in execution of illegal GPU instructions and cause unpredictable behavior. Placing this data in a file on a read-only filesystem is recommended to reduce the attack surface. The user of DRIVE OS prepares the pipeline cache data during their SW development using the provided Pipeline Cache Compiler tool. Refer to "The Pipeline Cache Compiler (PCC) Tool" section in the NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX SDK Developer Guide [3], for more details on the tool usage.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: There are no usages in woven-togo and bev3-adas-root. bev3.rtsdk_proj in bev3-adas-root has Vulkan SDK headers shipped as part of QNX BSP.

fields.name: DLA_RES_015
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that the hardware-specific executable binaries and neural network models (aka loadables) such as for Deep Learning Accelerator (DLA) are stored in a partition that is protected by an access control mechanism.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: WbyT AD/ADAS software does not have any influence over storage of DLA models to the QNX Image File System (IFS). Model integration into the IFS is handled by platform integration teams.

fields.name: NVIPC_RES_014
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that the entire outgoing frame is populated with user data or filled with zeros when using NvSciIpcWriteGetNextFrame() NvSciIpc API to prevent the transfer of arbitrary data.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: NvSciIpcWriteGetNextFrame() NvSciIpc API is not directly used in Bev or WTG.

fields.name: DOS_ASU_133
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure the calibration and configuration data are stored in an authenticated file system to protect their integrity. This requirement refers to any calibration and configuration data in the context of the NVIDIA DRIVE OS Security Manual "SWE-DRIVE-397-SWCSM.pdf" .
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: AD/ADAS SW has configuration data stored as configuration parameters as part of the source code in behavior SWCGs, and calibration data and vehicle parameters are sent by Ethernet to the V4H for world understanding SWCGs. AD/ADAS SWCG owners need to identify the correct APIs in the correct location defined by platform security team

fields.name: FSI_RES_032
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW must ensure during integration that the error codes reserved by NVIDIA Software by Functional Safety Island (FSI) SW and documented in 'FSI Integration Guide' section in NVIDIA DRIVE OS 6.5 QNX PDK Developer Guide are not reported from any other User Application.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601:
This is application level requirement.
WbyT's AD/ADAS applications define and emit their own error/diagnostic codes, we are directly responsible for designing our error-code ranges and implementation so that none of our SWCs ever use NVIDIA-reserved error codes, ensuring those reserved codes remain unique to NVIDIA software

fields.name: NET_RES_006_NEG
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that it does not directly use NvSockets, otherwise it will need to implement security requirements "NET_RES_006" & "NET_RES_007".
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: To verify that the AD/ADAS SWCGs do not directly use NvSockets.

fields.name: VKSC_RES_013_NEG
fields.description:
The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that it does not directly use Vulkan SC with DRIVE OS to store and load the pipeline cache data, otherwise it will need to implement security requirement "VKSC_RES_013".
Refer to https://www.khronos.org/blog/vulkan-sc-overview to identify APIs associated with storing and loading pipeline cache data.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: To verify that the AD/ADAS SWCGs do not directly use Vulkan SC with DRIVE OS to store and load pipeline cache data.

fields.name: NVIPC_RES_014_NEG
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW shall ensure that it does not directly use NvSciIpcWriteGetNextFrame() NvSciIpc API, otherwise it will need to implement security requirement "NVIPC_RES_014".
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: To verify that the AD/ADAS SWCGs do not directly use NvSciIpcWriteGetNextFrame() NvSciIpc API.

fields.name: DLI-PROGRAM-SWCSM
fields.description: SYRDs derived from DLI-PROGRAM-SWCSM

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_106
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW must verify the correctness of all memory addresses of inputs to the Deep Learning Inference APIs. Specifically, this includes the input tensor addresses where input data will be written prior to making an enqueue call such as ITRTGraph::executeAsync, and the output tensor addresses from where output data will be read for subsequent driving decisions. If the verification fails, the software shall not use the Deep Learning Inference API and return an appropriate error.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601:
This requirement needs to be implemented by the RT-SDK team or platform SW team. The APIs referenced are not reachable via the AD/ADAS software.

This requirement constrains the memory addresses used for inputs and subsequent outputs, but the platform / ECU level software needs to provide the valid memory address space that is allowed to be used for these operations.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_119_ENV
fields.description: The AD/ADAS SW that uses Deep Learning Inference must not set the LD_LIBRARY_PATH environment variable before starting the inference process.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Tentatively in-scope for AD/ADAS SW Application. The inference process is initiated from the WbyT AD application which then call the RT-SDK's TRT runner module which then calls NVidia APIs. It needs to be determined whether Platform/ECU level will perform a LD_LIBRARY_PATH check, or the system will rely on the SW application to check itself. Process management (starting the process and setting start-time environment variables) is part of Platform/ECU security concept (e.g. secure boot) and can't be handled by WbyT AD/ADAS application.

fields.name: DEEPLRN_RES_119_LIB
fields.description: The platform software must ensure that the authentic system libraries from the rootfs are linked against. This includes the libc, libc++, libslog2, libm, libgcc_s, and libnvdvms_client libraries.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: System library authentication is all part of DN security concept (e.g. secure boot). That can't be handled by WbyT AD application.

fields.name: SEC-ePF-VUL-ECU-REQ-SPEC-a01-02-a
fields.description: SYRDs derived from SEC-ePF-VUL-ECU-REQ-SPEC-a01-02-a

fields.name: VULERQ_01001_SBOM
fields.description:
Requirements

 

AD/ADAS software owners shall identify off-the-self components that are used in the software.

Conditions That Apply to Off-the shelf components

・ OSS（Open Source Software） e.g. OS（Linux, AGL etc.）、Library（OpenSSL）etc.

・ External procurement software e.g. BSW、Hypervisor、OS（QNX）etc.

・ External procurement hardware e.g. Microcontroller、SoC、HSM、Memory etc.

・ External procurement development environment / tools The development environment / tools to be applied are those used in software implementations. e.g. Compiler, automatic code generation tool for model- based development

※OSS / External procurement software embedded in firmware of product is also applied to this condition.

Supplement

If it is hard to judge whether the component to be adopted is off- the-shelf component, the department in charge of security (the department issuing the present specifications), the department in charge of design, and suppliers shall make discussion separately and clarify the measures.

 

Reasons

 

To check the necessity of countermeasures when vulnerabilities of off-the-shelf components are reported
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: This is a generic supplier in-scope requirement for third party software adoption requested by DN

fields.name: VULERQ_01002
fields.description:
Requirements

 

①The Product Integrity Cybersecurity team shall check whether public vulnerabilities described in the vulnerability DB is present in the AD/ADAS software's off-the-shelf components to be used for the production. The list may be already provided by the off-the-shelf component vendor. (*1) ②If vulnerabilities are found, execute countermeasures mitigate the vulnerabilities. (*1) For "Vehicles subject to China GB" and "ECU: DCM, MM", vulnerabilities that are disclosed six months prior to the certification test will be subject to verification. Vulnerability DB to be Checked ・ JVN iPedia（or NVD） ・ CVE ・ US-CERT ・ CAVD(only for "Vehicles subject to China GB" and "ECU: DCM, C-DC(MM)") In the Case of Update in Vulnerability DB It is necessary to check vulnerability DB continuously since the information in vulnerability DB is updated every day. Methods to Check the Nonexistence of Vulnerabilities The following is available to check the nonexistence of vulnerabilities. ・(Annex 1) Off-The-Shelf Vulnerability Analysis Guide

 

Reasons

 

To prevent remaining public vulnerabilities that can be exploited
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: This is a generic security activity requirement requested by DN

fields.name: VULERQ_02006
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The Product Integrity Cybersecurity team shall ensure that similar vulnerabilities handled in the past at Toyota shall be nonexistent in the AD/ADAS software by checking the Toyota Vulnerability Notices (TVN) database and creating requirements to prevent recurrence of them.

 

Reasons

 

To prevent recurrence of vulnerabilities handled in the past thoroughly.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: This is a generic security activity requirement requested by DN

fields.name: VULERQ_01001_SECINFO
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The Product Integrity Cybersecurity team shall check the list of identified off-the-shelf components in AD/ADAS software for information related to security.

Items for Checking Information Related to Security

・ Type of the software and hardware, version

・ Whether there is evidence(※) related to security

※ e.g. ： Certificate of security certification(Common Criteria, EDSA Certification, etc.), Vulnerability analysis / evaluation result by software vendor etc.

 

Supplement

If it is hard to judge whether the component to be adopted is off- the-shelf component, the department in charge of security (the department issuing the present specifications), the department in charge of design, and suppliers shall make discussion separately and clarify the measures.

 

Reasons

 

To check the necessity of countermeasures when vulnerabilities of off-the-shelf components are reported
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: This is a generic supplier in-scope requirement for third party software adoption requested by DN

fields.name: SEC-ePF-VUL-CMN-REQ-SPEC-a02-01-a
fields.description: SYRDs derived from SEC-ePF-VUL-CMN-REQ-SPEC-a02-01-a

fields.name: VULCMN_01000
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The AD/ADAS software shall not contain functions (concealed function) for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation. (*) *) Does not include disabling functions. If off-the-shelf products already install functions (concealed function) for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation, logics for the functions shall be removed. If it is unavoidable to install functions (concealed function) for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation in the ECU, the functions shall satisfy the security requirements and obtain an agreement from the department in charge of system (each design department) and the department in charge of part (each design department). E.g. Software used during only the development phase, inspection software, and other unnecessary software shall not be installed in production parts.

 

Reasons

 

If a function that has not been approved by Toyota Motor Corporation and that may lead to backdoor remains in the market product, it can be used by attackers to access data that are normally not available to them. Excess functions may be potentially exploited by attackers.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: SW Application level hidden function; To close the backdoor to certain vulnerability

fields.name: VULCMN_01100_DOC
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"The AD/ADAS software owners shall clearly define and document the I/F specifications of the boundaries between the in-vehicle parts."

 

Reasons

 

To facilitate VULCMN_01100 related requirements for secure operation during attacks that involve making abnormal inputs and observing the behavior to analyze the processing and that involve causing abnormal operations and making outputs outside the scope of specification.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: SW Application level requierment; To prevent the overflow problems and control the data

fields.name: VULCMN_50700
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The countermeasure requirements for VULCMN_01100 for the AD/ADAS software shall be satisfied through fuzz testing with commercially feasible coverage and time-bounding.

 

Items to be Checked

 

Whether countermeasures are implemented Validity of countermeasures
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Confirmation REQ of VULCMN_01100_DOC, VULCMN_01100_IN, & VULCMN_01100_OUT

fields.name: VULCMN_01400
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"Data received by AD/ADAS software from outside the in-vehicle part shall be used only after checking its integrity."

 

Reasons

 

In-vehicle parts that receive external data should be capable of checking the validity of the written data and preventing operations on invalid data. This must be ensured by the in-vehicle parts having the update function.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601:
SW Application level requirement (e.g. MapService), to ensure applicable asset data integrity in case of update.
DN will handle data integrity inside ECU.

fields.name: VULCMN_51100
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The countermeasure requirements for VULCMN_01400 for the AD/ADAS software shall be satisfied through positive and negative functional tests.

 

Items to be Checked

 

Whether countermeasures are implemented Validity of countermeasures
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Countermeasure of VULCMN_01400

fields.name: VULCMN_01800_NEG
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"The AD/ADAS software shall ensure no CSP or PSP is distributed to other in-vehicle parts. E.g. Utilization of shared key protocol, information dispersion"

 

Reasons

 

"When distributing a CSP or PSP, it is necessary to maintain the confidentiality and integrity with use of encryption or MAC to prevent the CSPs from being leaked or tampered(For PSPs, to prevent tampering)."
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: The derived SYRD is duplicate of SYRD VULCMN_01700_NEG, because AD/ADAS SW owners will ensure no CSP or PSP exist within the AD/ADAS SW. Therefore, AD/ADAS software cannot distribute CSPs or PSPs.

fields.name: VULCMN_01600_NEG
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"The AD/ADAS software owners shall ensure no passwords exist within the AD/ADAS software.

 

Reasons

 

"We assume AD/ADAS software does not manage passwords, but we need to verify that. If we do manage passwords, additional requirements will apply."
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: To verify AD/ADAS SW does not contain passwords.

fields.name: VULCMN_01700_NEG
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"The AD/ADAS software owners shall ensure no CSP or PSP exist within the AD/ADAS software.

 

Reasons

 

"We assume AD/ADAS software does not manage CSPs or PSPs, but we need to verify that. If we do manage CSPs or PSPs, additional requirements will apply."
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: To verify AD/ADAS SW does not contain CSPs or PSPs.

fields.name: VULCMN_50800
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The AD/ADAS software shall be compliant with each programming language coding rules with in VULCMN_01200. The legacy software and the automatically generated code shall be compliant with secure coding rules. If confirming compliant with the secure coding rules with using static code analysis tools, "Recommended tools" column shall be refered. If there are items cannot be checked by the static code analysis tool, countermeasure requirement shall be satisfied with source code review. The external procurement software shall be compliant with corresponding to secure coding. If secure coding is not supported, it shall be compliant with corresponding to risk treatment. If there is a violation of the rule, the reason for the violation shall be permissible in terms of security.

Recommended Tools: Klocwork, Coverity, CodeSonar, QA・C, LDRA, Fortify SCA (use of the latest version is recommended)

 

Items to be Checked

 

Whether vulnerabilities exist in implementation
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Countermeasure of VULCMN_01200

fields.name: VULCMN_51200
fields.description:
Requirements

 

The countermeasure requirement for VULCMN_01600_NEG & VULCMN_01700_NEG shall be satisfied through source-code scanning in WbyT AD/ADAS SW Application.

 

Items to be Checked

 

Whether countermeasures are implemented Validity of countermeasures
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Countermeasue of VULCMN_01600, VULCMN_01700, VULCMN_01800, and VULCMN_01900

fields.name: VULCMN_01200
fields.description:
Requirements

 

To reduce vulnerabilities of software, for all software in ECU, the coding rules given below shall be applied. - C language: MISRA-C and CERT-C shall be applied in accordance with TSC7030G (C language coding standard for software embedded in in-vehicle electric/electronic parts). - C++ language: MISRA-C ++, AUTOSAR C ++ 14 and CERT-C ++ shall be applied in accordance with TSC7047G (C++ language coding standard for software embedded in in-vehicle electric/electronic parts). - Languages other than C language, and C++ language: Secure coding rules appropriate for each language shall be complied. E.g. ISO/IEC TR 24772, CERT-JAVA, CERT-Perl And, the legacy software, the automatically generated code of model-based development and the external procurement software shall support secure coding in the following table.

*1) You may check the codes using a static program analysis tool that enables secure coding checks(*2), and then fix only deviations from the coding rule that are not acceptable from security perspectives(*3).

*2) Receiving the verification result from a software vendor and confirming the result are acceptable.

*3) Confirm posing threats (*4) to information assets including CSPs, safety, corporate assets, privacy, etc.

*4) Example threats to information assets are: - CSP: Leakage of CSPs - Safety: Tampering of controls and programs of risk level 7 or higher - Corporate assets: Leakage of programs - Privacy: Leakage of personal and privacy information (*5)

*5) For personal and privacy information, see "Standards of Personal and Privacy Information" and "Requirements of Personal and Privacy Information".

Discuss whether measures are necessary among the department in charge of the system (each design department), the department in charge of the part (each design department), the department in charge of the coding (PQF), the department in charge of the security (issuing dept. of this document), and the supplier.

 

Reasons

 

Reduce vulnerabilities by performing coding in accordance with the rules.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: SW Application level requirement; Generic secure coding REQ

fields.name: VULCMN_01900
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"When the update process is stopped due to power interruption, etc., the state prior to the update shall be able to be retained."

 

Reasons

 

"If the CSP/PSP has some random value due to the interruption of the update process, the security function itself does not serve its purpose. Therefore, it is necessary that the value returns to that prior to the update process."
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: The derived SYRD is duplicate of SYRD "VULCMN_01700_NEG", because AD/ADAS SW owners will ensure no CSP or PSP exist within the AD/ADAS SW. Therefore ensuring the state of CSP or PSP is not applicable.

fields.name: VULCMN_04000
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"The password that is used by the applications shall contain at least numbers, uppercase letters and lowercase letters, and shall be at least 8 digits in length, or when the customer changes to a password which does not satisfy the above password requirement, the ECU shall notify the risk of it."

 

Reasons

 

"The application could be potentially permit an unauthorized use by Brute Force Attack etc. if an insecure password is set. If it is difficult to be set a sufficient secure password, the application encourages an appropriate use by providing the attention for the customer."
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: The derived SYRD is duplicate of SYRD for VULCMN_01600

fields.name: VULCMN_50600
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"This requirement should be implemented when applying VULCMN_01000. The AD/ADAS software owners shall confirm whether or not a function that does not correspond to Specifications specified by Toyota Motor Corporation are installed. If it is unavoidable to install functions for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation in the AD/ADAS software, the AD/ADAS software owner shall confirm that the functions satisfy the security requirements and the AD/ADAS software owner obtained an agreement from Toyota Motor Corporation."

 

Items to be Checked

 

"(1) Whether correspondence relationship between Specifications specified by Toyota Motor Corporation and function implemented on matrix table is indicated. (2) Whether function for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation are not included. (3) If it is unavoidable to install functions for specifications not specified by Toyota Motor Corporation, validity of the functions. (4) Whether table of review results regarding the correspondence relationship is described."
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Confirmation REQ of VULCMN_01000

fields.name: VULCMN_52900
fields.description:
Requirements

 

This requirement should be implemented when applying VULCMN_04000. The countermeasure requirements shall be satisfied through functional test.

 

Items to be Checked

 

Whether countermeasures are implemented Validity of the countermeasures
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: VULCMN_04000 is out-of-scope

fields.name: VULCMN_01100_IN
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"The AD/ADAS software shall not operate in reaction to any input outside the scope of I/F specification. E.g. Abnormal operation is not made even though the actual data length does not match the specified data length during a diagnostics or the like. (Anomaly process is carried out.)"

 

Reasons

 

There are attacks that involve making abnormal inputs and observing the behavior to analyze the processing and that involve causing abnormal operations and making outputs outside the scope of specification.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: SW Application level requierment; To prevent the overflow problems and control the data

fields.name: VULCMN_01100_OUT
fields.description:
Requirements

 

"The AD/ADAS software shall not make any output outside the scope of I/F specification. E.g. Abnormal operation is not made even though the actual data length does not match the specified data length during a diagnostics or the like. (Anomaly process is carried out.)"

 

Reasons

 

There are attacks that involve making abnormal inputs and observing the behavior to analyze the processing and that involve causing abnormal operations and making outputs outside the scope of specification.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: SW Application level requierment; To prevent the overflow problems and control the data

fields.name: CIA(工程一覧)_DENSO-WbyT
fields.description:
CIA is direct agreement of WbyT scope with DENSO

 

Received from Hidetoshi Kobayashi (Denso)
WbyT AD/ADAS Product Integrity team shall implement in-scope requirements from the CIA(工程一覧)_DENSO-WbyT.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Standard ISO21434 document that AD/ADAS LoB needs to support.

fields.description: WbyT AD/ADAS Product Integrity team shall support Denso in creation of the Vulnerability Analysis Report for the ECU design level, by performing vulnerability analysis of the AD/ADAS SW, including: Vulnerability Analysis at the AD/ADAS SW Design Level, Basis for Vulnerability Management at the AD/ADAS SW Design Level, Weaknesses at the AD/ADAS SW Design Level, and Risk Mitigation Measures for Vulnerabilities detected in AD/ADAS SW.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Marked as WbyT "Support" in the CIA, so AD/ADAS LoB needs to support.

fields.name: 1-7-3_PLAN
fields.description: WbyT AD/ADAS Product Integrity team shall support Denso in creation of vulnerability response results at the ECU level, by creating a vulnerability management plan for AD/ADAS SW.
fields.scope_for_adadas_rationale$601: Marked as WbyT "Support" in the CIA, so AD/ADAS LoB needs to support.

fields.name: 1-7-3_RISK
fields.description: WbyT AD/ADAS Product Integrity team & SWCG owners shall communicate to Denso, the risk response measures for vulnerabilities detected during implementation of the vulnerability management plan for AD/ADAS SW at the AD/ADAS SW level as part of SYRD "1-7-3_IMPL".

fields.name: SWRD-LaCM-3
fields.description:
Description

  • Describe the requirements for the vehicle in the TSS4e LTA・VLO performance requirement as of 20250120.
    20250120時点でのTSS4e LTA・VLO性能企画書に記載の車両としての要求を記載する。下記留意すること。
  • There is a possibility of future changes as some target performances are currently being re-examined considering the situation at other companies and trends in assessment.
    他社の状況やアセスメントの動向を鑑みて再度検証中の性能目標があるため、今後変更の可能性がある。
  • The following requirements are for the overall vehicle system. In the future, the requirements for the vehicle system will be divided into requirements for Lateral Controller Main.
    下記要求は車両システム全体への要求である。今後車両システムへの要求をLateral Controller Mainへの要求に按分する予定である。
  • "During AD control" is defined as the condition in which "AD state" corresponds to any of the states listed in the "Table: State list during AD control."
    「AD状態」が「表: AD制御時の状態一覧」のいずれかに該当するときを「AD制御中」と定義する。
  • Table: State list during AD control (T.B.D.)
    表: AD制御時の状態一覧（T.B.D.）
State Name
状態名
FadeOutToManualDrive
HandsOnAssist
HandsOffAssist
HandsOnRequestSilent
HandsOnRequestNormal
DotRequestSilent
DotRequestWeak
DotRequestNormal
CarStoppedDotRequest
SubDotRequest
SubFadeOutToManualDrive
  • Define "system activation" as satisfying the following conditions.
    次の条件を満たすときを「システム起動」と定義する。
  • When the previous "AD state" can be obtained and does not correspond to any state in the "Table: State list during AD control," and the current "AD state" corresponds to any state in the "Table: State list during AD control."
    前回の「AD状態」が取得でき「表: AD制御時の状態一覧」のいずれにも該当せず、現在の「AD状態」が「表: AD制御時の状態一覧」のいずれかに該当するとき。
  • It is guaranteed by the specification that there is no transition where the previous "AD state" cannot be obtained and the current "AD state" corresponds to any state in the "Table: State list during AD control." Therefore, the above definition is sufficient as a condition for transitioning to AD control.
    前回の「AD状態」が取得できず、現在の「AD状態」が「表: AD制御時の状態一覧」のいずれかに該当する遷移は仕様上ないことが保証されているため、AD制御に遷移する条件としては上記の定義で十分である。

Interface

IN

  • Target trajectory from the current pose
  • 現在の位置姿勢での目標トラジェクトリ
  • Selected vehicle speed
  • 選択車速
  • Redundant acceleration
  • 冗長加速度
  • Selected yawrate
  • 選択ヨーレート
  • AD state
  • AD状態
  • Current steering angle
  • 現在舵角
  • Vehicle specification information
  • 車両諸元
  • LaVIP output valid flag
  • LaVIP出力有効フラグ
  • Request ADAS pinion angle
  • ADAS要求ピニオン角
  • Request ADAS lateral ID
  • ADAS要求横ID
  • Steering cooperation status
  • ステア協調状態
  • Rear tire angle
  • リアタイヤ角

OUT

  • Target steering angle
  • 目標舵角
  • Target steering angle velocity
  • 目標舵角速度
  • Request lateral ID
  • 要求横ID
fields.rationale$136:
• To follow the trajectory.
    トラジェクトリに追従するため。

fields.name: SWRD-LaCM-3_1
fields.description:
Description

(empty)

Specification

SWRD-LaCM-3_1_SP_1

  • If "During AD control," which is defined in :id[SWRD-LaCM-3], calculate and output "target steering angle" based on "target trajectory from the current pose" and "selected vehicle speed," "redundant acceleration," "selected yawrate." If not "During AD Control," output "target steering angle" as "current steering angle."
    :id[SWRD-LaCM-3]で定義される「AD制御中」の場合、「現在の位置姿勢での目標トラジェクトリ」と「選択車速」、「冗長加速度」、「選択ヨーレート」から「目標舵角」を算出し出力する。「AD制御中」以外の場合、「現在舵角」の値を「目標舵角」の値として設定して出力する。
  • When vehicle specification information that varies depending on the vehicle variant is required for calculating "target steering angle," follow the conditions below.
    「目標舵角」の算出に車両バリエーションによって変動する車両諸元情報が必要な場合は、下記条件に従うこと。
  • If "LaVIP output valid flag" is true, use "vehicle specification information" to calculate "target steering angle." If "LaVIP output valid flag" is false, use the default values of "vehicle specification information" stored in LaCM to calculate "target steering angle."
    「LaVIP出力有効フラグ」がtrueの場合は、「車両諸元」を使用して「目標舵角」を算出すること。「LaVIP出力有効フラグ」がfalseの場合は、LaCMで保持する「車両諸元」の標準値を使用して「目標舵角」を算出すること。
  • The default values of "vehicle specification information" shall comply with vehicle configuration specification (T.B.D.).
    「車両諸元」の標準値は車両設定仕様書（T.B.D.）に従うこと。

SWRD-LaCM-3_1_SP_2

  • If "During AD control," which is defined in :id[SWRD-LaCM-3], output "request lateral ID" as AdvancedDrive. If not "During AD Control," output "request lateral ID" as NotRequested.
    :id[SWRD-LaCM-3]で定義される「AD制御中」の場合、「要求横ID」をAdvancedDriveにして出力する。「AD制御中」以外の場合、「要求横ID」をNotRequestedにして出力する。
fields.rationale$136:
• To follow the trajectory.
    トラジェクトリに追従するため。
  • To notify the EPS of "request lateral ID," allowing the EPS control mode to transition to one that meets the AD specification.
    EPSに「要求横ID」を通知し、EPSの制御モードをAD向けの仕様を満たしたものに移行させるため。
  • When "request lateral ID" is "Not Requested," "target steering angle" is not used for control. However, in the unlikely event that it is used, "current steering angle," which has the least impact on control, shall be outputted for safety reasons.
    「要求横ID」が「要求なし」のとき「目標舵角」は制御には使われないが、万が一使われた場合に安全のため最も制御に影響のない「現在舵角」を出力している。

fields.name: SWRD-LaCM-3_2
fields.description:
Description

  • Lane Trace
    レーントレース
  • The lateral deviation for the overall vehicle system is the distance between the center of the lane and the center of the vehicle.
    車線中央と自車中央の距離を車両システム全体の横偏差量とする。
  • Two types of target performance of deviation, X1 and X2 are set. X1 is a value that the driver does not feel as a deviation, and X2 is a value that the driver does not feel as discomfort. In addition, these thresholds can be expanded according to the lateral acceleration of the vehicle.
    偏差量の性能目標を2種類（X1, X2）設定する。X1はドライバが偏差を感じない値、X2はドライバが不快に感じない値である。また、これらの閾値は自車の横方向加速度に応じて拡大できる。
  • LTA performance requirement has requirement on the lateral deviation for the overall vehicle system as quoted below.
    車両システム全体の横偏差については、LTA性能企画書に以下の要求がある。
  • Satisfy 90% or more of lateral deviation within X1, and 99% or more of lateral deviation within X2.
    X1以内の横偏差を90%以上、X2以内の横偏差を99%以上を満たすこと。
  • The scope of application for this specification is when "Brake control request state" is "control on," or when it is in No.4 from "table: scene classification based on positional relationship with objects."
    「ブレーキ制御要求状態」が「制御あり」のとき、または「表: 対象物との位置関係によるシーン分類」の No.4 を適用範囲とする。
Type
種別		 Lateral acceleration [m/s2]
横加速度 [m/s2]		 X1 [m] X2 [m]
Inner side
内側		 Outer side
外側		 Inner side
内側		 Outer side
外側
Straight
直線		 0.0～0.5 0.20 0.40
Curve
カーブ		 0.5～1.5 0.30 0.20 0.50 0.40
1.5～3.0 0.35 0.20 0.55 0.40
  • The scope of application for this specification is when "Brake control request state" is "control off," and when it is either in No.1, 2, 3 from "table: scene classification based on positional relationship with objects."
    「ブレーキ制御要求状態」が「制御無し」のとき、かつ「表: 対象物との位置関係によるシーン分類」の No.1, 2, 3 のいずれかの場合を適用範囲とする。
Type
種別		 Lateral acceleration [m/s2]
横加速度 [m/s2]		 X2 [m]
Inner side
内側		 Outer side
外側
Curve
カーブ		 0.5～1.5 - 0.40
1.5～3.0 0.40
  • When driving on a lane adjacent to a branching lane, the lateral deviation towards the branching direction shall always be within X2 in "branching section (the section between the point where the outer line of the current lane intersects with the outer line of the branching road)" in case where X2 is defined.
    分岐車線と隣接する車線を走行時、「分岐区間（自車線の外側線と分岐路の外側線が交わる点と点の間の区間）」において、X2 が定義されている場合は分岐方向への横偏差が常に X2 以内であること。
  • Note: Requirements using "Brake control request state" for judgment are expected to be removed in URD0.0.11.
    ※「ブレーキ制御要求状態」を用いた判定の要求は、URD0.0.11にて削除見込み。
  • For large deviations, the evaluation index is based on the "deviation amount equivalent to lane departure". When vehicle width is 1.98 m driving on the Metropolitan Expressway, where the lane width is 3.25 m, it will deviate from the lane by just over 0.6 m, so the deviation amount equivalent to lane departure is set at 0.6 m. Part of that amount is assigned as the specification of the "deviation amount equivalent to lane departure" for LaCM alone. 大きな偏差について「車線逸脱相当の偏差量」を基準として評価指標を考える。首都高速の車線幅3.25 mを車幅1.98 mの車両が走行した場合を考えると、0.6 m強で車線逸脱するため、0.6 mを車線逸脱相当の車両システム全体の偏差量とする。そのうちLaCM単体の車線逸脱相当の偏差量として割り付けた値を仕様に記載する。
  • For unnecessary sudden behavior, it has been experimentally proven that drivers feel uneasy when lateral jerk of 1.36 m/s^3 continues for 0.4 sec. Therefore, lateral jerk of 1.36 m/s^3 is set as the threshold for unnecessary vehicle behavior.
    急で不要な挙動について、横ジャークが1.36 m/s^3が0.4 sec続くとドライバが不安に感じることが実験的にわかっている。そのため横ジャークが1.36 m/s^3を不要な車両挙動の閾値とする。
  • Lane change
    レーンチェンジ
  • According to R79 ACSF Category C, lateral jerk must not exceed 5.0 m/s³ and the relative lateral acceleration to the lane markings must not exceed 1.0 m/s². The system must ensure that these limits are not exceeded under any circumstances.
    R79 ACSF カテゴリ C にて横ジャークは5.0 m/s^3、区画線相対横加速度は1.0 m/s^2を超えてはならないとの規定があり、いかなる場合でもシステムによりこれを超える挙動が発生しないこととする。
  • According to the LC maneuvers performed by skilled drivers during the development of ASP2, the lateral jerk observed was approximately 1.0 m/s³ and the lateral acceleration was 0.5 m/s². Another study indicated that when lateral acceleration is less than 0.3 m/s², it becomes difficult to perceive that an LC maneuver is being executed, and up to 0.8 m/s², there is no sense of unease due to the speed of the movement. Therefore, the target performance is set at a lateral jerk of 1 m/s³ or less and a lateral acceleration of 0.3 to 0.8 m/s², which corresponds to a natural LC maneuver similar to that of skilled drivers.
    ASP2開発時に行った熟練ドライバのLC動作によると、発生する横ジャークはおよそ1.0 m/s^3、横加速度は0.5 m/s^2であった。また別の検討では、横加速度が0.3 m/s^2より小さいと LC動作を実施しているか分かりにくい、0.8 m/s^2までは動きの速さに不安を感じないとの結果があり、熟練ドライバ同等で自然な LC挙動である横ジャーク1 m/s^3以下、横加速度0.3~0.8 m/s^3を性能目標とする。
  • The calculation methods for relative lateral acceleration to the lane markings and lateral jerk should refer to '1.3 Definition of Analysis Data' in the LCA performance requirement.
    区画線相対加速度及び横ジャークの算出方法はLCA性能企画書の「1.3 解析データの定義」を参考にすること。
  • LCA performance requirement
    LCA性能企画書 TSS4e_LCA-PFM-STD-01-04
  • Lane change abort
    レーンチェンジ中止
  • The maximum lateral jerk of the vehicle during LC control abort shall be 3.0 m/s^3 (absolute value) or less.
    LC 中止制御中の車両の最大横ジャークが 3.0 m/s^3 (絶対値) 以下であること。
  • The relative lateral acceleration with respect to the lane line shall be less than 2.0 m/s².
    区画線相対横加速度が 2.0 m/s^2 未満であること。
  • The maximum jerk during LC abort control shall be the initial jerk at the timing when LC abort condition is met, and it shall be less than 1.5 m/s³.
    LC 中止制御中の最大ジャークが LC 中止条件が成立したタイミングの初期ジャークであり、かつ 1.5 m/s^3 未満であること。
  • Ensure that the lateral jerk does not exceed 2.0 m/s^3.
    横ジャークが2.0 m/s^3を超えないこと
  • Branch
    分岐
  • Ensure that the lateral acceleration caused by LC into the branch lane does not exceed 1.5 m/s^2. "lateral acceleration caused by LC into the branch lane" is defined as the difference between the actual lateral acceleration and the average lateral acceleration between 1 second before the beginning of a branch and the hard nose.
    分岐先車線へのLCによって発生する横加速度が1.5 m/s^2を超えないこと。ただし「分岐先車線へのLCによって発生する横加速度」とは、分岐始端1秒前からハードノーズの間の横加速度の平均値に対して実際に発生した横加速度の差分として定義される。
  • Variable Lateral Offset
    VLO
  • By keeping lateral distance from vehicles in adjacent lanes or structures close to the vehicle, driver's sense of security can be improved.　Vehicle overall performance requirement has below specification on the lateral velocity
    自車に近い隣接車線の車両あるいは構造物と横距離を確保することで、ドライバーの安心感を向上させる。その際、車両挙動について性能企画書に以下の規定がある。
  • About lateral speed
    横速度について
  • If the action to keep lateral distance is too fast, it may be perceived as swaying behavior. The performance target is defined as the range where the driver does not perceive the behavior as swaying but rather as smoothly keeping lateral distance.
    横距離を確保するための動作が速すぎると挙動としてふらつきと捉えられてしまう。ドライバが挙動をふらつきと感じずにスムーズに横距離を確保していると感じる範囲を性能目標として規定する。
  • Closed courses like test courses are considered to have fewer disturbances than open courses like public roads, thus stricter performance targets for lateral speed are set.
    テストコース等のクローズドコースでは、公道等のオープンコースよりも外乱が少ないと考えられるため横速度については厳しい性能目標を規定する。
  • Meet the following lateral speed relative to a lane line targets
    下記の区画線相対横速度の目標を満たすこと
  • Table: Lateral speed relative to a lane line targets
    表: 区画線相対横速度の目標
Course
コース		 Lateral speed relative to a lane line target
区画線相対横速度の目標
Closed course (e.g., test courses)
クローズドコース（テストコース等）		 0.05 m/s or less
0.05 m/s 以下
Open course (e.g., public roads)
オープンコース（社外等）		 0.11 m/s or less
0.11 m/s 以下
  • The lateral deviation for LaCM is the distance between the input trajectory and the rear axle center of the vehicle　when the vehicle moves according to the LaCM output steering command, for which the specifications are defined by distributing the overall vehicle system lateral deviation requirements to each SWCGs

LaCM観点の横偏差量を入力トラジェクトリとLaCMが出力する目標舵角によって車両が移動した際の自車後輪軸中心との距離とし、車両システム全体の偏差量からLaCMに割り付けた値を要求仕様に記載する。

  • In the context of LaCM, lateral movement metrics are defined as the increase in the absolute value of them when the vehicle moves according to the LaCM output steering command relative to the input trajectory, and the values allocated to LaCM alone are specified below. Lateral movement metrics refer to the yaw rate change, lateral jerk, lateral acceleration, and lateral velocity.

LaCM観点での横移動メトリクスは、入力トラジェクトリに対してLaCMが出力する目標舵角によって車両が移動した結果発生した横移動メトリクスの絶対値の増加分と定義し、LaCM単体に割り付けた値を仕様に記載する。横移動メトリクスとは、ヨーレート変化率、横ジャーク、横加速度、横速度を指す。

  • The prerequisites, including the road environment and vehicle conditions targeted by this SWRD, shall comply with LTA Performance Specification, LCA Performance Specification, and BRN Performance Specification.
    本SWRDが対象とする道路環境や自車両条件などの前提条件については、LTA性能企画書、LCA性能企画書、BRN性能企画書に従うこととする。

Specification

SWRD-LaCM-3_2_SP_1

  • Satisfy 90% or more of lateral deviation within X1, and 100% of lateral deviation within X2.
    X1以内の横偏差を90%以上、X2以内の横偏差を100%満たすこと。
  • For LaCM, X1 (TBD) and X2 (TBD) are defined as the table below.
    LaCM単体の横偏差について、以下の表のX1(TBD), X2(TBD)を適用する。
Type
種別		 Lateral acceleration [m/s2]
横加速度 [m/s2]		 X1 [m] X2 [m]
Inner side
内側		 Outer side
外側		 Inner side
内側		 Outer side
外側
Straight
直線		 0.0～0.5 0.14 0.28
Curve
カーブ		 0.5～1.5 0.19 0.14 0.32 0.28
1.5～3.0 0.21 0.14 0.34 0.28

SWRD-LaCM-3_2_SP_2

  • The maximum lateral jerk shall be 0.15 m/s³ (TBD) or less.
    最大横ジャークが0.15 m/s^3 (TBD)以下であること。

SWRD-LaCM-3_2_SP_3

  • The yaw rate change shall be within 0.4 deg/s² (TBD).
    ヨーレート変化率が0.4 deg/s^2 (TBD) 以内であること。

SWRD-LaCM-3_2_SP_4

  • Lateral speed relative to a lane line targets shall be 0.02 m/s (TBD) or less.
    横速度が0.02 m/s (TBD)以下を満たすこと

SWRD-LaCM-3_2_SP_5

  • The maximum relative lateral acceleration to the white line shall be 0.02 m/s^2 (TBD) or less.
    最大横加速度が0.02 m/s^2 (TBD) 以下であること。
fields.rationale$136:
• To prevent the driver from feeling any discomfort or unease due to the deviation.
    ドライバに偏差により違和感や不快感を感じさせないため。
  • To reduce driver's sense of anxiety due to sudden vehicle maneuver.
    急な車両挙動によりドライバが感じる不安感をより小さくするため。
  • To prevent sudden maneuvers from occurring during LC.
    LCによって急挙動が発生しないようにするため。
  • To ensure a safe and smooth LC into the branch lane.
    安心・安全に分岐車線にLCするため。
  • By keeping lateral distance from vehicles in adjacent lanes or structures close to the vehicle, driver's sense of security can be improved.
    自車に近い隣接車線の車両あるいは構造物と横距離を確保することで、ドライバーの安心感を向上させる。

fields.name: SWRD-LaCM-3_3
fields.description:
Description

  • When there is a deviation from the lane center immediately after "system startup" or "hands off after steering override", control the deviation to converge towards zero.
    「システム起動」や「ステアリングオーバーライド後の Hands OFF」直後に車線中央から偏差がある場合、偏差がゼロに収束するようシステムが制御する。
  • It is specified in the LTA performance requirement that Immediately after "system startup" or "hands off after steering override," the maximum overshoot shall be within 0.20 m and the overshoot after one cycle shall be within 0.15 m.
    車両システム全体の最大オーバーシュート量が0.20 m, 1周期後のオーバーシュート量が0.15 m以内であることがLTA性能企画書に規定されている。
  • The lateral deviation for LaCM is the distance between the input trajectory and the rear axle center of the vehicle　when the vehicle moves according to the LaCM output steering command, for which the specifications are defined by distributing the overall vehicle system lateral deviation requirements to each SWCGs
    LaCM観点の横偏差量を入力トラジェクトリとLaCMが出力する目標舵角によって車両が移動した際の自車後輪軸中心との距離とし、車両システム全体の偏差量からLaCMに割り付けた値を要求仕様に記載する。
  • It is specified in the LTA performance requirement that Immediately after "system startup" or "hands off after steering override", the yaw rate change shall be within 5.6 deg/s² and the lateral jerk shall be within 1.36 m/s³.
    「システム起動」や「ステアリングオーバーライド後の Hands OFF」直後の、車両システム全体でのヨーレート変化率が5.6 deg/s^2以内、横ジャークが1.36 m/s^3以内であることがLTA性能企画書に規定されている。
  • In the context of LaCM, lateral movement metrics are defined as the increase in the absolute value of them when the vehicle moves according to the LaCM output steering command relative to the input trajectory, and the values allocated to LaCM alone are specified below.
    LaCM観点での横移動メトリクスは、入力トラジェクトリに対してLaCMが出力する目標舵角によって車両が移動した結果発生した横移動メトリクスの絶対値の増加分と定義し、LaCM単体に割り付けた値を仕様に記載する。

!image wandering

  • The overshoot amount was approximately 0.2 m in the LC maneuvers of skilled drivers, so this is set as the overall vehicle system's target performance.
    LC時のオーバーシュート量は、熟練ドライバーの LC 動作においておよそ 0.2 m であったため、これを車両システム全体の性能目標とする。
  • In the context of LaCM the lateral overshoot is defined as the distance between the input trajectory and the vehicle rear axle center when the vehicle moves according to the LaCM output steering command and it crosses the input trajectory. The values allocated to LaCM alone are specified below.
    LaCM観点のオーバーシュート量は入力トラジェクトリをLaCMが出力する目標舵角によって車両が移動した際の自車後輪軸中心が超えた距離とし、車両システム全体のオーバーシュートからLaCMに割り付けた値を要求仕様に記載する。
  • The prerequisites, including the road environment and vehicle conditions targeted by this SWRD, shall comply with LTA Performance Specification, LCA Performance Specification, and BRN Performance Specification.
    本SWRDが対象とする道路環境や自車両条件などの前提条件については、LTA性能企画書、LCA性能企画書、BRN性能企画書に従うこととする。

Specification

SWRD-LaCM-3_3_SP_1

  • The maximum overshoot shall be within 0.12 m (TBD).
    最大オーバーシュート量が0.12 m (TBD) 以内であること。

SWRD-LaCM-3_3_SP_2

  • The overshoot after one cycle shall be within 0.08 m (TBD).
    1周期終了後のオーバーシュート量が0.08 m (TBD) 以内であること。

SWRD-LaCM-3_3_SP_3

  • Immediately after "system startup" or "hands off after steering override," the time to the edge of the lane shall be at least 2.0 seconds.
    「システム起動」や「ステアリングオーバーライド後のHands OFF」直後に、レーン端までの時間が2.0 sec以上であること。
  • [Description] The time to the edge of the lane is calculated from the lateral speed and the distance to the lane edge.
    【説明】 レーン端までの時間は横速度とレーン端までの距離から算出する。
  • The above requirements are for the overall vehicle system. In the future, the requirements for the vehicle system will be divided into requirements for Lateral Controller Main.
    上記要求は車両システム全体への要求である。今後車両システムへの要求を Lateral Controller Main への要求に按分する予定である。

SWRD-LaCM-3_3_SP_4

  • Starting within 7 seconds (T.B.D.) after "system startup" or "hands off after steering override," ensure that the lateral speed relative to a lane line remains at 0.2 m/s (T.B.D.) or less for 1.0 second (T.B.D.).
    「システム起動」や「ステアリングオーバーライド後のHands OFF」直後を始点に7秒以内（T.B.D.）に、区画線相対横速度が0.2 m/s（T.B.D.）以下が1.0秒間（T.B.D.）継続すること。
  • [Description] Based on the TSS4 specifications, the system is designed to converge to the lane center within 7 seconds.
    【説明】 TSS4の仕様を参考に7秒以内に道路中央に収束する仕様とする。
  • The above requirements are for the overall vehicle system. In the future, the requirements for the vehicle system will be divided into requirements for Lateral Controller Main.
    上記要求は車両システム全体への要求である。今後車両システムへの要求を Lateral Controller Main への要求に按分する予定である。
fields.rationale$136:
• To prevent the driver from feeling any discomfort or unease due to the deviation.
    ドライバがふらつきにより不快に感じさせないため。
  • To ensure the driver does not feel uneasy during LC.
    LC 時にドライバに不安を感じさせないため。

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits
fields.description:
Description

  • The requirement for the SP is to target the interval from t0 to t22 within the sampling range. SPに記載されている機能要件の速度プランは 0.0秒 ～ 2.2秒 (*1) までの区間におけるサンプリング値を対象とする。
  • (1) Refer to headway time setting in ISO 15622, Section 6.2.3.1. (1) ISO15622 6.2.3.1項における車間時間設定を参照
  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the following Appendix. 本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：DefinitionofCommonequations"に定義されたものとする。
Physical quantity Symbol
Sampling time $ t_n $
Target trajectory speed value $ v_n $
Acceleration $ a_n $
Jerk $ j_n $
  • In this SWRD, the target trajectory contains a time-series dataset of planned ego vehicle speeds at each sampling time as the vehicle travels along the predicted path. 本SWRDにおける目標トラジェクトリは、車両が予測経路上を移動する際の各サンプリング時刻ごとに計画された自車速度の時系列データを持つ。
  • Sampling starts at time $t0 $ (index 0) and continues at intervals of $\Delta t$, recording the target trajectory speed values $vn$ corresponding to each sampling time $tn$ within the range 0.0 to 5.0 seconds. サンプリングはサンプリング番号 0 の時刻 $t0 $ からサンプリング間隔 $\Delta t$ ごとに実施し、各サンプリング時刻 $tn$（0.0秒〜5.0秒）における目標トラジェクトリの速度値 $vn$ を格納する。

Interface

IN

  • Ego vehicle speed
  • 自車速度
  • Ego vehicle acceleration
  • 自車加速度
  • Set speed
  • 設定車速

OUT

  • Target trajectory
  • 目標トラジェクトリ

Specification

SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits_SP_1

  • The minimum acceleration threshold for each speed $vn$ is defined as follows, and the measured average acceleration $ an $ shall not be less than this threshold. 各速度 $vn$ における最小加速度閾値 $a{\mathrm{limit\min}}(v)$ は以下の通り定義し、加速度 $ an $ がこの閾値を下回らない速度プランであること。

$$

a{\mathrm{limit\min}}(v) =

\begin{cases}

-5.0 & \text{if } 0 \le v \le 5 \\

-3.5 & \text{if } v \ge 20 \\

-5.0 + \frac{-3.5 - (-5.0)}{20 - 5} \cdot (v - 5) & \text{otherwise}

\end{cases}

\quad [\mathrm{m/s^2}]

$$

SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits_SP_2

  • The maximum acceleration threshold $a{\mathrm{limit\max}}(v)$ for each speed $vn$ is defined as follows, and the measured average acceleration $ an $ shall not exceed this threshold. 各速度 $vn$ における最大加速度閾値 $a{\mathrm{limit\max}}(v)$ は以下の通り定義し、加速度 $ an $ がこの閾値を上回らない速度プランであること。

$$

a{\mathrm{limit\max}}(v) =

\begin{cases}

4.0 & \text{if } 0 \le v \le 5 \\

2.0 & \text{if } v \ge 20 \\

4.0 + \frac{2.0 - 4.0}{20 - 5} \cdot (v - 5) & \text{otherwise}

\end{cases}

\quad [\mathrm{m/s^2}]

$$

SWRD-PnP-VF-Common_Operational_limits_SP_3

  • The minimum jerk threshold $j{\mathrm{limit\min}}(v)$ for each speed $vn$ is defined as follows, and the measured average jerk $ jn $ shall not be less than this threshold. 各速度 $vn$ における最小ジャーク閾値 $j{\mathrm{limit\min}}(v)$ は以下の通り定義し、ジャーク $ jn $ がこの閾値を下回らない速度プランであること。

$$

j{\mathrm{limit\min}}(v) =

\begin{cases}

-5.0 & \text{if } 0 \le v \le 5 \\

-2.5 & \text{if } v \ge 20 \\

-5.0 + \frac{-2.5 - (-5.0)}{20 - 5} \cdot (v - 5) & \text{otherwise}

\end{cases}

\quad [\mathrm{m/s^3}]

$$

Reference

  • Each threshold shall comply with ISO15622. 各閾値はISO15622に準拠する。
fields.rationale$136: • To ensure that acceleration and jerk remain within acceptable limits. 加速度、ジャークが許容範囲を超えないようにするため。

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-CSpm_CorneringSpeedManagement_0001
fields.description:
Description

  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the following Appendix. 本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：DefinitionofCommonequations"に定義されたものとする。
Physical quantity Symbol
Sampling time $t_n$
Target trajectory speed value $v_n$
Lateral acceleration $a_{\mathrm{lat},n}$
Path curvature $\kappa_n$
  • In this SWRD, the target trajectory contains a time-series dataset of planned ego vehicle speeds at each sampling time as the vehicle travels along the predicted path. 本SWRDにおける目標トラジェクトリは、車両が予測経路上を移動する際の各サンプリング時刻ごとに計画された自車速度の時系列データを持つ。
  • The target trajectory speed targeted by this requirement is defined at intervals of $\Delta t$ from the time $t0$ corresponding to sampling index 0 up to 5.0 seconds ahead, and stores the velocity value $vn$ at each sampling time $tn$. 本要件で対象とする目標トラジェクトリの速度は、サンプリング番号 0 に対応する時刻 $t0$ を起点とし、サンプリング間隔 $\Delta t$ ごとに 5.0 秒先まで定義され、各サンプリング時刻 $tn$ における速度値 $vn$ を格納するものとする。
  • This requirement satisfies the function in UN R171, Section 5.3.7. 本要件は UN_R171 5.3.7項 における機能を満たすものである。

Interface

IN

  • Ego vehicle speed
  • 自車速度
  • Ego vehicle acceleration
  • 自車加速度
  • Set speed
  • 設定車速
  • Curvature information
  • 曲率情報

OUT

  • Target trajectory
  • 目標トラジェクトリ

Specification

SWRD-PnP-VF-CSpm_CorneringSpeedManagement_0001_SP_1

  • When the path curvature $\kappan$ is greater than or equal to 1/3000 m⁻¹, the target trajectory speed shall be such that the lateral acceleration $a{\mathrm{lat},n}$ at each point in the time series does not exceed 3.0 m/s², in accordance with the path curvature $\kappan$. 経路曲率 $\kappan$ が 1/3000 m⁻¹ 以上の場合、時系列の各点における横加速度 $a{\mathrm{lat},n}$ が、経路曲率 $\kappan$ に応じて 3.0 m/s² 以下となる目標トラジェクトリの速度であること。
  • The above maximum value shall be configurable and subject to change. 上記の最大値は後から変更可能なものとする。
fields.rationale$136: • To assist the driver in traveling at an appropriate vehicle speed adapted to the path curvature. 経路の曲率に応じて適切な自車速度で走行できるよう、ドライバーの運転を支援するため。

Specification

  • Construction installations on the ego lane are detected. 自レーン上の工事区間設置物を検知していること。

  • Otherwise, the Ego lane closure detection flag shall be False. それ以外の場合、自レーン閉鎖検知フラグがFalseとなること。
fields.rationale$136: • To require DOT when the ego lane is closed due to construction installations. 自レーンが工事区間設置物により閉鎖されている場合に、DOT要求するため。

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-PVF_PrecedingVehicleFollowing_0001
fields.description:
Description

  • The evaluation of this function is performed in the lower-level Requirement, therefore this Requirement is excluded from the SWQT. 当該機能の評価は、下位のRequirementで確認する為、本Requirementは、SWQTの対象外とする
  • The term "vehicle" in this function refers to vehicles that fall under the categories defined by law. 当該機能での「車両」とは、法規で規定される下記に該当するものを指す
  • Heavy vehicles 大型自動車
  • Medium-sized vehicles 中型自動車
  • Light vehicles 普通自動車
  • Large special-purpose vehicles 大型特殊自動車
  • Large motorcycles 大型自動二輪車
  • Light motorcycles 普通自動二輪車
  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the following Appendix. 本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：DefinitionofCommonequations"に定義されたものとする。
Physical quantity Symbol
Sampling time $ t_n $
Target trajectory speed value $ v_n $
  • In this SWRD, the target trajectory speed is a time-series dataset of planned ego vehicle speeds at each sampling time, representing the vehicle's motion along the predicted path, and is a component of the target trajectory. 本SWRDにおける目標トラジェクトリの速度は、車両が予測経路上を移動する際の各サンプリング時刻ごとに計画された自車速度の時系列データであり、目標トラジェクトリの構成要素とする。
  • Sampling starts at time $t0 $ (index 0) and continues at intervals of $\Delta t$, recording the target trajectory speed values $vn$ corresponding to each sampling time $tn$ within the range 0.0 to 5.0 seconds. サンプリングはサンプリング番号 0 の時刻 $t0 $ からサンプリング間隔 $\Delta t$ ごとに実施し、各サンプリング時刻 $tn$（0.0秒〜5.0秒）における目標トラジェクトリの速度値 $vn$ を格納する。

Interface

IN

  • Ego vehicle speed
  • 自車速度
  • Ego vehicle acceleration
  • 自車加速度
  • Set speed
  • 設定車速
  • Target following distance
  • 目標車間距離
  • Recognition information
  • 認識情報

OUT

  • Target trajectory
  • 目標トラジェクトリ

Specification

SWRD-PnP-VF-PVF_PrecedingVehicleFollowing_0001_SP_1

  • Output the target trajectory required for preceding vehicle following based on the input information. 入力情報から先行車追従に必要な目標トラジェクトリを出力する。
  • The functional requirements for the output information shall follow the specifications below. 出力情報に対する機能要件は下記に従うものとする。
  • SWRD-PnP-VF-PVFPrecedingVehicleFollowingDistanceKeeping_0001
  • SWRD-PnP-VF-PVFPrecedingVehicleFollowingFollowingAcceleration_0001
  • SWRD-PnP-VF-PVFPrecedingVehicleFollowingFollowingDeceleration_0001

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-PVF_PrecedingVehicleFollowing_FollowingInDestinationLane_0001
fields.description:
Description

  • The target trajectory speed shall be a time-series dataset of ego vehicle speed. 目標トラジェクトリの速度は、自車速度の時系列データとする。
  • The requirement for the SP is that the target trajectory speed shall target the interval from t0 to t22 within the sampling range. SPに記載されている機能要件の目標トラジェクトリの速度は 0.0秒 ～ 2.2秒(*1) までの区間におけるサンプリング値を対象とする。
  • (1) Refer to the headway time setting in ISO 15622, Section 6.2.3.1. (1) ISO15622 6.2.3.1項における車間時間設定を参照
  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the following Appendix. 本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：DefinitionofCommonequations"に定義されたものとする。
Physical Quantity Symbol
Headway distance $d_n$
  • For any physical quantity whose values at specific vehicle speeds are provided in tabular form within this SWRD, the value corresponding to a vehicle speed not explicitly listed in the table shall be obtained by linear interpolation using the two adjacent speed points that bound the target speed. 本SWRDにおいて速度に対する値を表形式で示した物理量について、当該表に明示されていない速度値に対応する値は、当該速度値を挟む2つの隣接する速度点を用いて線形補間により算出するものとする。

Interface

IN

  • Ego vehicle speed
  • 自車速度
  • Ego vehicle acceleration
  • 自車加速度
  • Set speed
  • 設定車速
  • Target following distance
  • 目標車間距離
  • Recognition information
  • 認識情報

OUT

  • Target trajectory
  • 目標トラジェクトリ

Specification

SWRD-PnP-VF-PVF_PrecedingVehicleFollowing_FollowingInDestinationLane_0001_SP_1

  • During transitions between travel lanes, the system shall also meet the functional requirements for distance keeping, following acceleration, and following deceleration with respect to the preceding vehicle in the destination lane. 遷移先レーンの先行車両に対して車間維持、追従加速、追従減速の機能要件を満足すること。

SWRD-PnP-VF-PVF_PrecedingVehicleFollowing_FollowingInDestinationLane_0001_SP_2

  • During a transition to the destination lane, if preceding vehicle following is active for a preceding vehicle in the current lane, the headway distance $dn$ at each sampling time shall be greater than or equal to the target value corresponding to the ego vehicle speed, as shown in the table below. 遷移先レーンへレーン遷移する際、遷移前の自レーン上の先行車に対して、各時系列における車間距離 $dn$ が自車速度に応じて下記の目標値以上であること。
Current speed [km/h] 4 8 12 16 20 24 26 30 36 52 60 68 84 100 116 136
Target Distance [m] 5.27 10.53 10.10 10.93 12.09 12.96 13.00 14.31 16.32 21.38 21.47 23.12 26.54 29.27 32.48 37.77
fields.rationale$136: • To enable preceding vehicle following for the vehicle in the destination lane during a transition between travel paths. レーン遷移先の先行車に追従するため。

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-SSF_SetSpeedFollowing_0001
fields.description:
Description

  • The evaluation of this function is performed in the lower-level Requirement, therefore this Requirement is excluded from the SWQT. 当該機能の評価は、下位のRequirementで確認する為、本Requirementは、SWQTの対象外とする
  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the following Appendix. 本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：DefinitionofCommonequations"に定義されたものとする。
Physical quantity Symbol
Sampling time $ t_n $
Target trajectory speed value $ v_n $
  • In this SWRD, the target trajectory contains a time-series dataset of planned ego vehicle speeds at each sampling time as the vehicle travels along the predicted path. 本SWRDにおける目標トラジェクトリは、車両が予測経路上を移動する際の各サンプリング時刻ごとに計画された自車速度の時系列データを持つ。
  • Sampling starts at time $t0 $ (index 0) and continues at intervals of $\Delta t$, recording the target trajectory speed values $vn$ corresponding to each sampling time $tn$ within the range 0.0 to 5.0 seconds. サンプリングはサンプリング番号 0 の時刻 $t0 $ からサンプリング間隔 $\Delta t$ ごとに実施し、各サンプリング時刻 $tn$（0.0秒〜5.0秒）における目標トラジェクトリの速度値 $vn$ を格納する。

Interface

IN

  • Ego vehicle speed
  • 自車速度
  • Ego vehicle acceleration
  • 自車加速度
  • Set speed
  • 設定車速

OUT

  • Target trajectory
  • 目標トラジェクトリ

Specification

SWRD-PnP-VF-SSF_SetSpeedFollowing_0001_SP_1

  • Output the target trajectory required for set speed following based on the input information. 入力情報から設定車速追従に必要な目標トラジェクトリを出力する。
  • The functional requirements for the output information shall follow the specification below. 出力情報に対する機能要件は下記に従うものとする。
  • SWRD-PnP-VF-SSFSetSpeedFollowingSpeedFollowing_0001
fields.rationale$136: • To assist the driver's driving through set speed following. 設定車速追従によってドライバーの運転を支援するため

fields.name: SWRD-PnP-VF-SSF_SetSpeedFollowing_SpeedFollowing_0001
fields.description:
Description

  • The target trajectory speed shall be a time-series dataset of ego vehicle speed. 目標トラジェクトリの速度は、自車速度の時系列データとする。
  • The requirement for the SP is to target the interval from t0 to t22 within the sampling range. SPに記載されている機能要件の速度プランは 0.0秒 ～ 2.2秒(*1) までの区間におけるサンプリング値を対象とする。
  • (1) Refer to headway time setting in ISO 15622, Section 6.2.3.1. (1) ISO15622 6.2.3.1項における車間時間設定を参照
  • The formulas for deriving physical quantities used in this SWRD are defined in the following Appendix. 本SWRDで使用する下記の物理量の算出式は"Appendix：DefinitionofCommonequations"に定義されたものとする。
